scripts.text:
[Wounded]
Wow! Thanks a lot!
I don't know how this happened to our ship
but we should go to see the captain.
scripts.translation:
[伤员]
哇！太感谢你了！
我也不知道我们的船怎么会变成这样，
不过我们得去找船长看看。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
... ohh, it seems my body is too injured.
Maybe you can go without me?
scripts.translation:
[伤员]
...唉，看来我伤得太重了。
你能不能先一个人过去？

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Information -!^000000
NPC Quest Received.
^4d4dffQuestinfo Shortcut is Alt + U^000000
You can check your quest status there anytime.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 信息 -!^000000
已接取 NPC 任务。
^4d4dff任务日志快捷键为 Alt + U^000000
你随时都可以在那里查看任务状态。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
Luckily the water has not entered the ship.
I will wait here, you should go see the captain.
scripts.translation:
[伤员]
幸好海水没有灌进船里。
我就在这里等着，你去找船长吧。

scripts.text:
[Wounded]
I'm fine! I'm fine!
Don't worry about me, you should really go to the captain!
scripts.translation:
[伤员]
我没事！真的没事！
别担心我，快去找船长吧！

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Information -!^000000
^4d4dffQuestinfo Shortcut is Alt + U^000000
You can check your quest status there anytime.
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 信息 -!^000000
^4d4dff任务日志快捷键为 Alt + U^000000
你随时都可以在那里查看任务状态。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
There are still people in the cabins?!
At least you are safe.
Are you alright?
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
船舱里还有人吗？！
至少你平安无事。
你没受伤吧？

scripts.text: I'm alright, but others need help.
scripts.translation: 我没事，但还有人需要帮助。

scripts.text: I think I am the last?
scripts.translation: 我想...我是最后一个了？

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
There are more people left?
I will send a rescue team to them.
Thank you for your report.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
还有人没出来吗？
我会派救援队去救他们。
谢谢你来报告。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Alright, that's good.
The storm came unexpectedly but I never thought it would hit us that hard.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
那就好。
风暴来得很突然，我没想到它会来得这么猛烈。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
At least most people made it to safety.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
至少大多数人都平安脱险了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Look at the trees there, ^4d4dfffollow them to the southwest^000000 to find a new ship.
The ship will take you to ^4d4dffIzlude^000000, our original destination.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
看那边的树，^4d4dff沿着它们往西南方向走^000000，就能找到一艘新船。
那艘船会带你前往^4d4dff依斯鲁得^000000，也就是我们原本要去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Ah! Speaking of it, those ^4d4dffPorings^000000 on this island drop several materials we could use for repairs.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
对了，说到这个，岛上的那些^4d4dff波利^000000会掉落几种修船用的材料。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
^4d4dffKill the Porings and bring 2 Lumbers to the southern crew^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
^4d4dff击败波利，再把 2 根木材送给南边的船员^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
It is a hard task, but you look tough enough.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
这任务可不轻松，不过看你身手不错，应该能胜任。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Speaking of Porings, you have to equip your gears.
You should have a ^4d4dffweapon and an armor^000000 equipped.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
说到波利，你得先把装备穿戴好。
^4d4dff至少要装备武器和防具^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffYou can equip gear or use items by simply double clicking them.
The item window can be opened by pressing Alt + E or using the menu button.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff双击物品即可装备或使用。
按 Alt + E 或点击菜单按钮可以打开物品窗口。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffEquipped Items can be seen by pressing Alt + Q.
Either double click or drag & drop to equip or unequip them.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff按 Alt + Q 可以查看已装备的物品。
双击或拖放物品即可装备或卸下。^000000

scripts.text:
[Captain Carlock]
Did you check all your equipment?
^4d4dffSkill distribution^000000 should be done.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
装备都检查过了吗？
^4d4dff技能点应该已经分配好了^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carlock]
For a smooth battle, you have to distribute your abilities properly.
^4d4dffIf you want to increase your strength, you need to raise Str^000000. ^4d4dffIf you want to increase your hit, you must raise Dex^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
想要战斗顺利，就得合理分配能力值。
^4d4dff想提升力量，就提高 STR^000000；^4d4dff想提高命中率，就提高 DEX^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
^4d4dffThe Ship^000000 is anchored in the southwest. It will take you to Izlude.
Don't forget to ^4d4dffget some Lumber^000000 for the ship.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
^4d4dff船^000000停泊在西南方，会带你前往依斯鲁得。
别忘了^4d4dff收集一些木材^000000带上船。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Don't forget to raise your ^4d4dffskills^000000.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
别忘了提升你的^4d4dff技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Everything is ready to sail over to Izlude.
The ship is located at the south-western part of the island.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
前往依斯鲁得的准备工作都完成了。
船停在岛屿的西南边。

scripts.text:
! - Information -!
^4d4dffYou get a stats bonus for every level you raise.
The status window can be opened and closed with the shortcut Alt + A^000000.
scripts.translation:
! - 信息 -!
^4d4dff每升一级，你都会获得属性点。
按快捷键 Alt + A 可以打开或关闭属性窗口。^000000

scripts.text:
! - Information -!
^4d4dffPlease properly allocate the stats you need to battle^000000.
scripts.translation:
! - 信息 -!
^4d4dff请合理分配属性点，为战斗做好准备^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Kill Porings and bring the Lumber to the crew.
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
击败波利，把木材交给船员。
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Had a good dream?
Soon, we will get to Izlude. And you can talk to other people like you just talked to me.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
睡得好吗？
我们很快就到依斯鲁得了。到时你也可以像刚才和我交谈那样，跟其他人聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
I think that guy over there lost his memory. I gave him a new name.
Lumin.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
我觉得那边那个人失忆了，所以给他起了个新名字。
卢敏。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Many youngsters visit the ^4d4dffRune-Midgarts Kingdom^000000 to chase their dreams.
Izlude is a satellite city of Prontera, the capital of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
许多年轻人来到^4d4dff卢恩·米德加兹王国^000000追寻梦想。
依斯鲁得是普隆德拉的卫星城，而普隆德拉正是卢恩·米德加兹王国的首都。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Izlude always welcomes young adventurers like you who have just started their journey through the world.
You are one of them, of course.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
依斯鲁得总是欢迎像你这样刚踏上旅途的年轻冒险者。
当然，你也是其中之一。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
I would like to tell you more stories, but it's time to get ready for arrival.
There is an academy in Izlude for newcomers like yourself.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
我还想多给你讲些故事，不过现在该准备靠岸了。
依斯鲁得有一所专为你这样的新人设立的学院。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Let me give you more details later. See you back at the harbor deck.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
之后我再详细告诉你。我们在港口甲板见。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
To get off this ship, you should enter the ^4d4dffShining Portal^000000 over there.
All transportation is made through the portals.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
想离开这艘船，就进入那边的^4d4dff闪耀传送门^000000。
所有交通都要通过传送门。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
嗯。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Oh boy.
What a cute reaction.
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
哎呀。
这反应也太可爱了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.....
Should I introduce myself?
scripts.translation: 要不要自我介绍一下？

scripts.text: My name is ~!
scripts.translation: 我叫~！

scripts.text: - Lu just walked away with a cynical look on his face.
scripts.translation: - 卢一脸不屑地走开了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
Looks like... he has a shy personality.
When you go to Izlude, will you check on him?
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
看来...他性格挺腼腆的。
你到了依斯鲁得后，能去看看他吗？

scripts.text:
[Captain Carocc]
From now on I'll be sailing the ship around the island.
Let's go, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[船长 卡洛克]
从现在起，我要驾船绕岛航行。
我们出发吧？

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
These Porings stole my materials to repair the ship. Can you help me to get them back?
There are plenty of Porings on this island.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
这些波利偷走了我修船用的材料。能帮我把它们找回来吗？
岛上有很多波利。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
I would really appreciate it if you help me.
I am not allowed to set foot on this island.
That's why I ask for your help~
scripts.translation:
[水手]
要是你肯帮忙，我就感激不尽了。
我不能踏上这座岛，
所以才拜托你帮忙~

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Unbelievable, perfect! Any chance you want to join my crew?
Enough talking!!
Come on, we're ready to set sail!
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
太棒了，真是难以置信！你有没有兴趣加入我的船员？
好了，不说了！！
快上船，我们要出发了！
真的非常感谢！

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
If you want to sail with us to Izlude, jump on board!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
想和我们一起去依斯鲁得的话，就上船吧！

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Oh, and take these ^4d4dffMagnifiers^000000.
When you hunt monsters you can find ^4d4dffunidentified items^000000.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
对了，这些^4d4dff放大镜^000000拿去用。
打怪时可能会找到^4d4dff未鉴定的物品^000000。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Using a Magnifier will identify the item.
scripts.translation:
[水手]
使用放大镜就能鉴定物品。

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
Maybe you already have some unidentified items from your fights with those Porings?
scripts.translation:
[水手]
你和那些波利战斗时，应该已经捡到未鉴定的物品了吧？

scripts.text:
[Sailor]
The ship is heading to Izlude soon~!
I'll let you know when we set sail~!
scripts.translation:
[水手]
船很快就要开往依斯鲁得了~！
出发时我会通知你~！

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, {0}!
Why are you here at the wharf?
I guess you are doing well at the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，{0}！
你怎么会在码头？
看来你在学院过得不错。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I'm going to be docking and reparing the ship here for a while.
I will be taking the same route I tried before.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我要在这里停靠一阵子，修理船只。
之后还是走我之前尝试的那条航线。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm? You must be a student of the Criatura Academy?
Were you on my ship?
Hmm I can't remember.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯？你是克里阿图拉学院的学生？
你之前在我的船上吗？
嗯...我想不起来了。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Well, anything is fine.
Shall I go easy on you since you said you were a student of the Academy?
I am still the captain of the ship, regardless.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯，怎样都无所谓。
既然你说自己是学院的学生，我就对你手下留情吧？
不过，我毕竟还是这艘船的船长。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I plan on taking off as soon as the repairs are complete.
The route will open with ^4d4dffPharos Lighthouse^000000 by then.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
船一修好，我就马上出发。
到那时，通往^4d4dff发乐斯灯塔^000000的航线也会开通。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
This is Izlude.
The best city for you to take wings to your dreams.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
这里就是依斯鲁得。
是最适合让你放飞梦想的城市。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Although I don't have any particular feelings for you,
I've seen a lot of young people like you, while operating the ship.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
虽然我跟你没什么特别交情，
但开船这些年，我见过不少像你这样的年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
There were those among them who succeeded and failed and went back after being unable to adjust.
I want you to have a successful start with this place.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
有人成功了，有人失败了，也有人因为无法适应而离开。
希望你能在这里有个顺利的开始。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Did you know this?
Izlude has a new Institute for budding adventurers like you!
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你知道吗？
依斯鲁得新设了一所学院，专门培养像你这样的新手冒险者！

scripts.text: You mean the Academy?
scripts.translation: 你是说那所学院吗？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Yes! It's called the ^4d4dffRoyal Criatura Academy^000000.
Founded by the Rune-Midgarts lineage to help out new adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
没错！它叫^4d4dff皇家克里阿图拉学院^000000。
由卢恩·米德加兹王室创立，专门帮助新手冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
A friend of mine works there, so I'll give you the introduction to him.
He could make a lot of things easier for you.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我有个朋友在学院工作，我可以介绍你们认识。
有他帮忙，你会省事不少。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
He usually talks to new adventurers near the entrance of the academy.
Go and meet him there.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他通常会在学院入口附近接待新冒险者。
去那里找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
I will mark his spot on the map so go to see him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他叫^4d4dff洪^000000。
我会在地图上标出他的位置，你去找他吧。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
The ^4d4dffMini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff小地图在屏幕右上角。
按 + 放大，按 - 缩小。NPC 标记的导航点也会显示在上面。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Received a Quest from ^4d4dffCaptain Carocc.
The quest content can be checked from the quest window.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
已接取^4d4dff船长卡洛克发布的任务。
可以在任务窗口中查看任务内容。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Quest window can be opened by pressing ^4d4dffAlt + u^000000 keys together.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
同时按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000即可打开任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says 'Hun'.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你还不熟悉地图，可以点击这里的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
没错，就是写着“洪”的那一处。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffThe icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff对话中的图标<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>表示可以查看导航指引。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with the navigation help.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
在目标列表中选中任务后，按下信息^4d4dff，
就会显示指向目标地点的箭头和导航指引。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it can help you for your future.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
总之，我的朋友会帮你办理学院入学手续。
希望这能助你一臂之力。

scripts.text: I know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我知道你说的是谁。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then there's no worry.
He'll introduce you to the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那就不用担心了。
他会带你了解学院。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK. I will show you the direction. You try it again.
By the way, did I tell you his name? His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好，我给你指一下方向。你再试试看。
对了，我告诉你他的名字了吗？他叫^4d4dff洪^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Mini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff小地图在屏幕右上角。
按 + 放大，按 - 缩小。NPC 标记的导航点也会显示在上面。^000000

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says [Hun].
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你还不熟悉地图，可以点击这里的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
没错，就是写着[洪]的那一处。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means
a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff对话中的图标 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 表示导航指引链接。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
在目标列表中选择任务后，按下“信息”^4d4dff，
屏幕便会显示指向目标地点的箭头和导航提示。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it will help you out in your journey
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
总之，我的朋友会帮你办理学院注册。
希望这对你的冒险有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you want, you can step forward to the world right away.
However, I recommend you visit the Academy first.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你愿意，现在就能踏上旅程。
不过，我建议你先去学院看看。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
The world is a lonely place to be alone.
The Academy has people you can make as lifetime companions.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
一个人在外闯荡难免孤单。
学院里有许多人，或许会成为你一生的伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
My friend Hun will be around the academy entrance.
If you don't know the way I'll point it out to you again.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的朋友洪会在学院入口附近。
要是你不认得路，我可以再给你指一次。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says ''Hun''.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你还不熟悉地图，可以点击这里的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
没错，就是写着“洪”的那一处。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means
a link to navigation directions.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff对话中的图标 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 表示导航指引链接。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
If you press info after selecting a task in the objectives^4d4dff,
an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
在目标列表中选中任务后，按下“信息”^4d4dff，
屏幕便会显示指向目标地点的箭头和导航提示。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy.
I hope it will help you out in your journey.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
总之，我的朋友会帮你办理学院注册。
希望这对你的冒险有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, {0}!
Still being dilligent?
I've been busy, also.
I was reparing the ship.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，{0}！
还这么勤奋啊？
我也忙得很，
一直在修船。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I'll be taking off as soon as the repairs are complete.
At that time, the sailing route to ^4d4dffPharos lighthouse ^000000will be opened.
Be excited for it.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
船修好后我就马上出发。
届时，前往^4d4dff发乐斯灯塔^000000的航线就会开通。
敬请期待吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hello?
Is it your first time on Izlude?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你好？
你是第一次来依斯鲁得吗？

scripts.text: Hello?
scripts.translation: 你好？

scripts.text: Let me get on the ship!
scripts.translation: 让我上船！

scripts.text: I don't know what to do.
scripts.translation: 我不知道该怎么办。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
You look strong and able!
I like able people like you!
Always be healthy and strong as you are now.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
你看起来身强体壮，也很能干！
我喜欢你这样能干的人！
要一直保持健康强壮啊。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I usually travel to ^4d4dffPharos Lighthouse^000000.
But I'm resting up due to some problems.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我平时会去^4d4dff发乐斯灯塔^000000。
不过最近出了点问题，暂时在这里休息。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If it's Alberta or Byalan Island, talk to the next sailor.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你要去艾尔贝塔或拜兰岛，请找下一位水手。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm? You said you didn't know what to do.
Since you're at Izlude, why don't you visit ^4d4dffCriatura Academy^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯？你说不知道该做什么。
既然来到依斯鲁得，何不去^4d4dff克里阿图拉学院^000000看看？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Izlude has the Institute for budding adventurers like you
A friend of mine works there, so I'll give you the introduction to him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
依斯鲁得有一所专门培养新手冒险者的学院。
我有个朋友在那里工作，可以介绍你们认识。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
He ususally talks to new adventurers near the entrance of an academy.
Go and meet him personally.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他通常会在学院入口附近接待新冒险者。
亲自去见见他吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
I will mark his location on the map so go to see him.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
他叫^4d4dff洪^000000。
我会在地图上标出他的位置，你去找他吧。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Mini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff小地图位于屏幕右上角。
按 + 放大，按 - 缩小。NPC 标记的导航点也会显示在上面。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Received a Quest from ^4d4dffCaptain Carocc.
Contents of your Quest can be monitored on the Quest information window.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
已接取^4d4dff船长卡洛克发布的任务。
可以在任务信息窗口中查看任务内容。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Quest window can be opened by pressing the ^4d4dffAlt + u^000000 key.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
按下^4d4dffAlt + U^000000即可打开任务窗口。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says [Hun].
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你还不熟悉地图，可以点击这里的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
没错，就是写着[洪]的那一处。

!- Information -!
^4d4dff the icon during talk <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> means

scripts.translation:

^4d4dff对话中的图标 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 表示导航指引链接。

an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
在目标列表中选中任务后，按下“信息”^4d4dff，
屏幕便会显示指向目标地点的箭头和导航提示。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it will help you out in your journey
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
总之，我的朋友会帮你办理学院注册。
希望这对你的冒险有所帮助。

scripts.text: I know who you're talking about.
scripts.translation: 我知道你说的是谁。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then there's no worry.
He'll introduce you to the academy.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那就放心了。
他会带你了解学院。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK. I will show you the direction. You try it again.
By the way, did I tell you his name? His name is ^4d4dffHun^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好，我给你指一下方向，你再试试看。
对了，我告诉你他的名字了吗？他叫^4d4dff洪^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Mini map can be seen on the right top of the screen.
You can zoom in with +, zoom out with -. The waypoint from the NPC will be marked on it. ^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff小地图位于屏幕右上角。
按 + 放大，按 - 缩小。NPC 标记的导航点也会显示在上面。^000000

[Carocc]
If you need more help with the map, press <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> here
Yes, the part that says [Hun].
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你还不熟悉地图，可以点击这里的<NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI>。
没错，就是写着[洪]的那一处。

scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff对话中的图标 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 表示导航指引链接。

an arrow pointing to the location of the objective will pop up along with navigation help
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
在目标列表中选中任务后，按下“信息”^4d4dff，
屏幕便会显示指向目标地点的箭头和导航提示。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Anyway, my friend will help you register with the academy
I hope it will help you out in your journey
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
总之，我的朋友会帮你办理学院注册。
希望这对你的冒险有所帮助。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Ah, it's you.
This guy has also decided to register at Criatura Academy.
This might be a good destiny for you. Hope you and him can be good friends.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
啊，是你。
这位也决定去克里阿图拉学院注册了。
说不定这是缘分呢。希望你们能成为好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
If you want, you can step forward to the world right away.
However, I recommend you visit the Academy first.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
如果你愿意，现在就能踏上旅程。
不过，我建议你先去学院看看。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
The world is a lonely place to be alone.
The Academy has people you could make into lifetime companions.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
一个人在外闯荡难免孤单。
学院里有许多人，或许会成为你一生的伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
My friend <NAVI>[Hun]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> will be around the academy entrance.
If you don't know the way I'll point it out to you again.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我的朋友 <NAVI>[洪]<INFO>izlude,122,207</INFO></NAVI> 会在学院入口附近。
要是不认得路，我可以再给你指一次。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
then, Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那么，祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Oh, We meet again.
Do you by any chance need a ship?
I usually travel to the port in Paros.
If you need to go to Paros later, come see me.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
哦，又见面了。
你是需要搭船吗？
我平时会去帕罗斯港。
以后要是想去帕罗斯，就来找我。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
It's been a while!
Looking at your expression, you must be doing well.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好久不见！
看你的神情，最近过得不错吧。

scripts.text: Take me to Pharos Lighthouse
scripts.translation: 前往发乐斯灯塔

scripts.text: To Alberta
scripts.translation: 前往艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Do you want to go to Pharos Lighthouse on the southern coast of Morocc?
The fee is 2800 zeny. I have a crew that needs payment so this fee is non-negotiable.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
要去摩洛克南岸的发乐斯灯塔吗？
船费是 2800 Zeny。我得付船员薪水，费用可不能讨价还价。

scripts.text: To Pharos Lighthouse!
scripts.translation: 去发乐斯灯塔！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Let us travel with the wing in our hair.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
让我们迎风启航吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Sorry but you are short of the boarding fee.
I need 2800z to operate.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
抱歉，你的船费不够。
运营这艘船需要 2800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
OK.
Do you know this, by the way?
^4d4dffThere's a Rogue hideout at Pharos Lighthouse^000000.
You already knew this?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
好。
对了，你知道吗？
^4d4dff发乐斯灯塔有盗贼的藏身处^000000。
你早就知道了？

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I thought you knew that I only go to Pharos?
Ask the sailor over there, he's the one that goes there frequently.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我还以为你知道我只去发乐斯灯塔呢？
去问问那边的水手吧，他经常去那里。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
There are plenty of other ships that travel to Alberta and Byalan Islands.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
还有很多船会开往艾尔贝塔和拜兰岛。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Hmm. I'm content with the well being of you and other adventurers who passed me by.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
嗯。看到你和其他曾与我同行的冒险者都平安无事，我就放心了。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Lumin must be doing well too.
I wonder why you feel like my own child even though we've only met from the sea.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
卢敏应该也过得不错吧。
我们明明只在海上见过，却不知为何让我觉得你像自己的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
I am Carocc, the caption of this ship.
Do you need a ship?
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
我是卡洛克，这艘船的船长。
你需要搭船吗？

scripts.text: Pharos Lighthouse - 2800z
scripts.translation: 发乐斯灯塔 - 2800 Zeny

scripts.text: Don't need it.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Let us travel with the wind in our hair.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
让我们迎风启航吧。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Sorry but you are short of the boarding fee.
I need 2800z to operate.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
抱歉，你的船费不够。
运营这艘船需要 2800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Carocc]
Then use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[卡洛克]
那就下次再来吧。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Continue the quest after organizing the inventory.
scripts.translation:
背包已满，无法继续任务。
整理好背包后再继续吧。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Oh.. you must be the adventurer Carocc was talking about.
I don't know where your homeland is but Midgard is a good place to start your life's journey.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
哦...你就是卡洛克提到的那位冒险者吧。
我不知道你的故乡在哪里，不过米德加尔特很适合作为人生旅程的起点。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
It's a good sight to see new adventurers start their journey.
You must be tired. Need a drink?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
看到新冒险者踏上旅程，真让人高兴。
你一定累了吧？要喝点什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Hun]
You can open the Item window by clicking on the 'item' icon on top left portion of the screen.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
点击屏幕左上角的“物品”图标，就能打开物品窗口。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
The items are automatically catagorized by 'consumables' 'equipment' 'etcetera' and 'personal' suitable for each use.
It will do the automatic sorting per indiviaul useage to
scripts.translation:
[洪]
物品会根据用途自动分为“消耗品”“装备”“其他”和“个人”类别。
系统还会按照各类物品的用途自动排序...

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Either ^4d4dffdouble click on the item^000000 you intend to use
or drag it onto^4d4dff the equipment window and use it^000000
scripts.translation:
[洪]
^4d4dff双击要使用的物品^000000，
或者将其拖到^4d4dff装备窗口中使用或装备^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffItems can be used or equipped with simply double-clicking.
Item window can be opened with shortcut key Alt+E
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff双击物品即可使用或装备。
按 Alt + E 可以打开物品窗口。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff Equipped items can be checked with Alt+ Q
Items can also be dragged onto the location where you wish to equip it.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff按 Alt + Q 可以查看已装备的物品。
也可以将物品拖到想要装备的位置。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
For detailed info on individual items^4d4dff, right click ^000000on that item.
You can check the detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
要查看物品的详细信息，^4d4dff右键点击^000000该物品即可。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffRight-clicking on the item icon^4d4dff  brings up detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff右键点击物品图标^4d4dff，即可查看物品的详细信息。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffWhen you select other players, you can trade, party up with them with the community window that pops up.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff选中其他玩家后，会弹出社交窗口，你可以通过它与对方交易或组队。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Ok now ^4d4dffdrink the apple juice that I gave you^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
好了，现在^4d4dff把我给你的苹果汁喝掉吧^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Hey there.
Rest up for a bit.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
你好啊。
先休息一会儿吧。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
It's joyous to see new adventurers starting out.
You want something to drink while you are resting?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
看到新冒险者踏上旅程，真让人高兴。
休息时想喝点什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Right clicking on the item icon ^4d4dffon the basic item window at the upper left corner brings up the detailed info on the item
scripts.translation:
[洪]
在左上角的基础物品窗口中，右键点击物品图标^4d4dff，即可查看物品的详细信息。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
The items are automatically catagorized by 'consumables' 'equipment' 'etcetera' and 'personal' suitable for each use.
It will do the automatic sorting per indiviaul useage to
scripts.translation:
[洪]
物品会根据用途自动分为“消耗品”“装备”“其他”和“个人”类别。
系统还会按照各类物品的用途自动排序...

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Either ^4d4dffdouble click on the item^000000 you intend to use
or drag it onto^4d4dff the equipment window and use it^000000
scripts.translation:
[洪]
^4d4dff双击要使用的物品^000000，
或者将物品拖到^4d4dff装备窗口中使用或装备^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
For detailed info on individual items^4d4dff, right-click ^000000on the item.
You can check the detailed info on the item.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
要查看单件物品的详细信息，^4d4dff请右键点击^000000该物品。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
Right clicking on the item icon ^4d4dffbrings up the detailed info on the item
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff右键点击物品图标即可查看详细信息。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
When you select on other players^4d4dff you can trade, party up with them with the community window that pops up.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
选中其他玩家后，^4d4dff会弹出社交窗口，你可以与对方交易或组队。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Ok now ^4d4dffdrink the apple juice that I gave you^000000.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
好了，现在^4d4dff把我给你的苹果汁喝掉吧^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Consume the apple juice that I gave you in your inventory.
Then we'll talk.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
打开背包，喝掉我给你的苹果汁。
然后我们再聊。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
How's the taste?
Pretty good-taste of sweet and sour, right? It might not be much but it also has healing properties.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
味道怎么样？
酸酸甜甜的，很不错吧？虽然不多，但也有恢复效果。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
I want to give you more but that was the last of it
Anyways here's some potions. They'll come in handy when you start fighting.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我还想多给你一些，可那已经是最后一瓶了。
总之，这里有些药水，开始战斗后会派上用场。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Criatura Academy is a good place to build up experience for the future.
And I'm not just saying this because I work here.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
克里阿图拉学院很适合为未来积累经验。
我可不是因为在这里工作才这么说的。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
I'm for real... haha
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我说真的...哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
How's the taste?
Pretty good-taste of sweet and sour, right? It might not be much but it also has healing properties.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
味道怎么样？
酸酸甜甜的，很不错吧？虽然不多，但也有恢复效果。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
I want to give you more but that was the last of it
Anyways here's some potions. They'll come in handy when you start fighting.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我还想多给你一些，可那已经是最后一瓶了。
总之，这里有些药水，开始战斗后会派上用场。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
What do you plan to do from now on?
Have you found a place to stay?
scripts.translation:
[洪]
接下来你打算做什么？
找到住的地方了吗？

scripts.text: I need help with that
scripts.translation: 这方面我需要帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
For real... hahahaha
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我说真的...哈哈哈。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[洪]
皇家克里阿图拉学院旨在帮助初出茅庐的冒险者迈出旅程的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Hun]
Although I'm but a work-hand here, it makes me happy to see students graduate here and become fine members of society.
scripts.translation:
[洪]
我虽然只是这里的工作人员，但看到学生毕业后成为社会栋梁，还是很高兴的。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the invenory being full.
Please try it again after re-organizing your items.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
背包已满，无法继续任务。
整理好物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Hi, how are you?
I am in charge of navigation directions for Izlude's key locations
I wish to propose a simple game along with the navigation, would that be ok?
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
你好，最近怎么样？
我负责依斯鲁得主要地点的导航指引。
我想结合导航带你玩个小游戏，可以吗？

scripts.text: Sure, let's play!
scripts.translation: 好啊，来玩吧！

scripts.text: I already know them all.
scripts.translation: 我都知道了。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
First of all, how to check the mini-map.
You can check your location through the mini-map at the top right of the screen
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
先来看看怎么查看小地图。
你可以通过屏幕右上角的小地图确认自己的位置。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
If you receive information on a town or a city, a waypoint ^4d4dff+^000000 can be marked on the map.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
获得城镇或城市的相关信息后，地图上就能标出导航点^4d4dff+^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Press ^4d4dff[Ctrl] and [ ~ ] on your keyboard and you can see the world map^000000.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
同时按下键盘上的^4d4dff[Ctrl]和[ ~ ]，就能查看世界地图^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Through the ^4d4dffworld map you can check the location of you, your party members and the level of monsters in the area.^000000
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
通过^4d4dff世界地图，可以查看自己和队友的位置，以及所在区域的魔物等级。^000000

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
This is useful info to remember.
Now then, should we play a simple game?
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
记住这些信息会很有用。
那么，我们来玩个小游戏吧？

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
I will ^4d4dffmark three specific locations on the mini-map.^000000
Please ^4d4dffvisit those locations ^000000using the waypoints as reference.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
我会在小地图上^4d4dff标出三个指定地点^000000。
请参考导航点，^4d4dff前往这些地点^000000。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Think of it as a treasure hunt and go.
I've hidden some useful items there.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
把它当成寻宝游戏，出发吧！
我在那些地方藏了一些实用物品。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Vist me again after going by all three locations.
I will check up on it.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
三个地点都跑过一遍后，再回来找我。
我会确认你的进度。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Ah, there' somebody who started out right before you!
If you don't hurry that person will take all the items!
So, run!
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
啊，有人比你早一步出发了！
不快点的话，东西就要被他全拿走了！
快跑吧！

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
Do you need information on all the locations of Izlude?
By clicking on the introduced ^B9062F[base camp name]^000000, I will offer you guidance so follow the ^B9062FRed Arrows^000000.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]
想了解依斯鲁得的所有地点吗？
点击介绍中的^B9062F[基地名称]^000000后，我会为你指路。跟着^B9062F红色箭头^000000走就行。

scripts.text:
[Information Staff]
What's with the long face?
It looks like you found all the locations I marked.
scripts.translation:
[咨询人员]

看来你已经找到我标出的所有地点了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Turtle...
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
乌龟...

scripts.text: What'd you call me?
scripts.translation: 你刚才叫我什么？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Because you are too slow.
Yes, it is. I have been waiting for you for what seems like forever.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
因为你太慢了。
没错，我等你都快等了一辈子了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.......Shall I share with you?
scripts.translation:

==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 信息 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城就在北边。

scripts.text: Except for the simple signboard, nothing can be found here.
scripts.translation: 除了这块简易告示牌，什么也没找到。

scripts.text: Where's the treasure?
scripts.translation: 宝藏藏在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Yo.
Sorry but I am quicker than you.
There were Fly Wings here..
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
哟。
抱歉，我比你快了一步。
这里本来有苍蝇翅膀...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
In fact, I don't like Fly's wings.
Flies are so dirty.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
说真的，我不喜欢苍蝇翅膀。
苍蝇太脏了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
By the way, why is one of the convenient transportations fly wing shaped?
Perhaps you know?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
对了，为什么有一种方便的交通道具长得像苍蝇翅膀？
你知道原因吗？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
...you don't know.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...你不知道啊。

scripts.text:
Defeated by Lumin again.
Keep calm and find the next location.
scripts.translation:
又输给卢敏了。
冷静下来，继续找下一个地点吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
...Hello
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...你好。

scripts.text: Are you kidding me?!
scripts.translation: 你在开玩笑吧？！

scripts.text: Where's the treasure?
scripts.translation: 宝藏在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
No...
Meeting three times in one day must be destiny.
You and I can be friends.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
不会吧...
一天之内遇见三次，一定是命运安排的。
我们可以做朋友。

scripts.text: Or Frenemies!
scripts.translation: 或者做欢喜冤家！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Frene-what? Oh well I'm done with the mission.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
欢喜冤家？那是什么？算了，我的任务完成了。
保重。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you even listening to me?!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你到底有没有在听我说话？！

scripts.text: ^4d4dff...I have to report the result to the Information Staff...^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff...我得向咨询人员汇报结果...^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Fly Wings.
If I hand them over to you, you'll just waste 'em so I think I'll keep them.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
苍蝇翅膀啊。
给你也是浪费，我还是自己留着吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Come on this is just friendly competition.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
拜托，这不过是场友谊赛。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I am doing this for you to make you stronger.
Now, so long.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我这么做是为了让你变得更强。
就这样，回头见。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff...I have to report of the result to Information staff...^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff...我得向咨询人员汇报结果...^000000。

scripts.text: Except for the simple signboard, nothing can be found.
scripts.translation: 除了这块简易告示牌，什么也没找到。

scripts.text: Why is there nothing?
scripts.translation: 这里怎么什么都没有？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Of course.
Fly's wings were here so I already packed them in my bag.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
当然有啊。
这里有苍蝇翅膀，我已经全装进包里了。

scripts.text: So can I have some?
scripts.translation: 那能分我一些吗？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
That's not fair, I was here first so they're mine.
You better get to the next stop faster if you want the prize.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
这不公平，是我先到的，所以东西归我。
想拿到奖品，就快点赶到下一站吧。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Well, then.....
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
那就...

scripts.text:
Lumin disappeared with his long hair in the air.
This guy....
scripts.translation:
卢敏长发飘扬，消失在远处。
这家伙...

scripts.text:
==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 信息 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城就在北边。

scripts.text:
==== Information ====
Prontera Field.
The city of Prontera is located to the north.
scripts.translation:
==== 信息 ====
普隆德拉野外。
普隆德拉城就在北边。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包已满，无法继续任务。
整理好物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Are you a student?
Do you have any problem in your body?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你是学院的学生吗？
身体有什么不舒服吗？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This is the dispensary of the Royal Criatura Academy.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
这里是皇家克里阿图拉学院的医务室。
有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Are you injured?
Even the emergency treatment didn't work for you?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你受伤了吗？
连紧急治疗也没能治好你吗？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Is that good enough?
Have you recovered?
If you are sane, go to bed and rest before you go.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
这样可以了吗？
恢复了吗？
没事的话，出发前先上床休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I feel sorry for you but...
I can only give my free healing service to those under base level 20.
You don't look like you're going to die anyways.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
我也很同情你，不过...
免费治疗只提供给基础等级未满 20 级的人。
而且你看起来也不像命在旦夕。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Just take a rest here until you've recovered.
There are lots of vacant beds!
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
就在这里好好休息，直到恢复为止。
还有很多空床位呢！

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You already know about First Aid.
We both are busy. Don't bother me.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你已经学会紧急治疗了。
大家都很忙，别来打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You are commendable!
First Aid is a skill that transfers SP to HP during emergency situations.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
做得不错！
紧急治疗是在危急时将 SP 转换为 HP 的技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Recovery ratio is very minimal...
It can help you avoid dying but won't give you much HP.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
恢复量非常有限...
虽然能帮你保住性命，但回复不了多少 HP。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Press ^4d4dffALT + S^000000 to open your Skill window to see your skills.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
按下^4d4dffALT + S^000000打开技能窗口，就能查看已学会的技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
If you press ^4d4dffF12^000000...
The shortcut window will open up with nine small compartments to register your skills to.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
按下^4d4dffF12^000000...
就会打开快捷栏窗口，里面有九个栏位可以登记技能。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Dragging the right hand corner at the shortcut window, you can open up more skill shortcut pages.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
拖动快捷栏窗口的右下角，就能展开更多技能快捷栏页面。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
It is a simple use.. ^4d4dffEach slot responds to individual keys from F1 to F9^000000.
Needed skills or items can be immediately used after registering on the corresponding slots.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
用法很简单。^4d4dff每个栏位分别对应 F1 到 F9^000000。
将需要的技能或物品登记到对应栏位后，就能快速使用。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
You can register needed items or skills at ^4d4dffshortcut slots by dragging the icons.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
将需要的物品或技能图标拖到^4d4dff快捷栏位即可登记。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dff The registered items and equipment at^4d4dff the slots can be immediately used or armed by pressing the reponding F1 - F9 keys.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff登记在栏位中的物品和装备^4d4dff，按下对应的 F1 至 F9 键即可使用或装备。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
By setting the ^4d4dffshortcut keys as you want, you can use the responding shortcut key.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
你可以按自己的喜好设置^4d4dff快捷键，之后按下对应按键即可使用。

scripts.text:
!- Information -!
^4d4dffyou may register the frequently using items and skills, and use them at your convenience.
scripts.translation:
!- 信息 -!
^4d4dff你可以登记常用的物品和技能，使用起来更方便。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Now open the skill window and register [First Aid] as shortcut key, then use it.
You will find it is more covenient to use this way.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
现在打开技能窗口，把[紧急治疗]设为快捷技能，然后使用它。
这样操作是不是方便多了？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Have you investigated the growing plants in the field?
^4d4dff Red Plant, Blue Plant, Green Plant, White Plant^000000etc..
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
你调查过野外生长的植物吗？
^4d4dff红草、蓝草、绿草、白草^000000等等。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You can get different colored herbs from the various plants.
Processing herbs turns to be a various useful potions.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
不同的植物会产出不同颜色的药草。
加工药草还能制成各种有用的药水。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Now, shall we collect the Red Herb with your hands?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
现在要亲手采一株红色药草吗？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
A ^4d4dffRed Plant is growing near the academy building.^000000.
I secretly planted it for today.
Go and get ^4d4dff1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
^4d4dff学院建筑附近长着一株红草。^000000
我特意为今天种下了它。
去采集^4d4dff 1 株红色药草^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You got it.
^4d4dffYou could eat this herb and get the benefit of it immediately but it will be more efficient if you make it into a potion.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
拿到了。
^4d4dff直接吃掉药草就能立即获得效果，不过把它制成药水会更有效。^000000

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Herbs vary their virtues according to their color.
^4d4dffGreen Herbs^000000 detox you.
^4d4dffBlue Herbs^000000 recover your SP.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
不同颜色的药草有不同功效。
^4d4dff绿色药草^000000可以解毒。
^4d4dff蓝色药草^000000可以恢复 SP。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Any other?
Well, HP is recovering like this red herb.
This like this... Make a nectar and put it into a bottle....
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
还想知道别的吗？
嗯，红色药草可以恢复 HP。
像这样...把药草制成药液，再装进瓶子里...

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This becomes the recovering potion possible to take anywhere, anytime.
I will give it to you as souvenir.
And also give you the recipe to make potions easily.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
这样就能制成随时随地都可以使用的恢复药水。
我送你一瓶留作纪念。
再给你一份简单的药水制作配方。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
This is the book for the simple combination of potion use.
You can make it easily by ^4d4dffusing the combination kit or cooking tool^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
这是一本介绍简单药水合成方法的手册。
使用^4d4dff组合专用工具或烹饪工具^000000就能轻松制作。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Not only potions but also other easily attainable things can be turned to various tools. Please make use of them.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
除了药水，许多容易取得的材料也能制成各种工具。记得善加利用。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
For your trial to make it, I gave you a Red Herb and one Apple,
How about making it with the combination kit?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
为了让你试着制作，我给了你一株红色药草和一个苹果。
要不要用组合专用工具试着做做看？

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Read the combination kit by ^4d4dffright-clicking^000000, and ^4d4dffclick the book shaped icon^000000 which will open up the explanation window.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
^4d4dff右键点击^000000组合专用工具，再^4d4dff点击书本形状的图标^000000，说明窗口就会打开。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Why don't you learn about the virtues of herbs?
Bring one Red Herb by beating the growing Red Herb near the academy building.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
想了解药草的功效吗？
去击败学院建筑附近的红草，带回一株红色药草吧。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
You can find it near the entrance of the academy.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
在学院入口附近就能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I already let you know about the basic medical botany.
By the way, there is something called a ^4d4dffShining Plant^000000 here on Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
基础的药用植物知识我已经告诉你了。
对了，米德加尔特还有一种叫^4d4dff光芒草^000000的植物。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
Nobody knows which herb comes out from this plant.
Once I got the fruit of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
没人知道它会长出什么药草。
我以前还得到过天地树果实呢。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
And, in the Alberta merchant guild, there is an old man making potions.
You can ask him for help.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
艾尔贝塔的商人公会里有位老人会制作药水。
你可以去找他帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
^4d4dffAlchemist^000000 or ^4d4dffBiochemist^000000 or the higher class job ^4d4dffGeneticist^000000 are all good at creating potions.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
^4d4dff炼金术士^000000、^4d4dff生物化学家^000000，以及更高阶的职业^4d4dff基因学家^000000都擅长制作药水。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
If you want to have a well-made potion, it may be a good idea to ask for a specialist.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
想做出品质上乘的药水，找专家帮忙会比较好。

scripts.text:
[Therapist]
I see...
For emergency situations, in case you've fainted and want to be brought back here, I will save your current location.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师]
我知道了...
为了以防万一，如果你昏倒后想回到这里，我可以替你记录当前位置。

scripts.text:
Your inventory is too full so you can't continue this quest.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包太满，无法继续任务。
整理好物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Hey there Turtle
You are really slow.
This Red Plant is no longer useful for you.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
嘿，乌龟！
你也太慢了吧。
这株红草对你已经没用了。

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text: Who're you?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You heard me.
Aren't you here to collect the Red Plant for the Academy Therapist.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我说得还不够清楚吗？
你不是来替学院的治疗师采红草的吗？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
But, But something weird just happened.
It happened right before my eyes.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
可是、可是刚才发生了件怪事。
那一幕我可是亲眼看见的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Did you lose your memory?
If the captain hears about it, he'll cry.
It is still ok as long as I remember you.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
你失忆了吗？
要是船长听说了，肯定会哭的。
不过，只要我还记得你就行。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Lumin.
.......
How about being happy?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
卢敏。
...
开心点怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Anyway, let me explain it to you, I have just cut all the leaves of this Red Plant.
You can't collect the Red Plant anymore.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
总之，我解释给你听：我刚把这株红草的叶子全剪掉了。
现在你没法再采它了。

scripts.text: Ok so give me a ^ff0000Red Herb^000000
scripts.translation: 那就给我一株^ff0000红色药草^000000

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
OK... then...
I don't even need it anyways. I already know all about basic medical botany.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
好吧...那就...
反正我也不需要。我已经学会所有基础药用植物知识了。

scripts.text: Then, why did you do it?
scripts.translation: 那你为什么要这么做？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I didn't do it!
I was just standing here.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
不是我干的！
我刚才只是站在这里。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Here take this Red Herb.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
来，拿着这株红色药草。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Ah... see it's growing back.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
啊...你看，它又长出来了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I guess you should go back to the Therapist.
He's probably waiting for you..
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我想你该回去找治疗师了。
他应该还在等你呢...

scripts.text:
He seems to think of something deeply.
Disregard it.
scripts.translation:
他似乎在认真思考。
先别打扰他。

scripts.text:
[Criatura Student]
.......
scripts.translation:
[克里亚图拉学院学生]
...

scripts.text: This student looks familiar...
scripts.translation: 这个学生看起来有点眼熟...

scripts.text:
[Criatura Student]
.......
scripts.translation:
[克里亚图拉学院学生]
...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
snoring... snoring...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
呼噜...呼噜...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
snoring... snoring...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
呼噜...呼噜...

scripts.text:
- A man is lying here
- he's barely breathing.
scripts.translation:
- 这里躺着一个男人。
- 他呼吸微弱。

scripts.text: - Is this maybe...?!
scripts.translation: - 这难道是...？！

scripts.text:
- an accident...
- yes, this is a murder!
- There's a murderer here!
scripts.translation:
- 是意外...
- 不对，这是谋杀！
- 这里有凶手！

scripts.text:
- I swear on some old person's grave
- I will solve this case!
scripts.translation:
- 我对着某位老人的坟墓发誓
- 一定会侦破此案！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Yawn. Who are you making so much noise next to me...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
哈啊。谁在我旁边吵吵嚷嚷的...

scripts.text: You aren't dead?
scripts.translation: 你没死？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Dead?! Who....?
me? Pu ha ha ha!!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
死了？！谁...？
我吗？噗哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Sorry for laughing. Ha ha ha!
I was just taking a nap because the weather is good.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
抱歉，我笑了。哈哈哈！
天气这么好，我只是打了个盹。

scripts.text: But you weren't breathing...
scripts.translation: 可是你刚才都没呼吸...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Ahh...... that?
Right it makes sense that you misunderstood.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
啊...那个啊？
这么说来，难怪你会误会。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I used the skill<^ff0000Play Dead^000000> because I didn't want to be disturbed by monsters or someone else.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我用了<^ff0000装死^000000>技能，这样魔物或其他人就不会来打扰我。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I never thought someone would think of me as an actual dead body.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我还真没想到会有人把我当成尸体。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Oh, I see... you are a new novice who just has arrived here?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
哦，原来如此...你是刚到这里的初心者吧？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I guess it is unexpected and surprising but do you want to learn <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
这确实有点出乎意料。你想学<^ff0000装死^000000>吗？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I am sure that it will help you. How do you think about it?
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我保证这技能对你有帮助。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: I am sorry but I am busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我现在有事。

scripts.text: I want to learn it!
scripts.translation: 我想学！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Really ? If you are busy then fine by me.
I should keep sleeping.
yawning...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
真的？你要是忙的话，那就算了。
我还是继续睡吧。
打哈欠...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
You made a right decision!
I want to teach you for good.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
你做了个明智的决定！
我一定会好好教你的。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
A novice does not know the potential power of himself nor how strong the enemy is.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
初心者往往不了解自己的潜力，也不清楚敌人有多强。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
There is a studious type of novice who studies well..but i guess we are not.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
有些初心者很爱钻研...不过我想我们都不是那种人。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Just take prompt action.
And sometimes you'll be defeated by stong enemies...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
遇到状况就果断行动。
不过，有时也会被强敌打败...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Huh? You're right this is my story.
I was getting sick of being defeated.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
嗯？你说得没错，这说的就是我。
我都快受够一次次被打败了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
One day, a good idea came to my mind. If I pretend to be dead when I find a strong enemy...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
有一天，我灵机一动：遇到强敌时，干脆假装自己已经死了...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I was faced with the risk of death, because I was not good at pretending to be dead.
Even when I look back at that time. it is still thrilling...
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
因为我不擅长装死，好几次都险些丧命。
现在回想起来，还是让人心惊胆战...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
let's continue to talk
So ever since then, Playing Dead started working out for me!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
接着说吧。
从那以后，我的装死战术就越来越管用了！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
And then...
I could not hold a breath for a long time.
That was a problem!
Clever monsters were checking out my breath!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
后来...
我没法长时间屏住呼吸。
这可麻烦了！
机灵的魔物会察觉到我的呼吸！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
So I had to train myself to hold my breath for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
所以我只好训练自己，尽可能长时间地屏住呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Sounds complicated.. but it is quite simple.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
听起来很复杂...其实很简单。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
If you feel like you can not beat the enemy, when a strong one appears, just fall down on the ground and pretend to be dead.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
如果遇到强敌，觉得自己打不过，就倒在地上装死吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I will put you on a brief test whether you hold you breathe or not.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我来简单测试一下你能不能屏住呼吸。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Hold a breath for 20 seconds, then talk to me later. I won't admit you if you talk to me before that time is over!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
屏住呼吸 20 秒，之后再来找我。在时间到之前来找我的话，我可不会让你通过！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Start!
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
开始！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
What? You aren't able to hold your breath for even 20 seconds?
You can't learn this skill until you are able to hold it!
scripts.translation:
[教官 阿戈斯]
什么？你连20秒都撑不住？
你得先学会屏住呼吸，才能学这招！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
Hold breath for 20 seconds again!
Then talk to me.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
再屏住呼吸 20 秒！
然后再来找我。

scripts.text: - Learned the <^ff0000Play Dead^000000>skill.

[Instructor Argos]
Okay, good job.
If you have strong patience like that, it will save you. There will be no monsters that can hurt you.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
很好，干得不错。
只要有这样的耐心，就能在危急时救自己一命，让魔物拿你没办法。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
The <^ff0000Play Dead^000000> skill is in your skill list which you can open by pressing <Alt + S>, Please do not forget to use it, it will save you when you are in a danger.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
<^ff0000装死^000000>技能已加入技能列表，按<Alt + S>即可打开。遇到危险时别忘了使用，它能救你一命。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
If you grow up and get another job, then you do not need this skill so do not spare it! Wse it when you need to and don't hesitate.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
等你成长并转职后，就用不上这技能了。需要时尽管用，别犹豫！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Argos]
I need to get some sleep, do not wake me up. Yawn.
scripts.translation:
[指导员 阿尔戈斯]
我得睡一会儿，别吵醒我。哈啊...

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
Hello, {0}.
How are you today?
I am in charge guiding you here in the Academy.
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
你好，{0}。
今天过得怎么样？
我负责带你熟悉学院。

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
Welcome to our Academy. I am in charge with the guide and registration for Novice education courses.
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
欢迎来到学院。我负责指引初心者教育课程，并为学员办理报名。

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: - As you are overloaded with too many items, quest can't be continued.-
scripts.translation: - 背包里的物品太多，无法继续任务。-

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
Let me see... Your name is... {0}.
I will make a new registration for you.
You can choose the course freely and each course has individual features.
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
我看看...你的名字是...{0}。
我来帮你重新登记。
你可以自由选择课程，每门课程都有各自的特色。

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
And this is the basic equipment for the educational course.
Please make a good use of it.
Be careful with it as it won't be provided again.
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
这是教育课程的基础装备，请好好使用。
要小心保管，之后不会再次发放。

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
It is your first step to be an adventurer that you have made a visit to us.
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
来这里拜访，就是你成为冒险者的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
On our next meeting, I anticipate you will grow up a bit more.
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
希望下次见面时，你已经又成长了一些。

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
One who is not a Novice can't attend the educational course.
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
非初心者不能参加教育课程。

scripts.text:
[Receptionist]
However, a part of the educational course except the character cultivation can be freely attended. So, you may look around the Academy and neighboring places.
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
不过，除了角色培养之外，其他教育课程都可以自由参加。你可以去学院和附近转转。

一楼有指导员，会为你讲解米德加尔特的世界和基础知识。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

首先，在医务室可以学习如何恢复体力，以及治疗 HP 的技能。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

在武器库可以接受基础训练，学习如何在米德加尔特与魔物战斗。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

在餐厅可以练习烹饪，并了解烹饪的各种好处。

scripts.text:

At the 2nd floor, there are trainers that will teach you about the different job classes in the world.
scripts.translation:

二楼有职业导师，会为你介绍这个世界的各种职业。

scripts.text:

Listen to the trainers and decide for yourself which job suits your personal style.
scripts.translation:

听听导师们的介绍，再选择最适合自己风格的职业吧。

scripts.text:

This town is called 'Izlude' the satellite and port city of the Capital City of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom Prontera.
scripts.translation:

这里叫依斯鲁得，是卢恩·米德加兹王国首都普隆德拉的卫星城和港口城市。

scripts.text:

This town was re-organized to suit the education of Novices.
scripts.translation:
[接待员]
这座城镇经过重新规划，方便初心者在此接受教育。

scripts.translation:

还有其他需要的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Ha ah....
What should I do with this lunchbox?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哈啊...
这个便当盒该怎么办呢？

scripts.text:
- Here, just moment!! -
- As you are overloaded with too many items in your inventory -
- You can't receive the items anymore -
- Let yourself enlightened -
- and please try again -
scripts.translation:
- 喂，稍等一下！！
- 你的背包物品太多了
- 已经无法再领取物品
- 请先整理一下背包
- 然后再试一次 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Are you ready to learn about abnormal statuses? I promise that I won't trick you anymore. I am a ''trainer'' after all right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
准备好了解异常状态了吗？我保证不再捉弄你了。毕竟我可是个“导师”，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
First of all, I'll tell you about <^FF0000Poison^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
首先，我来给你讲讲<^FF0000中毒^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you already experienced, when you are poisoned, your body turns purple and you lose a little HP every second.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
就像你刚才体验到的那样，中毒后身体会变成紫色，而且每秒都会损失少量 HP。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can't lose HP forever so you won't die from poison.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
HP 不会一直减少，所以中毒不会致命。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Experiencing is believing! I will put you in a poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
实践出真知！我现在就让你进入中毒状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
See what happens to you in the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
看看你处于中毒状态时会有什么反应。

scripts.text: You are- <^FF0000Poisoned^000000>.
scripts.translation: 你现在处于<^FF0000中毒^000000>状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Did you see what is the poisoned status? After a certain period of time, you could be detoxicated, but if you're being attached, it is dangerous to expect being detoxicated naturally.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
看清中毒状态的效果了吗？过一段时间后，毒素可能会自行消退；但如果这时还在持续受攻击，就别指望它会自然消退了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Refer to the detoxicants such as <^0022FFGreen Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Next, I'll tell you about<^FF0000 Stun^000000.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
接下来，我来给你讲讲<^FF0000 眩晕^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
While in the Stun status, stars will circle around your head and you can't move basically you'll be ''defenseless''.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
眩晕时，你的头顶会有星星打转，而且基本无法移动，完全处于“毫无防备”的状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you are defenseless, you can't move, use skills, and use items.
So, it is impossible to recover from it by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
毫无防备时，你无法移动、使用技能或物品，
因此没办法自行解除状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
The exceptional case is you can recover from it by the skill called <^0022FFGentle Touch-Cure^000000> if you are a Sura.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
有个例外：如果你是修罗，可以使用<^0022FF点穴-快^000000>技能解除眩晕。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can recover with skills such as the Priest's <^0022FFRecovery ^000000> or the Arch Bishop's <^0022FFLauda Ramus^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
也可以使用牧师的<^0022FF恢复^000000>或大主教的<^0022FF折枝赞颂^000000>等技能解除。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Stun status!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我演示一下眩晕状态的效果！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it?
Didn't you feel oppressed since you couldn't move?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
怎么样？
动弹不得的感觉很难受吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Imagine that you are in that status and monsters are rushing to you...
Believe me it'll happen.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
想象一下，你动弹不得时，魔物正朝你冲来...
相信我，真有可能发生。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
This time, I will teach you about <^FF0000Sleep^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
接下来，我要教你关于<^FF0000睡眠^000000>的知识。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Sleep status, you fall asleep with a <Zzz> popped up over your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
进入睡眠状态时，你会睡着，头上还会冒出一个<Zzz>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Same as the Stun status, you are defenseless, but the difference is you can recover from the enemy's attack.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
和眩晕时一样，你会毫无防备；不同的是，受到敌人攻击后你就会醒来。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But in Sleep status, the possibility to be hit by ''Critical'' attacks from enemy's attack is increased, you are in danger and exposed a severe damage.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不过，睡眠状态下更容易受到敌人的暴击，处境会很危险，也可能遭受重创。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
For your reference, recovery by yourself is impossible and is only possible with the <^0022FF Recovery ^000000>skill of a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
提醒你一下，睡眠状态无法自行解除，只能靠牧师的<^0022FF恢复^000000>技能解除。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我演示一下睡眠状态的效果。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
怎么样？想象一下在危险的敌人面前睡着，不太好受吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
睡眠有助于恢复，但在激烈的战斗中可不是什么好事。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Lastly, I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
最后，我来讲讲<^FF0000沉默^000000>状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
进入沉默状态后，你无法使用任何魔法技能，头顶还会出现一个<...>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不过，沉默并不会让你无法攻击，仍然可以进行普通攻击。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
沉默状态下，你只能进行物理攻击，或者使用药水恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我演示一下睡眠状态的效果。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不能使用技能，是不是很令人着急？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
尤其是依赖技能而非普通攻击的高阶职业，或在战斗中陷入睡眠时，都会因此遭受重创。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In addtion, there are other statuses like Darkness, Frozen, Curse, Stone, Confusion etc, but I can let you experience all of them.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
此外还有黑暗、冰冻、诅咒、石化、混乱等状态，我也可以让你逐一体验。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I hope this was helpful for you to experience some of the things that you will see out in the world.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
希望这次体验能帮你提前熟悉今后冒险中会遇到的状况。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Whenever you want to experience an abnormal status, please come to me.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
想体验其他异常状态时，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As an apology for the lunchbox matter, I will give you a small gift.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
之前便当盒的事是我不好，就送你一份小礼物赔罪吧。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Wish you have good luck in your adventures!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
祝你冒险顺利！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Hey, you there!
By any chance, are you a training beginner?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
嘿，你！
你是刚来学院的新手训练生吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I'm Trainer Mainz; and I'm in charge of education at this Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我是教官美因茨，负责这所学院的教学工作。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Which course?
It is not important so I will let you know later.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
选哪门课程？
现在还不重要，之后我再告诉你。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You must be very exhausted after having to read and learn so much right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
读了这么多、学了这么多，一定很累吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Of course, you are... Oh, you poor thing.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
当然，你是...哎，真可怜。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
There's a person who can help you when you need it.
Do you know who is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你需要帮助时，有个人能帮你。
猜猜是谁？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
That's me!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
就是我！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What does that mean?
It means I have prepared a special gift just for your exhausted self!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你问这是什么意思？
我特地为疲惫的你准备了一份礼物！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
A lunchbox for you!!! Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
给你准备了便当！！！哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Since I'm not the one who made it don't worry.
My beloved wife prepared it. So, just be my guest and enjoy!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
放心，不是我做的。
这是我亲爱的妻子准备的。来，别客气，尽管享用！

scripts.text: Don't take it.
scripts.translation: 别拿了。

scripts.text: Take it.
scripts.translation: 拿来吧。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You don't want to have this lunchbox? I guess it's your loss then.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你不想要这个便当？那可就亏大了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Should I just take it for myself then?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
那我就自己留下了？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Yes... You made a right decision.
Please keep in mind that I really wanted to have it but since you look exhausted I offered it to you first!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
没错...你做了个明智的决定。
可别忘了，我其实很想吃；不过看你这么累，才先让给你！

scripts.text: - You open the lunchbox and there is some type of food inside -
scripts.translation: - 你打开便当盒，发现里面装着某种食物 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Wahahahat! Don't hesitate and just take it!
It will refresh you from your fatigue!
Eat it~~ Eat it~~
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哇哈哈！别犹豫，快吃吧！
吃了就能消除疲劳！
吃吧~~快吃~~

scripts.text: - Since you're tired and starved you're obliged to take the box -
scripts.translation: - 你又累又饿，只好收下便当盒 -

scripts.text: - You eat the food and suddenly feel a sharp pain in your stomach. Your vision seems to be blurry too -
scripts.translation: - 你吃下食物后，胃里突然一阵剧痛，视线也开始模糊 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Oh... what happened to you?
You don't look too good!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哎呀...你怎么了？
脸色看起来不太好！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Oh, man...
I think you've been poisoned.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
糟了...
我想你是中毒了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will give you an antidote. You might get better if you take it.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我给你一剂解毒药，服下后应该会好些。

scripts.text: - You reluctantly take the antidote -
scripts.translation: - 你不情愿地服下了解毒药 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Well, how the heck were you poisoned?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你到底是怎么中毒的？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
By the way, I heard that there's a ghost wandering around the Royal Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
对了，我听说皇家克里阿图拉学院里有幽灵出没。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I think the ghost must have poisoned you.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我看一定是那个幽灵给你下了毒。

scripts.text:
- You roll your eyes at Mainz -
- Mainz turns his head as if he doesn't notice -
scripts.translation:
- 你朝美因茨翻了个白眼 -
- 美因茨转过头，装作没看见 -

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Ehem! Anyway, I am sorry.
Please understand there is no malice.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
咳咳！总之，抱歉。
请相信我没有恶意。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
All of these are for you...
Want to know what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我做这一切都是为了你好...
想知道为什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
There are various kinds of monsters on the Midgard continent. And some of them can poison you or put you in abnormal conditions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
米德加尔特大陆上有各种各样的魔物，有些会让你中毒或陷入其他异常状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Usually, anybody is too embarrassed to admit being poisoned without knowing.  I just did it on purpose to let you have the experience in case it happens out in the real world.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
通常，谁也不愿承认自己不知不觉就中毒了。我故意让你体验一次，以后在真正的冒险中遇到时，你就知道该怎么办了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Understand that I didn't intend to pass my wife's lunchbox as if it was a present. It was just another lesson from the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
别误会，我不是把妻子做的便当当作礼物糊弄你。这只是克里阿图拉学院安排的另一堂课。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As an apology, I would like to inform you of several abnormal statuses you might experience in the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
为了赔罪，我来给你介绍几种在米德加尔特大陆上可能遇到的异常状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Don't decline it! Being ready to learn so speak to me again.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
别拒绝啊！准备好学习之后，再来找我聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Are you here for an explanation about the abnormal statuses? What makes you anxious?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
你是来了解异常状态的吗？有什么不明白的？

scripts.text: I have no questions.
scripts.translation: 我没有其他问题了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I'll tell you about <^FF0000Poison^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我来给你讲讲<^FF0000中毒^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you already experienced, when you are poisoned, your body turns purple and you lose a little HP every second.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
就像你刚才体验到的那样，中毒后身体会变成紫色，而且每秒都会损失少量 HP。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can't lose HP forever so you won't die from poison.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
HP 不会一直减少，所以中毒不会致命。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Experiencing is believing! I will put you in a poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
实践出真知！我现在就让你进入中毒状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
See what happens to you in the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
看看你处于中毒状态时会有什么反应。

scripts.text: You are- <^FF0000Poisoned^000000>.

[Mainz]
Did you see what is the poisoned status? After a certain period of time, you could be detoxicated, but if you're being attached, it is dangerous to expect being detoxicated naturally.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
看清中毒状态的效果了吗？过一段时间后，毒素可能会自行消退；但如果这时还在持续受攻击，就别指望它会自然消退了。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Refer to the detoxicants such as <^0022FFGreen Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
What else are you anxious about?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
还有什么让你担心的状态吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I'll tell you about <^FF0000Stun^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
我来给你讲讲<^FF0000眩晕^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
While in the Stun status, stars will circle around your head and you can't move basically you'll be ''defenseless''.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
眩晕时，你的头顶会有星星打转，而且基本无法移动，完全处于“毫无防备”的状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
As you are defenseless, you can't move, use skills, and use items.
So, it is impossible to recover from it by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
毫无防备时，你无法移动、使用技能或物品，
因此没办法自行解除状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
The exceptional case is you can recover from it by the skill called <^0022FFGentle Touch-Cure^000000> if you are a Sura.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
有个例外：如果你是修罗，可以使用<^0022FF点穴-快^000000>技能解除眩晕。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
You can recover with skills such as the Priest's <^0022FFRecovery ^000000> or the Arch Bishop's <^0022FFLauda Ramus^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
也可以使用牧师的<^0022FF恢复 ^000000>或大主教的<^0022FF折枝赞颂^000000>等技能解除。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Stun status!
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我演示一下眩晕状态的效果！

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it?
Didn't you feel oppressed since you couldn't move?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
感觉如何？
动弹不得的感觉很难受吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Imagine that you are in that status and monsters are rushing to you...
Believe me it'll happen.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
想象一下，你动弹不得时，魔物正朝你冲来...
相信我，真有可能发生。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What else are you anxious about?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
还有什么让你担心的状态吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will teach you about <^FF0000Sleep^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
接下来，我来给你讲讲<^FF0000睡眠^000000>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Sleep status, you fall asleep with a <Zzz> popped up over your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
进入睡眠状态时，你会睡着，头上还会冒出一个<Zzz>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Same as the Stun status, you are defenseless, but the difference is you can recover from the enemy's attack.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
和眩晕时一样，你会毫无防备；不同的是，受到敌人攻击后你就会醒来。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But in Sleep status, the possibility to be hit by ''Critical'' attacks from enemy's attack is increased, you are in danger and exposed a severe damage.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不过，睡眠状态下更容易受到敌人的暴击，处境会很危险，也可能遭受重创。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
For your reference, recovery by yourself is impossible and is only possible with the <^0022FF Recovery ^000000>skill of a Priest.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
提醒你一下，睡眠状态无法自行解除，只能靠牧师的<^0022FF 恢复 ^000000>技能解除。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in the Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我演示一下睡眠状态的效果。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
How was it? It isn't fun to imagine being asleep in front of a dangerous enemy is it?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
怎么样？想象一下在危险的敌人面前睡着，不太好受吧？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Sleep is good for recovery but not necessarily good while you're in the middle of a battle.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
睡眠有助于恢复，但在激烈的战斗中可不是什么好事。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
What else are you anxious about?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
还有什么让你担心的状态吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
I will teach you about  <^FF0000 Silence ^000000>.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
最后，我来讲讲<^FF0000 沉默 ^000000>状态。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In Silence status,  you can't use any magic skills and a <...> will appear above your head.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
进入沉默状态后，你无法使用任何魔法技能，头顶还会出现一个<...>。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
But all attacks are not impossible. Normal attacks can still be done while silenced.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不过，沉默并不会让你无法攻击，仍然可以进行普通攻击。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
In the silence status, you can merely still physically attack or recover by using potions.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
沉默状态下，你只能进行物理攻击，或者使用药水恢复。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's possible to recover with the items such as<^0022FF Green Herb^000000>, <^0022FFGreen Potion^000000>, <^0022FFPanacea^000000> and <^0022FFRoyal Jelly^000000>.

[Mainz]
Let me show you what will happen in Sleep status.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
让我演示一下睡眠状态的效果。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
It's frustrating to not be able to use your skills right?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
不能使用技能，是不是很让人着急？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Especially, when you are a high class depending upon the skills rather than physical attacks or in Sleep status during the battle, you will be damaged severely.
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
尤其是依赖技能而非普通攻击的高阶职业，或在战斗中陷入睡眠时，都会因此遭受重创。

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Do you have any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
If you don't have any more questions, would you please have my lunchbox on behalf of me?
No?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
如果没有别的问题了，能不能替我把这份便当吃掉？
不愿意吗？

scripts.text:
[Mainz]
Haaaaa...
What should I do with this lunchbox?
scripts.translation:
[美因茨]
哈啊...
这份便当该怎么办呢？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Ahaaa~~ sticking at the dispensary.
Playing hooky is cool and awesome.
while XXXXXX, but what are you?
Are you the same kind of XXXXX?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~~躲在医务室里。
逃课可真爽啊。
不过，XXXXXX，你又是什么人？
你也和XXXXX一样吗？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Ahaaa~~ sticking at the dispensary.
Playing hooky is cool and awesome.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~~躲在医务室里。
逃课可真爽啊。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hmmm... you look like you have some talent.
Being in a good mood, shall I show you something newfangled?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嗯...你看起来还挺有天赋的。
我心情不错，要不要让你见识点新玩意儿？

scripts.text: Newfangled?
scripts.translation: 新玩意儿？

scripts.text: Who are you..?
scripts.translation: 你是谁...？

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Who are you..?
scripts.translation: 你是谁...？

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你为什么在这里？

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I may look ordinary to you but I have a newfangled talent.
Not my fault, if you are shocked at seeing it.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
在你看来，我或许很普通，但我可是有一项新潮本领。
看了之后要是吓一跳，可别怪我没提醒你。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
OK. Where should I start?
First, Bash!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
好，我从哪儿开始呢？
先来一招狂击！

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Hehehe.. Surprised?
I'm just pretending...
It's not a real punch.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嘿嘿...吓到了吧？
我只是在装模作样...
这又不是真的打你。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Looks like you were surprised!
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
看来你被吓到了！

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
Just keep calm
and have a potion
But that's not the last of it.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
冷静点，喝瓶药水就好。
不过，好戏还在后头。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
I have stolen one thread of your hair.

scripts.translation:

我拔了你一根头发。

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
The last one is a flame, to say the least!
How about it? Newfangled.
Idling away too long,
All the skills learnt over your shoulder could be used.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]

怎么样，很新潮吧？
闲逛太久，
平时学的那些技能也该派上用场了。

scripts.text:

and wasted... I am tired.

scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

If you don't graduate from school and hang around and only mimic other's lifesstyles you'll end up like me.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
要是你不毕业，整天待在这儿，只会模仿别人的生活，最后就会变成我这样。

scripts.text:

Genius and idiot has a paper thin difference.
Those of versatility but of no special capability, that is the Super Novice.
That's what everyone calls us.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
天才和笨蛋只有一线之隔。
什么都会一点，却没有一项特别拿手的，这就是超级初心者。
大家都这么称呼我们。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]

scripts.text:

You, talking like this, why don't you go and change your job already instead of hanging around here?

scripts.translation:

看你这么能说，干嘛不干脆转职，还在这儿闲逛？

scripts.text:

Aha~ If you want all the different skills...
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
啊哈~你要是想学会各种各样的技能...

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]

scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
照我这样做，你也能成为了不起的超级初心者。

scripts.text:

When I was at your age,

scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
哼，嘴真臭！

scripts.text:

OK... that's enough..
Now I am in a good mood?
When I am using good words,
go away silently, yes?
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
好了...够了...

难得我好好跟你说话，

scripts.text:

If you are loafing around here,
Once grown up, you will be a man like me.
Scary, isn't it?
scripts.translation:

你在学校里闲逛呢？

scripts.text:

Go away, gooooooawaaaaaayyyyyyyyy~
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Well,
What am I doing?
I became like this, in the blink of an eye.
scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
嗯，
我这是在做什么？

scripts.text:
[Odd Novice]
By nature, I had a great dream...

scripts.translation:
[古怪的初心者]
我天生就有个远大的梦想...

I can enjoy myself.
scripts.translation:

好，好，随你便...

[店铺助手 莱奥妮]
还有商人会出售装备精炼材料。

scripts.translation:
[店铺助手 莱奥妮]
到了城镇后，不妨找找有哪些商店，看看哪些对你有用。

scripts.text: [Shop Helper Leonie]
scripts.translation: [店铺助手 莱奥妮]

scripts.text:
[Shop Helper Leonie]

scripts.translation:
[店铺助手 莱奥妮]
卡普拉和大多数 NPC 商人都使用^ff0000Zeny^000000；马兰岛和异世界的部分地区则使用其他货币。

[店铺助手 莱奥妮]
它们分别是^ff0000猕猴桃果实^000000和^ff0000辉煌领域金币^000000，可以在商城购买，也能通过任务获得。

你是新来的学生吗？对属性有疑问的话尽管问我，我可是属性专家。

All materials in the world have their own attributes.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
世上的一切事物都有各自的属性。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
There are many types of attributes. There are 4 elemental attributes ^0D6EF2Water^000000, ^006600Wind^000000, ^FF0000Fire^000000, ^B97246Earth^000000.

[Attribute Expert]
There are more uncommon ones like... Neutral, Poison, Holy, Dark, Angel, Undead.
There are more types than you think right?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
还有一些较少见的属性...无属性、毒、神圣、暗、不死。
属性种类比你想象的还多吧？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
All right, here's the question which attribute do we belong to?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
好了，考考你：我们属于什么属性？

scripts.text: Water
scripts.translation: 水

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 风

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 火

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.translation: 毒

scripts.translation:

万物之间都有强弱之分，因此^3131FF平衡与相克^000000始终存在。
