scripts.translation: 水

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 火

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 风

scripts.text: Etc...
scripts.translation: 其他...

scripts.text: I already know
scripts.translation: 我已经知道了

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^0D6EF2Water^000000 is stronger than ^FF0000Fire^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Fire attribute!
But it is weak to ^006600Wind^000000.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^0D6EF2水^000000克制^FF0000火^000000，因此攻击火属性魔物时会造成额外伤害！
不过，水属性会被^006600风^000000克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Water Attribute are Poring and Roda Frog... have you heard of those monsters?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
波利和罗达蛙就是水属性魔物。
你听说过它们吗？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^FF0000Fire^000000 is stronger than ^B97246Earth^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Earth attribute!
Examples of monsters with the Fire Attribute are Drops and Picky.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^FF0000火^000000克制^B97246地^000000，因此攻击地属性魔物时会造成额外伤害！
土波利和小鸡就是火属性魔物。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Fire Attribute are Drops and Picky.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
土波利和小鸡就是火属性魔物。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^B97246Earth^000000 is stronger than  ^006600Wind^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Wind attribute!
But it is weak to ^FF0000Fire^000000.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^B97246地^000000克制^006600风^000000，因此攻击风属性魔物时会造成额外伤害！
不过，地属性会被^FF0000火^000000克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Earth Attribute are Pupa and Fabre.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
虫蛹和绿棉虫就是地属性魔物。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^006600Wind^000000 is stronger than ^0D6EF2Water^000000, so they give bonus damage to anything with Water attribute!
But it is weak to ^B97246Earth^000000.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^006600风^000000克制^0D6EF2水^000000，因此攻击水属性魔物时会造成额外伤害！
不过，风属性会被^B97246地^000000克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Examples of monsters with the Wind Attribute are ChonChon and Hornet.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
苍蝇和蜂兵就是风属性魔物。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
^3131FFPoison^000000 is stronger than Fire, Wind, and Earth, but weak at Undead attribute.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
^3131FF毒^000000克制火、风和地属性，但会被不死属性克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
It is important.. Isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
这很重要...对吧？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Do you want to experience an attribute?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
想亲自体验一下属性相克吗？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
All right, do you see those ^3131FFFire Eggs^000000 over there?
Go over there and smack one of them.
Don't worry about destroying it either.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
好，你看到那边的^3131FF火蛋^000000了吗？
过去打它一下吧。
不用担心会把它打坏。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
How is it? Have you ever attacked to Fire Eggs?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
感觉怎么样？以前打过火蛋吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text: I want to quit.
scripts.translation: 我想结束了。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
How much damage did you give?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
你造成了多少伤害？

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Oh man, {0}! Are you even trying?
You're barely hitting it.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
哎呀，{0}！你有认真打吗？
你几乎没对它造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
You are good I guess...
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
看来你还挺厉害的...

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
But wait that's impossible.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
等等，这不可能。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
All right. Class is over.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
好了，下课。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
I am not sure if you remember monsters with ^FF0000Fire^000000 are weak against ^0D6EF2Water^000000.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
不知道你还记不记得，^FF0000火^000000属性魔物会被^0D6EF2水^000000属性克制。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
I will give the ^0D6EF2Water^000000 attribute to you as a present.
If you attack the Fire Eggs again you should do more damage now.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
我把^0D6EF2水^000000属性当作礼物送给你。
现在再去攻击火蛋，应该能造成更多伤害。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
There is only one more chance!
Hurry up, the attribute magic will be gone if you take more time thanks for joining to my class.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
只剩最后一次机会！
快点，再磨蹭下去属性魔法就要消失了。谢谢你来上课！

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Go and smack those eggs over there.
The egg of an ant is strong so don't worry about destroying them too much.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
去打那边的蛋吧。
蚂蚁蛋很坚固，不用怕把它们打坏。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
There is nothing I can do. But I will help you anytime if you need.
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
我帮不了你更多。不过，你随时可以来找我求助。

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Magic basically consists of different attribute attacks. There is another way of giving the attribute to your weapon by using skill or item. You will learn more the longer you play. Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
魔法基本上都是属性攻击。也可以通过技能或道具改变武器的属性。玩得越久，你就会懂得越多。祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Attribute Expert]
Are you getting interested in the depth of the different attributes?
scripts.translation:
[属性专家]
你开始对各种属性的奥妙感兴趣了吗？

scripts.text:
Why are you carrying so much stuff?
Put them down and come back.
scripts.translation: 行李带得太多了。先放下一些东西再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What an alluring smell!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
这香气真诱人！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Various dishes to stimulate the five senses. Oh, its heaven!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
各式料理，刺激你的五感...啊，简直是天堂！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
It's not an accident that you came here!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
你能来到这里绝非偶然！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What's your name stranger?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
陌生人，你叫什么名字？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I am Dacquoise, the pupil of the legendary chef of Rune-Midgarts, ^0000cdCharles Orleans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
我是达克瓦兹，卢恩·米德加兹王国传奇主厨^0000cd查尔斯·奥尔良^000000的弟子。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
And we are also club members of Sir Orleans' ^0000cdfan club- Loverleans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
我们也是奥尔良爵士^0000cd粉丝俱乐部“恋奥尔良”^000000的成员呢！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Orlean belongs to all of us!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
奥尔良爵士可是属于大家的！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Ah, what do all the fools of the land eat?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
啊，俗人都吃些什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Fruits? Of course you can eat it raw, but isn't it art when you see the red strawberries laying on top of a creampie?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
水果？当然可以直接吃，不过看到红艳艳的草莓铺在奶油派上，不觉得像一件艺术品吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Bread? Of course you can eat it plain, but can you resist the fantastic harmony of meat and cheese and vegetables in a perfect sandwich?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
面包？当然可以直接吃，但你能抵挡完美三明治中肉、奶酪与蔬菜交织出的绝妙滋味吗？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
I like the steamed horse feet of Minourus!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
我喜欢吃清蒸米洛斯马蹄！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
If you eat a dedicated meal, you can ^0000cdraise a specific stats^000000 and additionally, ^0000cdrecover your health^000000, so what's the reason not to cook?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
吃一顿精心烹制的料理，既能^0000cd提升特定属性^000000，还能^0000cd恢复体力^000000。这样你还有什么理由不下厨？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
You, do you want to know more about cooking?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
你想进一步了解烹饪吗？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Will you exeprience the various spectrums of cooking?
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
想亲自体验各种料理的魅力吗？

scripts.text: I'm not interested, excuse me...
scripts.translation: 我没兴趣，告辞了...

scripts.text: Wow! I want to know more!
scripts.translation: 哇！我想多了解一些！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Really? Okay then... come back whenever you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
真的？好吧...改变主意的话，随时欢迎再来。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
I have a hunch that you will come back again!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
我有预感，你还会再回来的！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Don't forget to pound your chest if you choke on sweet potato!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
吃红薯噎住的话，记得捶捶胸口哦！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Ok, we will be kind guides to the journey of cooking!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
好！我们会带你踏上精彩的烹饪之旅！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
It's ok with me, asking me everthing you want to know.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
当然可以，想知道什么尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Kindness is our spice~
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
亲切就是我们的调味料~

scripts.text: Cooking Benefits
scripts.translation: 烹饪的好处

scripts.text: Cooking Methods
scripts.translation: 烹饪方法

scripts.text: Actually, I have to go...
scripts.translation: 其实，我得走了...

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Aha! You want to know about the benefits of cooking? Cooked meals have two benefits!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
啊哈！想知道烹饪有什么好处吗？料理有两大益处！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
First, ^0000cdincreased stats!^000000 Baaam!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
第一，^0000cd提升属性！^000000砰！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Cooking is divided into 6 catagories. Each will raise up ^0000cdStr, Agi, Vit, Int, Dex, Luk^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
料理分为六类，分别提升^0000cd力量、敏捷、体质、智力、灵巧和幸运^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
The amount of the stat increase changes depending on the level of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
属性提升幅度会随料理等级而变化。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
And the next benefit? Babam!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
第二个好处呢？锵锵！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
^0000cdHP and SP recovery^000000 effect!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
^0000cd恢复 HP 和 SP^000000！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
This also differs with cooking levels, and some only recover HP.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
恢复量也会随料理等级而变化，有些料理只能恢复 HP。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
How is it? Sounds yummy right?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
怎么样？听起来很诱人吧？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Your level is too low to experience the effects right now. If you level up more you will experience and cry for the effect of cooking.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
你现在等级太低，还无法体验这些效果。再升几级就能亲自感受烹饪的妙处，到时候你一定会感动得哭出来。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Prepare lace handkerchief.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
记得准备一条蕾丝手帕。

scripts.text: How can I cook?
scripts.translation: 怎么烹饪？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
There you go! Now you seem interested!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
这就对了！看来你很感兴趣嘛！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
But haste is waste in cooking! Proper cooking requires preparation.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
不过，烹饪急不得！想做出好料理，准备工作可不能少。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Only the one who is well prepared can enter the world of cooking!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
只有准备充分的人，才能踏入烹饪的世界！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Preparation, it's not hard!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
准备起来并不难！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Preparation can also be split into two stages.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
没错，准备工作可以分成两个阶段。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Right, cooking needs some preparation. This can also be divided into two catagories.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
烹饪确实需要事先准备，而且可以分成两类。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What is this? What a waste of time!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
这是什么啊？真浪费时间！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
I thought we were going to get more members!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
我还以为我们要招募更多成员呢！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Never show up again!!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
以后别再出现了！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
First, you need a ^0000cdCookbook.^000000
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
首先，你需要一本^0000cd食谱^000000。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Let's say you have a mountain of ingredients, but you don't know what to do with them?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
假设你手头有一大堆食材，却不知道该怎么处理呢？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
That's when you open the Cookbook.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
这时候就该翻开食谱了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You need a Cookbook to know how to prepare the ingredients for cooking.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你得先有食谱，才能知道该如何准备烹饪食材。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
So how can I get these Cookbooks?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
那要怎么获得食谱呢？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Cookbook can be earned ^0000cdthrough Quest^000000s or can be found by hunting ^0000cdmonster^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
食谱可以通过^0000cd任务^000000获得，也可能从狩猎^0000cd魔物^000000时掉落。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
After getting the Cookbook, next preperation is!
The ^0000cdingredients!^000000.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
拿到食谱后，接下来要准备的就是——
^0000cd食材！^000000

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
You can't cook without ingredients! Even a novice knows that!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
没有食材怎么烹饪！连初心者都知道吧！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
You can get ingredients by beating or smashing ^0000cdmonster^000000 or you can buy them from a ^0000cdCooking Ingredient Merchant^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
你可以通过狩猎^0000cd魔物^000000取得食材，也可以向^0000cd烹饪食材商人^000000购买。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Cooking requires some preparation but the benefits are well worth it.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
烹饪需要一些准备，但这些付出绝对值得。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
And one thing to remember, there is ^0000cda potential to fail in cooking^000000.  Be careful as it depends on your cookwares and cooking level.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
还有一点要记住：^0000cd烹饪有失败的可能^000000。成功率会受到厨具和烹饪等级影响，要多加小心。

scripts.text: I want to cook!
scripts.translation: 我想学烹饪！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
That's the spirit! Let's cook for real!
Get prepared and come back!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
就是要有这股干劲！那就正式开始烹饪吧！
准备好后再回来！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
We are not responsible even if it fails!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
失败了我们可不负责哦！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Did you bring them all?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
东西都带齐了吗？

scripts.text: Yes! I did!
scripts.translation: 是的，都带齐了！

scripts.text: No, I gave up.
scripts.translation: 没有，我放弃了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I used my valuable time to introduce the cooking world to you.
Then you just give up?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
我可是花了宝贵时间给你介绍烹饪的世界。
你居然就这么放弃了？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
You have insulted us!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
你这是在侮辱我们！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Come back again, if you want to learn later~ I guess...
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
以后想学的话再来吧~大概吧...

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Can I have a look?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
我看看，可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你把我要的东西都带来了！好，那我就兑现承诺，为你做料理。
我这就飞快地开工！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Go hunting after eating this. You will feel your power enhanced.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
吃完这个再去打猎吧，你会觉得自己变强了。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you really want to cook, go and see ^0000ffSir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle^000000!!
Kya... Sir Orleans!!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
真想学烹饪的话，就去普隆德拉王宫地下室找^0000ff查尔斯·奥尔良爵士^000000！！
呀...奥尔良爵士！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你把我要的东西都带来了！好，那我就兑现承诺，为你做料理。
我这就飞快地开工！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Try this. It will make you run like you are a flying bee.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
尝尝这个。吃了之后，你会跑得像飞翔的蜜蜂一样快。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you really want to cook, go and see ^0000ffSir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle^000000!! You must be attracted by him!!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
真想学烹饪的话，就去普隆德拉王宫地下室找^0000ff查尔斯·奥尔良爵士^000000吧！你一定会被他迷住的！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你把我要的东西都带来了！好，那我就兑现承诺，为你做料理。
我这就飞快地开工！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Can you feel unknown power coursing through your veins? You're eating it!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
能感觉到一股神秘力量在血管里奔涌吗？你吃下去的正是这股力量！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you are really curious about the cooking, go seek Sir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera Castle.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
真想了解烹饪的话，就去普隆德拉王宫地下室找查尔斯·奥尔良爵士吧。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You brough what I need! Okay, then I will cook for you as I promised.
Time to move like greased lightning!!!!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你把我要的东西都带来了！好，那我就兑现承诺，为你做料理。
我这就飞快地开工！！！！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
If you eat this. You will never miss your target!
In fact, never miss the target for level 1!
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
吃了这个，你就不会打偏了！
至少在 1 级时，绝不会打偏！

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Go and see Sir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle!!
You can learn real cooking from him!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
去普隆德拉王宫地下室找查尔斯·奥尔良爵士吧！！
你可以向他学习真正的烹饪！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
What do you want me to do without ingredients? Go and get them myself?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
没有食材你还想让我做什么？难道要我自己去找吗？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
You came back to me again because you want to cook, right?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你又回来了，想学烹饪，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
So what do you want to cook?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
那你想做什么料理？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Oh? That kid is back again. {0} right? So what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
哦，那个孩子又回来了。是{0}吧？这次想做什么？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Are you ready? Then making is believing! Let's cook!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
准备好了吗？光说不练可不行，来做料理吧！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
For this demonstration the duration of the cooking will be shortened.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
这次只是演示，烹饪时间会缩短。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
The cooking we are about to show you requires a recipe and cooking equipment but it is difficult for novices so I will cook for you.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
接下来要示范的料理需要食谱和厨具，对初心者来说有些难，所以这次由我来做给你看。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Why are you saying you will make them?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
为什么要由你来做？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ah, Why not?
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
咦？为什么不行？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I am the leader of this flame cooking trio chefs!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
我可是火焰料理三人组的队长！

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
What?!! When was that decided?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
什么？！！这是谁决定的？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Is there anyone who is older than me?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你们谁比我年纪大？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Age! There is nothing I can do with it.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
年纪！这我也没办法啊。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Just because you're one year older, you want to automatically be rejected. Anyone have an objection?
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
就因为你大一岁，就想自封为头儿？有人反对吗？

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Quiet!
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
安静！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
So what do you want to make? Int and Luk meals would have no benefit to you, so I prepared the other 4 foods.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
你想做哪一种？智力和幸运料理对你没什么用，所以我准备了另外四种。

scripts.text: Fragrant Herb Mix
scripts.translation: 香草什锦

scripts.text: Crunchy Salad
scripts.translation: 脆爽沙拉

scripts.text: Mixed Shabu Shabu
scripts.translation: 什锦涮涮锅

scripts.text: Golden Apple Roast
scripts.translation: 金苹果烤肉

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
^0000cdFragrant Herb Mix^000000. It increases ^0000cdStr^000000.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
^0000cd香草什锦^000000可以提升^0000cd力量^000000。

scripts.text:
[Equazu]
It's usually eaten by people of strength.
scripts.translation:
[埃夸祖]
力量型的人通常会吃这道料理。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients- ^0000cd1 Clover, 1 Green Herb, 1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
食材：^0000cd1 株三叶草、1 株绿色药草、1 株红色药草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Clover and the Red Herb are dropped by Lunatic or Fabre monsters wandering everywhere on the field outside Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
依斯鲁得岛外的野地里，疯兔或绿棉虫会掉落三叶草和红色药草。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Green Herbs are dropped by Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
绿棉虫会掉落绿色药草。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
We can cook once you bring all the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
你把食材带齐后，我们就能开火了。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Crunchy Salad. This I really like. You know your cooking.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
脆爽沙拉啊，我最喜欢这道菜了。看来你很懂吃嘛。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Crunchy Salad increases ^0000cdAgi^000000. Good for fast attacks and avoiding damage from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
脆爽沙拉能提升^0000cd敏捷^000000，适合想加快攻击速度或躲避魔物攻击的人。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients are ^0000cd1 Apple & 2 Carrots^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
食材：^0000cd1 个苹果和 2 根胡萝卜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Apples are dropped by Porings bouncing around the field outside of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
依斯鲁得岛外的野地里，波利会掉落苹果。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Carrots are given by Lunatics.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
疯兔会掉落胡萝卜。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you bring all the ingredients we can cook.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
你把食材带齐后，我们就能开火了！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Scary ^0000cdAnything ShabuShabu!^000000 This raises ^0000cdVit^000000. Even a small portion makes you full.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
^0000cd惊人的什锦涮涮锅！^000000可以提升^0000cd体质^000000。即使只吃一点，也会很有饱足感。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
If you eat this, you can feel less pain from monsters.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
吃了它，被魔物攻击时就不会那么痛了。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients are ^0000cd1 Jellopy, 1 Fluff, 1 Feather^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
食材：^0000cd1 个杰勒比结晶、1 团绒毛和 1 根羽毛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Jellopy are dropped by Porings bouncing around the field of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
依斯鲁得的野地里，波利会掉落杰勒比结晶。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Fluff can be received from Fabre or Lunatic.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
绒毛可以从绿棉虫或疯兔身上获得。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Feathers are dropped by Lunatics or Fabres.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
疯兔或绿棉虫会掉落羽毛。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
When you bring all the ingredients I'll make them for you.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
把所有食材带齐，我就做给你吃。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
^0000cdGolden Apple Toast~^000000 shiny golden glaze...  It tastes as good as it looks.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
^0000cd金苹果吐司~^000000金黄的糖衣闪闪发亮...味道和卖相一样棒。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
This raises ^0000cdDex^000000. It is mainly enjoyed by Archers who want to increase his attacking power or by people to increase their hit rate.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
这能提升^0000cd灵巧^000000。弓箭手想提高攻击力，或任何想提升命中率的人，都会喜欢这道料理。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Ingredients are-^0000cd 1 Apple & 1 Clover^000000.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
食材：^0000cd1 个苹果和 1 株三叶草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Apple can be found in Porings in the field outside of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
依斯鲁得岛外的野地里，波利会掉落苹果。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Clovers are dropped by Lunatics or Fabre in the field outside Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
疯兔或绿棉虫会在依斯鲁得岛外的野地里掉落三叶草。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
When you bring all the ingredients I'll make them for you.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
把所有食材带齐，我就做给你吃。

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
I am Dacquoise, the pupil of the legendary chef of Rune-Midgarts, ^0000cdCharles Orleans^000000.
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
我是达克瓦兹，卢恩·米德加兹王国传奇主厨^0000cd查尔斯·奥尔良^000000的弟子。

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
Steaks not only increase stats but also recover both your HP and SP.
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
牛排不但能提升属性，还能同时恢复 HP 和 SP。

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
If you really want to cook, go and see^0000cd Sir. Charles Orleans at the basement of Prontera castle^000000!! You must be attracted by him!!
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
真想学烹饪的话，就去普隆德拉王宫地下室找^0000cd查尔斯·奥尔良爵士^000000吧！！你一定会被他迷住的！！

scripts.text:
[Dacquoise]
Looks like you're no longer a beginner. Are you cooking these days?
scripts.translation:
[达克瓦兹]
看来你已经不是新手了。最近有在做料理吗？

scripts.text:
[Eclaire]
If not why don't we start?
scripts.translation:
[艾克莱尔]
如果还没有，不如现在开始吧？

scripts.text:
[Mille Feuille]
Steaks not only increase stats but also recover both your HP and SP.
scripts.translation:
[千层酥]
牛排不但能提升属性，还能同时恢复 HP 和 SP。

scripts.text:
[Flame Cook Trio Chefs]
If you really want to cook, go and meet ^0000cdSir. Charles Olreans at the basement of the Prontera castle^000000! You must be attracted by him.
scripts.translation:
[火焰料理三人组]
真想学烹饪的话，就去普隆德拉王宫地下室见见^0000cd查尔斯·奥尔良爵士^000000吧！你一定会被他迷住的。

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包已满，无法继续任务。
整理好物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Are you interested in the beginner's guild?
I am selling Combination books and kits.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
对初心者公会感兴趣吗？
我这里有卖组合书和组合专用工具。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
To the Criatura students below level 20, a special sale is going on. Hope you to buy a lot!!!
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
基础等级未满 20 级的克里阿图拉学院学生可以享受特价。欢迎多买一些！！！

scripts.text: Novice Combination Book
scripts.translation: 新手物品组合书

scripts.text: Combination Kit
scripts.translation: 组合专用工具

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Have you been treated by the Therapist?
At the medical botany class, you may receive a guild book.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
治疗师帮你治疗过了吗？
上完药用植物学课程后，可以领取公会组合书。

scripts.text: Ah... is that so?
scripts.translation: 啊...是这样吗？

scripts.text: I lost it.
scripts.translation: 我弄丢了。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Later, buy a lot of the guild combination kits~~~
I am selling them at a jaw dropping price to students below base level 20.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
之后记得多买些公会组合专用工具哦~~~
基础等级未满 20 级的学生可以享受超低价。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Say what?
A book costs you 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
什么？
一本书要 1000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
You mean the combination book.
A book costs you 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
你是说组合书吧？
一本要 1000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text: Don't buy.
scripts.translation: 不买

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
下次再用吧。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Here you are.
This book is for the beginners. But it will allow you combine the useful tools together, if you use it correctly.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
给你。
这是给初心者用的书。只要使用得当，就能用它组合出实用工具。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
The book price is 1000 zeny.
You seem to be short of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
这本书售价 1000 Zeny。
看来你的 Zeny 不够。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Breaking news! Special sale for you only!
One combination kit only for 30z!
How many do you need?
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
特大新闻！只给你的特别优惠！
组合专用工具一套只要 30 Zeny！
你要几套？

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
No sales today.
One combination kit costs you 500z.
Tell me how many pieces you need?
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
今天没有特价。
组合专用工具一套要 500 Zeny。
告诉我你要几套？

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
Well, you don't need to buy it now.
Use it next time.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
嗯，你现在不必买。
下次再用吧。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
How many pieces do you need?
You can buy up to 99 at once.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
你要几套？
一次最多可以买 99 套。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
{0} combination kits will cost you {1}.... zeny.
You look short of money for that amount.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
{0} 套组合专用工具要 {1}... Zeny。
看来你的钱不够买这么多。

scripts.text:
[Querrie]
{0} combination kits will cost you {1}.... zeny.
Thank you. Come back again.
scripts.translation:
[奎里]
{0} 套组合专用工具要 {1}... Zeny。
谢谢惠顾，欢迎再来。

scripts.text:
- You have too many items.
- Clear inventory and try again.
scripts.translation:
- 你带的物品太多了。
- 清理一下背包再试试。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
You shouldn't be like this, you are high enough to change your job.
I won't stop you even if you stay still...
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
你不该一直待在这里，你的等级已经足够转职了。
不过你要是继续原地踏步...我也不会拦着你...

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Try to talk to ^ff0000each job instructor^000000 on the 2nd floor of the Academy if you aren't sure what job you want still.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
如果你还没决定想转哪个职业，可以去学院二楼和^ff0000各职业导师^000000聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Welcome!
I am ^ff0000Battle Instructor Subino^000000.
I ^ff0000provice a simple request^000000 to help you to grow up as good a soldier as fast as you can, so look around.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
欢迎！
我是^ff0000战斗指导员苏比诺^000000。
为了帮你尽快成长为优秀的战士，我会发布^ff0000一些简单的委托^000000，四处看看吧。

scripts.text: Check requests
scripts.translation: 查看委托

scripts.text: Warp me to the Field
scripts.translation: 送我去野外

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: The most delicious in the world (1~3)
scripts.translation: 世上最美味的东西（1～3）

scripts.text: Carrots are delicious (1~3)
scripts.translation: 胡萝卜真好吃（1～3）

scripts.text: Fabre rolling clothes (4~6)
scripts.translation: 绿棉虫绒衣（4～6）

scripts.text: Barrier!! (4~6)
Stop.
scripts.translation: 停

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Poring^000000s are very cute monsters when you see them.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
^ff0000波利^000000看起来都是非常可爱的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
They drop Jellopy which are regarded as a main cooking material in Criatura Academy so we always need to hunt Porings.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
波利会掉落杰勒比结晶，这是克里阿图拉学院常用的烹饪材料，所以我们总得去狩猎波利。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Lunatic^000000s are very cute animal that live near Prontera.
Tender...Soft...Very cute... It is very cute........
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
^ff0000疯兔^000000是生活在普隆德拉附近的可爱动物。
软绵绵...软乎乎...超可爱...可爱极了...

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
It always bring ^ff0000Carrot^000000s with it, so it is easy to get a delicious carrot by hunting them.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
疯兔总带着^ff0000胡萝卜^000000，狩猎它们就能轻松获得美味的胡萝卜。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
A carrot has lots of fibrous cells and contains vitamin A and carotin so it is good for eyes!
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
胡萝卜富含膳食纤维，还含有维生素 A 和胡萝卜素，对眼睛很有好处！

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Fabre^000000 is the most common bug which is usually seen in Rune-Midgarts Kingdom..
It is a worm but it is very popular because it looks cute.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
^ff0000绿棉虫^000000是卢恩·米德加兹王国最常见的虫子。
虽然是只虫子，却因为长得可爱而很受欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
Most of the clothes provided by Criatura Academy are made from ^ff0000Fluff^000000 from Fabres. It makes very strong and warm fabric.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
克里阿图拉学院的大部分制服，都是用绿棉虫掉落的^ff0000绒毛^000000制成的。用它织出的布料既结实又保暖。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Pupa^000000 is the intermediate stage of a Fabre before transforming into a Creamy.
The process of a larva turning into a buttefly is mysterious.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
^ff0000虫蛹^000000是绿棉虫变成克瑞米之前的阶段。
幼虫蜕变成蝴蝶的过程真是奇妙。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
As a Fabre transforms to a Creamy I hope that all Novices turn to be great adventurers! So ^ff0000Chrysalis^000000.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
就像绿棉虫会变成克瑞米，我也希望所有初心者都能成长为优秀的冒险者！所以，来一场^ff0000蜕变^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
^ff0000Hornet^000000s are a group of bees that live near Prontera under control of the Queen bee Mistress.
Not aggressive... They only attack with their stingers when they are in danger.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
^ff0000蜂兵^000000是生活在普隆德拉附近、受蜂后妖后统领的蜂群。
它们通常不会主动攻击，只有感到危险时才会用毒针反击。

scripts.text:
[Battle Instructor Subino]
There is a study about using the poison extracted from their stingers to make an antidote in Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[战斗指导员 苏比诺]
克里阿图拉学院正在研究如何利用蜂兵毒针中的毒液制作解毒剂。

[老练的冒险者]
你看那边...已经关闭的克里阿图拉学院花园里，波利正像小果冻似的长着呢。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Not all monsters in Midgard are our for your blood, just most of them.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
米德加尔特并非所有魔物都想要你的命...只是大多数都想。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Take a look at that, looks like that ^3131FFPoring^000000 has something to say to you
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
你看，那只^3131FF波利^000000好像有话要对你说。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you are confused, Please check the quest status by pressing ^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000 anytime.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
如果不清楚情况，随时按^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000查看任务状态。

scripts.text: How to gain Unripe Apples
scripts.translation: 如何获得青苹果

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
You'd want to go to the Dispensary to learn how to make ^3131FFUnripe Apple^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
去医务室学学怎么制作^3131FF青苹果^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
One of the staff there should have a ^3131FFItem compounding book^000000 for novices, ^3131FFHow to make Unripe Apples^000000 is one of the subjects.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
那里的工作人员应该有初心者用的^3131FF物品合成书^000000，里面就有^3131FF青苹果的制作方法^000000。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
So you used the taming item on the Little Porings, then they turned into eggs?
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
你把驯服道具用在宝贝波利身上，它们就变成蛋了？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Ha ha ha, don't fret my pet.
You just cleared ^3131FFtaming^000000.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
哈哈，别担心，小家伙。
你刚通过了^3131FF驯服^000000考验。

scripts.text: Taming?
scripts.translation: 驯服考验？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Yep, it means you are ready to be a friend like me and Debbie Ruchi.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
没错，这说明你也能像我和黛比·鲁奇一样，和宠物成为朋友了。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
There are lots of different monsters and tames out there.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
外面有各种各样的魔物，也有不少可以驯服的伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you successfully tame it you end up with a little egg.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
成功驯服魔物后，就能得到一颗宠物蛋。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
So congratulations again for passing the test, the friendship test!
Ask anytime whenever you have a question about cute pets.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
再次恭喜你通过考验，成为宠物的朋友！
想了解可爱宠物的话，随时来问我。

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
Do you see the shivering poring over there? Go easy on the lil' blighter, okay?
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
看到那只发抖的波利了吗？对它温柔点，别吓着它，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Adept Adventurer]
If you are confused, Please check the quest status by clicking ^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000 anytime.
scripts.translation:
[老练的冒险者]
如果不清楚情况，随时点击^3131FF<Alt+U>^000000查看任务状态。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
You have too many items to continue the quest.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你的物品太多，无法继续任务。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Open inventory with ^3131FFAlt+E^000000 key, if you find unnecessaty items, sell them to ^3131FFmerchant^000000 or put into ^3131FFwarehouse^000000 by using kafra service~.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
按^3131FFAlt+E^000000打开背包。发现不需要的东西，可以卖给^3131FF商人^000000，或使用卡普拉服务存进^3131FF仓库^000000~

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Help me novice...
scripts.translation:
[波利]
初心者，帮帮我...

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Dear oh dear...what do we have 'ere?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哎呀...这是怎么回事？

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 发生什么事了？

scripts.text: Ignore him/it?
scripts.translation: 要无视它吗？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh dear, oh dear...
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哎呀，哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Wot a sad state of affairs.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
真是太惨了。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
That geeza' ghostring got defeated out in his dungeon and came here to pick on other monsters like me.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
那个混账幽灵波利在迷宫里被打败后，跑来这儿欺负我这样的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I'm too low level to stop 'im, you can hear them cheering now...
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我的等级太低，拦不住它。你听，他们现在又在欢呼了...

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
Oi you lot! Tell me wot I want to hear!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵波利]
喂，你们这群家伙！说点我爱听的！

scripts.text:
[Unskilled Poring]
Ghostring's the strongest in the world!
scripts.translation:
[笨拙的波利]
幽灵波利是世界上最强的！

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
What kind of monster I am?
scripts.translation:
[幽灵波利]
你们说，我是什么魔物？

scripts.text:
[Unskilled Poring]
Ghostring's da Boss!
scripts.translation:
[笨拙的波利]
幽灵波利才是老大！

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
Bwa ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[幽灵波利]
哇哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Bleedin' shame...
Little Porings takin' up with a git like that and not bein' cute anymore.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
真丢人...
宝贝波利居然跟那种混账混在一起，连可爱劲儿都没了。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
The Little Porings aren't bad'uns, they've just not been to the outside world.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
宝贝波利们其实不坏，只是它们还没去过外面的世界。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
If this keeps up, all of the Porings in Midgard will be under the sway of Ghostring.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
再这样下去，米德加尔特所有的波利都会被幽灵波利控制。

scripts.text: Can I help you?
scripts.translation: 我能帮你吗？

scripts.text: Too bad.
scripts.translation: 真可惜。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh dear, oh dear.....
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哎呀，哎呀...

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Now that you mention it sir, I could use some help.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你这么一说，先生，我确实需要帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Unskilled Poring]
Wot's Dat? Onna them Poring's talkin' to a huumie.
Shall we beat him up?
scripts.translation:
[笨拙的波利]
那是什么？有只波利居然在跟人类说话。
我们要不要揍他一顿？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Blimey!
Help me! Save me!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
天哪！
帮帮我！救命啊！

scripts.text: What can I do to help?
scripts.translation: 我能怎么帮你？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I do have a good idea!
Come over here!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我有个好主意！
跟我来！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
This is ^3131FFunripe apple^000000.
The favorite items for Little Poring to eat.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
这是^3131FF青苹果^000000。
宝贝波利最爱吃这个。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Maybe you can use it to tempt them away from listenin' to Ghostring.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
也许你可以用它把宝贝波利引开，让它们不再听幽灵波利的话。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
^3131FFDouble click the unripe apple^000000 that I gave you and ^3131FFselect^000000 a ^3131FFLittle Poring^000000 that you fancy.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
^3131FF双击我给你的青苹果^000000，再^3131FF选择^000000你喜欢的^3131FF宝贝波利^000000。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
TThe click the centre of the slot machine.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
然后点击老虎机中央。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
That'll lure them from out of Ghostring's influence.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
这样就能把它们从幽灵波利的控制中引出来。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Ello' mate. Were you successful? Where are the lil' bleeders?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
嘿，伙计，成功了吗？那些小家伙在哪儿？

scripts.text: Show eggs
scripts.translation: 给我看看宠物蛋

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Steady on now guv'na...
What did you do to Unskilled Poring!?!? Novice!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
冷静点，伙计...
你对笨拙的波利做了什么？！初心者！！！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I used the unripe apples that you gave me, then they turned into eggs.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我用了你给我的青苹果，它们就变成蛋了。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oh, guess I didn't expect they'd be turned into pets so easily!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
哦，没想到这么容易就能把它们变成宠物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah, don't worry, I'll make sure to
give them a good home.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是啊，别担心，我会
给它们找个好归宿。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
^3131FFDouble click the unripe apple^000000 that I gave you and ^3131FFselect^000000 your preferred ^3131FFLittle Poring^000000.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
^3131FF双击我给你的青苹果^000000，再^3131FF选择^000000你喜欢的^3131FF宝贝波利^000000。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
The all you have to do is ^3131FFclick ^0000 the middle of the slot machine.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
接着只要^3131FF点击^0000老虎机中央即可。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
It may fail, but keep trying to lure way those Little Porings!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
可能会失败，但继续尝试把那些宝贝波利引过来吧！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Have you ever heard about the changes of a novice from adept adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你听说过从初心者成长为老练冒险者的过程吗？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Unripe Apples are the item to tame.
It will only work on the Little Porings hopping around.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
青苹果是用来驯服魔物的道具。
只对四处蹦跳的宝贝波利有效。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
If you're going to make them a cute pet...
You must take care of your Little Poring!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
想让它们成为可爱的宠物...
就得好好照顾你的宝贝波利！

scripts.text: What?
scripts.translation: 什么？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Even before that Ghostring came here, the Little Porings were kind of cowardly.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
即使在幽灵波利来这里之前，宝贝波利就已经有点胆小了。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Since they've never been out in the real world, sort of like human novices.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
它们从没去过外面的世界，就像人类的初心者一样。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
You're just starting out on your adventure, right? You will visit many towns and meet many people and encounter the frightful Boss Monsters.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
你才刚开始冒险吧？以后会走访许多城镇、结识许多人，还会遇上可怕的头目魔物。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Won't you consider taking one of these chavs with you?
scripts.translation:
[波利]
要不要带一只这样的可爱小家伙一起旅行？

scripts.text:
[Poring]
They're smeggin' talkative, but they'll be loyal friends!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
它们虽然话很多，却会是忠实的伙伴！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I'd say that the ^31311FAdept adventurer ^000000knows lots of things about pets, so you can ask him about your new Little Poring Friend.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我想，^31311F老练的冒险者^000000很了解宠物。你的新伙伴宝贝波利有什么问题，都可以去问他。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
By the way, you should have a ^3131FFportable egg incubator ^000000.
It was dropped by a careless ^3131FFPet Groomer^000000 traveling through.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
对了，你应该有一个^3131FF<携带用孵蛋器> ^000000。
这是一个路过的粗心^3131FF宠物美容师^000000掉下的。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
I will also give you the Little Poring's favorite ^3131FFapple juice^000000, so make sure that it stays fed all the time!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
我还会送你宝贝波利最爱喝的^3131FF苹果汁^000000，记得按时喂它！

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Oi, Little Poring.
I look forward to seeing you once you've explored Midgard!
Cheers mate.
scripts.translation:
[波利]
嘿，宝贝波利。
等你探索完米德加尔特，记得回来找我。保重，伙计。

scripts.text:
[Poring]
Take good care of your Little Poring. Ask the adept adventurer if you have any questions about cute pets!
scripts.translation:
[波利]
好好照顾你的宝贝波利。关于可爱宠物的问题，记得去问老练的冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Ghostring]
I am da biggest and da meanest Ghostring!
scripts.translation:
[幽灵波利]
我可是最强、最凶的幽灵波利！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Welcome, Kafra service is always close to your heart
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
欢迎！卡普拉服务始终陪伴在你身边。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
For those who are using the Kafra service for the first time.
Kafra service offers thorough information rundown~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
第一次使用卡普拉服务吗？
我们会为你详细介绍各项服务~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Tell us what you would like to know
about the Kafra service~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
告诉我，你想了解哪些卡普拉服务~！

scripts.text: Saving
scripts.translation: 存档服务

scripts.text: Storage Service
scripts.translation: 仓库服务

scripts.text: Teleport Service
scripts.translation: 瞬间移动服务

scripts.text: Use of Pushcart Service
scripts.translation: 手推车使用

scripts.text: Check Other Information
scripts.translation: 查看其他信息

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Save service is for when you ^8B4513die in battle^000000 or use an item like ^8B4513Butterfly Wings^000000, you will be sent back to your Save Location.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
如果你在战斗中^8B4513倒下^000000，或使用^8B4513蝴蝶翅膀^000000等物品，就会返回你登记的复活点。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Easy to understand~?
You want to try the Save service~?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
很容易懂吧~？
要不要试试存档服务~？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Don't be afraid of it~!
Save service doesn't swallow you.
If you change your mind, you would better try it definitely~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
别害怕~！
存档服务不会把你吞掉的。
改变主意的话，最好还是亲自试试看~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Well~ then, for now, ^8B4513Izlude Square^000000 where the Criatura Academy is located will be saved as your save point~!.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
那么~先把克里阿图拉学院所在的^8B4513依斯鲁得广场^000000设为你的复活点~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Voila~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
完成啦~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
It's already done. Easy huh?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
已经设好了。很简单吧？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Now, when you use a ^006400Butterfly Wing^000000, it will send you to the last saved location.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
现在使用^006400蝴蝶翅膀^000000，便会返回上次登记的复活点。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Storage service is a place where you can safely store your items.
Your items can be accessed by all characters in your account.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
仓库服务能帮你安全存放物品。
账号内的所有角色都能使用仓库里的物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
To use the storage, you need to be over Novice Job Level 6 and higher.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
初心者职业等级至少达到 6 级，才能使用仓库。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
For a small fee, most Kafra Employees will let you open your storage.
You can even buy Kafra Cards from the Item Mall to open storage from anywhere!
Do you want to use the storage?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
支付少量费用后，大多数卡普拉职员都能帮你打开仓库。
你也可以在道具商城购买卡普拉随身仓库使用券，随时随地开启仓库！
要使用仓库吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Storage is necessary for you to survive so use it regularly.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
仓库对冒险很重要，记得经常使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
To use the storage, you need to be raised the beginner level 6 and higher.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
初心者等级达到 6 级后，才能使用仓库。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
I'll open the storage~.
Thanks for using~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
这就帮你打开仓库~
感谢使用~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Dear customer, you don't have enough money~!
You need 500 zeny to use the storage~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
亲爱的顾客，你的钱不够~！
使用仓库需要 500 Zeny~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Teleport service is a service that sends you to various locations throughout Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
瞬间移动服务可以把你传送到米德加尔特各地。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Different Kafra Employees have different teleport locations to send you to so you need to talk to them to find out where they're teleporting to.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
各地卡普拉职员提供的传送目的地都不同，记得和他们聊聊，确认能去哪里。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Ok, so for educational purposes I'm offering a free teleport service here at the Academy.
Why don't you try it out?~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
为了教学，我在学院提供免费瞬间移动服务。
要不要试试看？~！

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You afraid of having your cells spliced or something? Don't worry this is perfectly safe~!
This is an essential service~
So, you better get used to it ok?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
怕身体被拆开重组什么的吗？别担心，绝对安全~！
这是项必备服务~
最好早点习惯，知道吗？

scripts.text: Academy 1st floor Great Hall
scripts.translation: 学院一楼大厅

scripts.text: Academy 2nd floor Principal's Office
scripts.translation: 学院二楼院长办公室

scripts.text: Izlude southern entrance
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得南入口

scripts.text: Use later
scripts.translation: 稍后再用

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
This will take you to the outside of the Criatura Academy, is that ok?
If you want to come back to the academy, find the entrance to the north of Izlude.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
要把你传送到克里阿图拉学院外面，可以吗？
想回学院的话，去依斯鲁得北边找入口。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You afraid of having your cells spliced or something? Don't worry this is perfectly safe~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
怕身体被拆开重组什么的吗？别担心，绝对安全~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You afraid of having your cells spliced or something? Don't worry this is perfectly safe~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
怕身体被拆开重组什么的吗？别担心，绝对安全~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Pushcart service is used for those who have the job ^8B4513Merchant^000000.
To rent a Pushcart Merchants pay a small zeny fee and that's it.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
手推车服务仅限^8B4513商人^000000职业使用。
商人只需支付少量 Zeny，就能租用手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
If you aren't a Merchant class or if you haven't learned the Cart Skill then you can't use this Kafra service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
不是商人，或没有学习手推车使用技能的话，就无法使用这项卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Among the other services we provide, there is a Customer point service system from Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
此外，卡普拉还设有顾客积分系统！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Every time you use a Kafra Service you get Special Reserve Points~
You can use these points at the Kafra Headquarters in Aldebaran to trade for certain items.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
每次使用卡普拉服务都能获得特别储备积分~
可以到艾尔帕兰的卡普拉总部兑换特定物品。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Here, I'll show you how many Special Reserve Points you currently have.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
来看看你目前累积了多少特别储备积分。

scripts.text: Check Special Reserve Points.
scripts.translation: 查看特别储备积分

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Even later~~!!
Please check your accumulated customer points~!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
晚点再看也行~~！！
记得查看你累积的顾客积分~！

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
{0}, your accummulated points are {1} points.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
{0}，你累积了 {1} 点积分。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
You can exchange your
Special Reserve Points for
rewards at the Kafra Main Office in Al De Baran. Please use our
convenient services to see the benefits of our rewards program.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
你可以在艾尔帕兰的卡普拉总部，用特别储备积分兑换奖励。
善用我们的服务，享受奖励计划带来的好处吧。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
Our Kafra service is doing our best to give you the best satisfaction that you deserve as a customer.
Thanks for using us.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
卡普拉会尽力为每位顾客提供最满意的服务。
感谢使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Guide Trainer]
First, you need to complete your^8B4513 registration^000000 at the Academy's front desk.
If you go to the first floor,
there'll be someone
to take your registration.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉向导培训师]
首先，请到学院前台完成^8B4513注册^000000。
去一楼找工作人员办理即可。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
You are the just a beginner.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
你还只是个初学者。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Everything looks new and unfamiliar, doesn't it? Isn't it all exiciting?
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
一切都新鲜又陌生，对吧？是不是很令人兴奋？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
What can be a more exciting start than a marriage in your life?
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
人生中还有什么比结婚更令人期待的开始呢？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Are you in love?
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
你恋爱了吗？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
I am the Wedding Secretary sent here for those people wanting to join their lives to another.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
我是婚礼秘书，专门为想与伴侣共度一生的人提供服务。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Please ask anything you are concerned with about marriage!
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
关于结婚有任何疑问，尽管问我！

scripts.text: How to get married.
scripts.translation: 如何结婚

scripts.text: Benefits of marriage
scripts.translation: 婚姻的好处

scripts.text: Adoption
scripts.translation: 收养

scripts.text: Shut up!
scripts.translation: 闭嘴！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Concluding the ceremony between two lovers is really the most beautiful and special event in one's life.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
为一对恋人主持婚礼，是人生中最美好、最特别的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
However, being together requires several procedures.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
不过，想要结为夫妻还得办理几项手续。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
First, the two of you wishing to get married have to be at least base level ^0000cd45^000000 or higher, meaning  you should be at the level responsible for your life and your finances.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
首先，想结婚的双方基础等级都必须达到^0000cd45^000000级以上，也就是说，你们都已具备独立生活和理财的能力。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Next, you need to prepare some tokens of appreciation. Men need a ^0000cdTuxedo^000000 Ladies need a ^0000cdWedding Dress^000000 and both need to have ^0000cdDiamond Ring^000000s as the symbol of everlasting love.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
接下来要准备一些信物：男士需要^0000cd燕尾服^000000，女士需要^0000cd结婚礼服^000000，双方还都要有象征永恒爱情的^0000cd钻石戒指^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
You will also need to provide a fee of ^0000cd1 million Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
另外还要支付^0000cd100 万 Zeny^000000手续费。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Having prepared all of these things, you must create a party with just the two of you and go to the ^0000cdProntera Cathedral^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
准备好这些之后，你们两人组成一支队伍，再前往^0000cd普隆德拉大教堂^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
There, another  ^0000cdWedding Secretary^000000 like me is wating for you. When you speak to her, she will give more details of what to do.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
那里会有另一位^0000cd婚礼秘书^000000等着你们。和她交谈，她会告诉你们详细流程。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
I hope that you will meet a great fiance and enjoy a happy marriage!
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
希望你能遇见一位好伴侣，拥有幸福美满的婚姻！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
To say the least, the benefit of marriage is being together forever!
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
婚姻最大的好处，就是两个人能永远相伴！

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
After the wedding ceremony, you can enjoy a sweet honeymoon at the ^0000cdJawaii^000000 resort only for you.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
婚礼结束后，你们还能到只属于两人的^0000cd爪哇度假村^000000享受甜蜜蜜月。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
And, upon marriage you will both get a ^0000cdspecial skill^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
结婚后，双方都会获得一项^0000cd特殊技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Two of these skills are called ^0000cdLoving Touch^000000 and ^0000cdUndying Love^000000 which are used to sacrifice HP or SP and send it to your partner.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
其中两项技能是^0000cd只呵护妳^000000和^0000cd只为你牺牲^000000，可以消耗自己的 HP 或 SP 转给伴侣。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
But among them, the skill called ^0000cdRomantic Rendezvous^000000 is the most romantic one, enabling you to summon your partner to you from anywhere in the world.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
其中最浪漫的要数^0000cd浪漫约会^000000，能让你从世界各地召唤伴侣到身边。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Aren't these skill great? Don't you want to get married right now?
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
这些技能很棒吧？你们不想马上结婚吗？

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Being together is wonderful but people without experience of it in the past couldn't understand the full Euphoria of being a parent.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
相伴左右固然美好，但没有亲身体验过的人，很难体会为人父母的全部喜悦。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Married couple can adopt other characters as their children.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
已婚夫妇可以收养其他角色作为自己的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
^0000cdKids of extended jobs such as Taekwon boy/girl, Gunslinger or Ninja can't be adopted^000000.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
^0000cd跆拳少年/少女、神枪手或忍者等扩展职业无法被收养^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
And any prospecting parents need to be at least base level  ^0000cd70^000000, meaning you should be at the level responsible enough to be parents.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
想收养孩子的准父母，基础等级都必须达到^0000cd70^000000级以上，才算有能力承担父母的责任。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Having made a family, ^0000cdaSkill to be used among the family^000000 will be earned.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
组建家庭后，你们还能获得一项^0000cd家族专属技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
There is another skill enables you to concrete your bond such as being able to summon your child when you miss them or not losing your earned level if you die during battle.
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
还有一项技能能让家人之间的羁绊更深，比如在想念孩子时召唤孩子，或是在战斗中倒下时避免损失等级。

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Cute charms coming from your kid is a bonus~
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
还能享受孩子带来的可爱乐趣呢~

scripts.text:
[Wedding Secretary]
Your mother didn't teach you right?
Mercy on you. You are ignorant of the beauty of love!!!
scripts.translation:
[婚礼秘书]
你妈妈没好好教你吗？
真可怜，竟然不懂爱情有多美好！！！

scripts.text:
[Mom]
Honey~~~
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
亲爱的~~~

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Yep~~

[Mom]
Did you see Etinifni playing at the backyard?
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
你看到埃蒂尼夫尼在后院玩吗？

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Nope~~
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
没看到~~~

scripts.text:
[Mom]
He's out again? Never stays in the house!! Shall I use it?
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
他又跑出去了？真是一刻也待不住！！要不要用那个把他叫回来？

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Leave him alone~ He may be playing somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
别管他啦~他可能在哪儿玩呢。

scripts.text:
[Mom]
You spoil him too much!
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
你太宠他了！

scripts.text:
[Mom]
^0000cd[Come to me, honey~]^000000
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
^0000cd[宝贝，快到我这里来~]^000000

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
What's up? Where am I?
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
怎么了？我在哪儿？

scripts.text:
[Mom]
Here!
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
在这里！

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
Ah... Again!! I have been out hunting Orcs.
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
啊...又来了！！我刚才还在外面打兽人呢。

scripts.text:
[Mom]
I told you stop hunting! Go and buy us milk!
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
我说过别再打怪了！快去给我们买牛奶！

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
Why am I just your errand boy? Go, get me a brother!
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
为什么我整天只能给你跑腿？不如给我生个弟弟！

scripts.text:
[Mom]
What? This moron?!
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
什么？这个笨蛋？！

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
OK. I will do it.
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
好吧，我去就是了。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
I am sorry... Dad has no power over your mom.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
抱歉...爸爸也管不了你妈妈。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Got this boy ten years ago after years of childlessness.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
我们多年都没能有孩子，十年前才终于有了这个男孩。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
He is the apple of my eyes to me, but my wife is too strict on him.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
他是我的心肝宝贝，可我妻子对他管得太严了。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
So, I am always worrying if the only son might be spoiled.
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
所以我总担心这个独子会被宠坏。

scripts.text:
[Dad]
Maybe all parents worry?
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
也许每个父母都会这样担心吧？

scripts.text:
[Etinifni]
Once you have time, come to Orc Dungeon!
scripts.translation:
[埃蒂尼夫尼]
有空的话来兽人地下城找我！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
Let's go~~ together hand in hand~~ Put everything aside ~~ in the dark blue night of Jawaii~~ under the stars~~
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
来吧~~手牵手一起走~~把烦恼全抛在脑后~~在爪哇深蓝的夜色里~~仰望星空~~

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
We are leaving for Jawaii-the place of our honeymoon to celebrate our 10th wedding anniversary!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
我们要去爪哇——当年我们度蜜月的地方，庆祝结婚十周年！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
Are you lifting up our good old memories renting my wedding dress and your tuxedo!! It will strenghthen our relationship, won't it?
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
穿上我的婚纱和你的燕尾服，重温当年的美好回忆吧！！这样肯定能增进感情，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
Honey~~ I love you!! Sweetheart~
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
亲爱的~~我爱你！！宝贝~

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
No!! I love you more than you do!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
不！！我比你更爱你！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
Shout like this when I miss you, honey!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
想我的时候，就这样大声喊我，亲爱的！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
^0000cd[I miss you.]^000000

[Romantic Female]
Then, you run towards me leaving everything behind,~ don't you?
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
到时候你会抛下一切，朝我飞奔而来，对吧？~

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
I will definitely do as you call me!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
只要你呼唤我，我一定会立刻赶来！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
You are tired of sitting, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
坐累了吧？

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
My sweetheart!!! I love you!!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
亲爱的！！！我爱你！！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
Yes, thank you for sharing your SP! You are also tired, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
谢谢你把 SP 分给我！你也累了吧？

scripts.text:
[Romantic Male]
My sweetheart!! I love you!!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的男子]
亲爱的！！我爱你！！！

scripts.text:
[Romantic Female]
Kia~ You are Coolest!!!
scripts.translation:
[浪漫的女子]
呀~你最酷了！！！

scripts.text:
[Manufacturing Maniac]
Hi~! I am an Alchemist.
It's one of the second jobs after Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[制造狂人]
你好~！我是炼金术士。
这是商人的二转职业之一。

scripts.text:
[Manufacturing Maniac]
I am making a potion.
I came to izlude to make potions at a quiet place.
I feel that quiet places help to increase the rate of success.
I am feeling good!
scripts.translation:
[制造狂人]
我正在制作药水。
我特地来到依斯鲁得，想找个安静的地方调配。
安静的环境似乎能提高成功率。
我今天手感正好！

scripts.text:
[Working Blacksmith]
The guy sitting over there has been staring at Wagzak. I was told that only one knife is left after losing all weapons?
scripts.translation:
[干活的铁匠]
坐在那边的家伙一直盯着瓦格扎克看。听说他把武器都弄丢了，现在只剩一把刀？

scripts.text:
[Working Blacksmith]
He can use safe refining... I don't understand why he takes such risks.
scripts.translation:
[干活的铁匠]
他明明可以安全精炼装备...真不懂为什么要冒这种险。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Shh...! Be quiet.
I am focusing on ^3131FFrefining^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
嘘...！安静点。
我正专心^3131FF精炼^000000呢。

scripts.text: What is refining?
scripts.translation: 什么是精炼？

scripts.text: Good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Come on.. Co..me on...!!
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
拜托了...成...成功吧...！！

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Some equipment except some specific ones can be enhanced by ^3131FFrefining^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
除部分特殊装备外，大多数装备都可以通过^3131FF精炼^000000来强化。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Weapons get increased ^3131FFAttack Power^000000, so the more you refine them the stronger they become.
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
精炼可以提升武器的^3131FF攻击力^000000，精炼等级越高，武器就越强。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Each weapon level has a different refining safe point. So it's important to pay attention when refining.
If you break it you lose it.
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
不同等级的武器都有各自的安全精炼上限，精炼时一定要留意。
精炼失败的话，装备就会损坏。

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
I'm trying to get to +10 right now... All my training is for this!
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
我现在正冲击 +10...所有训练都是为了这一刻！

scripts.text:
[Refining Maniac]
Please ask to the owner of refining, I have a important mission +10!
scripts.translation:
[精炼狂人]
精炼问题去问专家吧，我正忙着冲 +10 呢！

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Welcome~
I am Samssoon~! I am a royal hair designer otter sent to academy.
scripts.translation:
[水獭 萨姆孙]
欢迎光临~
我是萨姆孙~！来自皇家的发型设计师水獭，奉命来到学院为大家服务。

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
If you take ^ff0000Criatura Hair Coupon^000000, they change your hairstyle for free! So do not miss this ^ff0000once in a lifetime^000000 chance~
scripts.translation:
[水獭 萨姆孙]
只要持有^ff0000克里图拉美发券^000000，就能免费更换发型！千万别错过这^ff0000千载难逢^000000的机会哦~

scripts.text: Read style book.
scripts.translation: 查看发型图鉴

scripts.text: Change hair style.
scripts.translation: 更换发型

scripts.text: How to get a coupon
scripts.translation: 如何获得美发券

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Oh my~ I am sure any hair style will suit you! You really have a good style~
There are many styles so pick ^ff0000from page 1 to 19^000000.
If you want to stop, say 0.
scripts.translation:
[水獭 萨姆孙]
哎呀~什么发型都很适合您！您的品味真好~
发型有很多种，请从^ff0000第 1 页到第 19 页^000000挑选。
想停止的话，输入 0。

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Oh my!!? Honey~ You can use a coupon for the hair style in here~
scripts.translation:
[水獭 萨姆孙]
哎呀！！？亲爱的~您可以用美发券换成这里展示的发型哦~

scripts.text:
[Otter Samssoon]
Did you decide? Which style??
I want to touch your hair with my hands~ Honey~
scripts.translation:
[水獭 萨姆孙]
决定好了吗？想选哪种发型？
我好想亲手摸摸您的头发~亲爱的~

scripts.text: [Otter Samssoon]
scripts.translation: [水獭 萨姆孙]
