scripts.text:
[Lusa's desk]
There are lots of files on the desk, they seem to be tasks from Prontera and Izlude residents.
scripts.translation:
[露莎的书桌]
桌上堆着许多文件，似乎是普隆德拉和依斯鲁得岛居民提交的任务委托。

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 你携带的物品太多了。 -

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Yesssssss? I wass sssent by the academy.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
是～～？我、我是学院派来的。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
I am ^A2563ESharp Snake's Fang^000000 from the Gunslinger Guild. What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
我是神枪手公会的^A2563E锐利的蛇牙^000000。有什么事？

scripts.text: Exchange Guns
scripts.translation: 交换枪械

scripts.text: Just Saying Hello
scripts.translation: 只是打个招呼

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You seem to be that guy our brother mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你就是哥哥提到的那个人吧。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You don't need to worry, he said you're doing great!
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
别担心，他说你表现得很出色！

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Do you wish to exchange your guild issued weapon?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你想更换公会配发的武器吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Let's first check your gun's condition.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
先让我检查一下你的枪。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
If you want to proceed, you need to have your weapon equipped.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
要继续的话，得先把武器装备上。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
我看看...

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
The gun you are using is was not provided by the guild.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你现在用的这把枪不是公会配发的。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Revolver?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你想更换公会配发的左轮手枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Rifle?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你想更换公会配发的步枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Shotgun?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你想更换公会配发的霰弹枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Gatling Gun?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你想更换公会配发的加特林机枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You want to exchange your Guild issued Grenade Launcher?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你想更换公会配发的榴弹发射器吗？

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
The gun looks to be in good condition.
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
这把枪看起来保养得不错。

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Please select the novice weapon you wish to exchange for your {0}!
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
请选择要用来换取你这把{0}的初心者武器！

scripts.text: Exchange for Revolver
scripts.translation: 换取左轮手枪

scripts.text: Exchange for Rifle
scripts.translation: 换取步枪

scripts.text: Exchange for Shotgun
scripts.translation: 换取霰弹枪

scripts.text: Exchange for Gatling Gun
scripts.translation: 换取加特林机枪

scripts.text: Exchange for Grenade Launcher
scripts.translation: 换取榴弹发射器

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
You already have that gun, just use it!
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
你已经有这把枪了，直接用就行！

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Gun control management number ^FF0000{0}{1}{2}{3}{4}{5}{6}^000000.

[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Are there any issues?
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
还有问题吗？

scripts.text: No issues.
scripts.translation: 没问题

scripts.text:
[Sharp Snake's Fang]
Cherish your gun!
scripts.translation:
[锐利的蛇牙]
好好爱惜你的枪！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Hi, Good morning!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
嗨，早上好！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
It's time to choose your job? How about Taekwon {0}? You may be a nice adult like me.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
是时候选职业了吧？考虑一下跆拳{0}怎么样？你也可以像我一样成为出色的大人。

scripts.text: People following the Taekwon way
scripts.translation: 追随跆拳之路的人

scripts.text: I want to follow the Taekwon way!!!
scripts.translation: 我要追随跆拳之路！！！

scripts.text: Good morning! Now it is...
scripts.translation: 早上好！现在正是...

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Do you want to know about taekwon boy/girl? You want to be a cool guy like me right?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
想了解跆拳少年/少女吗？你也想像我一样成为帅气的人吧？

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Make the world wonderful by making a strong body with the right spirit. That's the Taekwondo motto!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
以正确的精神锻炼强健的体魄，让世界变得更美好。这就是跆拳道的座右铭！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Later if you are trained to be a stronger body, you can change your job to ^FF0000Taekwon Master^000000 or a ^FF0000Soul Linker ^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
等你把身体锻炼得更强健，就可以转职为^FF0000拳圣^000000或^FF0000悟灵士^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
It is not an easy way. So I don't like to recommend it to you if you aren't fully prepared. But it is definitely a nice and great way to follow!!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
这条路可不轻松，没做好准备的话，我可不建议你走。不过，只要下定决心，这绝对是一条很棒的路！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Introduction to the class may let you know about what Taekwon in more detail.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
职业介绍能让你更深入地了解跆拳。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
If you are really anxious about Taekown, I would like to recommend you a brief introduction. Will you use it?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
如果你特别想了解跆拳，我可以给你一份简要介绍。要看看吗？

scripts.text: After I look around more.
scripts.translation: 我再看看别的。

scripts.text: Yes, let's do this!
scripts.translation: 好，就这么办！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Every adventurer may have their own job! Hope you can find what you want!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
每位冒险者都有自己的职业道路！希望你能找到心仪的职业！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Go to the [Misc] tab on Skill Window after equipping the Manual and there you will see some skills.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
装备手册后，打开技能窗口并切换到[其他]标签页，就能看到一些技能。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
^FF0000Flying Kick^000000 is the skill to approach rapidly and attack the enemy! It fully contains the typical feature of Taekwon!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
^FF0000飞脚踢^000000可以迅速接近敌人并发动攻击！这招充分体现了跆拳的特色！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
^FF0000Warm Wind^000000 is the skill to change the feature of attacks. This is the essential skill for ^FF0000Taekwon unable to use weapons^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
^FF0000暖风^000000可以改变攻击的属性，是^FF0000无法使用武器的跆拳职业^000000必学的技能。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
While taking the Quest, experience the skills of a Taekwon! You could meet an adept trainer on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
接下任务，亲自体验跆拳技能吧！一楼就有位资深教练。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Want to follow the Taekwon way? Let me see....
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
想走跆拳这条路吗？我看看...

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Taekwon is the tough way training himself rather than learning from somebody. However, if you want to follow, I will recommend you to a trainer.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
跆拳之道讲究自我磨练，而不是依赖别人。不过你要是想加入，我可以给你推荐一位教练。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Training is on you, but he will give you the direction for training. I can take you about there. Want to go now?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
训练得靠你自己，不过他会为你指点方向。我可以带你过去，现在就走吗？

scripts.text: Let me think a little more.
scripts.translation: 让我再想想。

scripts.text: Let's go!!
scripts.translation: 走吧！！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Choose it with discretion. It is a matter of your future adventure.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
慎重考虑再做决定吧，这关系到你今后的冒险。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You can find a boy with the same appearance as me, when you get in the town through ^FF0000the west entrance^000000, and continue follow the way ^FF0000to the north^000000 after passing the pub house but just before the archer town.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
从^FF0000西门^000000进城，经过酒馆后继续^FF0000往北走^000000，快到弓箭手之村前，你会看到一个长得和我一模一样的男孩。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
To follow the Taekwon way, you have to get to job level 10. To be a Taekwon, train yourself until you get to job level 10!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
想走跆拳之道，就得先把职业等级升到10级。努力训练，成为跆拳吧！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
If you feel difficult in training alone, make a visit to the trainer on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
要是觉得独自训练很辛苦，就去一楼找那位教练吧。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Ahahaha.. It is already time? While I am inside... Don't worry.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
啊哈哈...已经到时间了吗？我还在里面呢...别担心。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Have a good day!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
祝你今天愉快！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
If you are interested in being a Taekwon making a healthy body with strong sprit, you can learn a lot here.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
如果你想成为跆拳，锻炼强健的体魄和坚定的精神，这里有很多东西可以学。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
What do you think? Are you interested in being a Taekwon? I don't push you to do! But if you do, I may become your trainer.. So..
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
怎么样？想成为跆拳吗？我不会勉强你！不过你要是愿意，我可以当你的教练...怎么样？

scripts.text: I have interest!
scripts.translation: 我有兴趣！

scripts.text: I have interest in you!
scripts.translation: 我对你有兴趣！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Is that so!? You are!? Yaho! Now I am a teacher! Now, ask me whatever!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
真的吗！？你真的愿意！？耶！我现在也是老师了！想问什么尽管问！

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Hahaha.. You are interested in me?
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
哈哈哈...你是对我有兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Suddenly, you see Arang's foot flying towards you.
scripts.translation: 阿朗突然朝你飞踢过来。

scripts.text: All you see are stars...
scripts.translation: 你眼前直冒金星...

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You look like a naive beginner? If you want to get in the class, come after registering on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你看起来还是个没经验的新人。想参加课程的话，先去一楼登记再回来。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Are you diligently training? Once you are trained well, you could become a Taekwon Master or a Soul Linker.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你训练得很努力吧？练得足够强之后，就能成为拳圣或悟灵士。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
You became a nice Taekwon Master!? Please keep in mind power is followed by responsibility.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
你已经成为出色的拳圣了！？记住，能力越大，责任越大。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Handling spirits is a very delicate job to do, I heard. Excellent! The adventurer led by me has grown up like this.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
听说操控灵魂是一项非常细致的工作。太棒了！我带出来的冒险者已经成长到这一步了。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
Ehra! I thought you followed the Taekwon way~~ it is regretful but everyone has their own life, hehe.
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
哎呀！我还以为你会走跆拳之道呢～～虽然有点遗憾，不过每个人都有自己的路，哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Arang]
I am propagating the way of Taekwons!
scripts.translation:
[阿朗]
我正在推广跆拳之道！

scripts.text:
As I can't recall, I feel the shock that something hit me on my head.
^FF0000I should look for somebody to heal me nearby.^000000.
scripts.translation:
我想不起发生了什么，只觉得头上挨了一下。
^FF0000得去附近找人帮我治疗。^000000

scripts.text: Why are you carrying so much with you? Unload it somewhere and come back.
scripts.translation: 你怎么带了这么多东西？先找地方存起来再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Emmm. This is?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
嗯...这是？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You were never trained by me.
Then, I have no interest in you.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
你没有接受过我的训练。
那我也没什么可教你的。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I see you received a complete education in Payon.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
看来你在斐扬接受了完整的训练。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Then again... you may want to learn more.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
不过...也许你还想再多学一些。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Either way, there is nothing I can teach you.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
不管怎样，我已经没什么能教你的了。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Ah~ You've become a skilled Archer.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
啊～你已经是个熟练的弓箭手了。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
The difference is great now compared to when you were a novice!
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
和你还是初心者时相比，进步可真大！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Because of my teachings, you have grown very fast!
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
多亏了我的教导，你才能进步这么快！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Sniff sniff! It is the smell of a novice!
Nice to meet you!!!
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
嗅嗅！这是初心者的气息！
见到你真高兴！！！
你来这儿做什么？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I can guess most, but hehehehe~~
Please feel comfortable and tell me everything you want!
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
我大概猜得到，嘿嘿嘿～～
放轻松，想问什么尽管说！

scripts.text: I get bored! Play with me!
scripts.translation: 我好无聊！陪我玩！

scripts.text: Tell me about Archers.
scripts.translation: 跟我说说弓箭手吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
What? Bored? Play with you?
You think this is just some kids playground?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
什么？无聊？要我陪你玩？
你当这儿是小孩子的游乐场吗？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you are bored, walk around and punch a monster in the face and see what happens.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
无聊的话就出去走走，朝魔物脸上揍一拳，看看会怎样。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Oh dear~ another sheep here to get a free lesson from me.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
哎呀～又来个想白听我课的愣头青。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
The main point of Archers is to use bows to attack enemies quickly from a long distance.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
弓箭手最擅长用弓箭从远处迅速攻击敌人。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Only problem is they are physically weak.
But, it doesn't matter if they are trained correctly.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
唯一的缺点是身板比较弱。
不过，只要训练得当就不是问题。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
What do you want to know about an Archer? I will tell you everything~
With my full explanation~, you can be an excellent one.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
想了解弓箭手的什么？我都可以告诉你～
听完我的详细讲解，你也能成为出色的弓箭手。

scripts.text: Archer's stats
scripts.translation: 弓箭手的属性

scripts.text: Archer's skills
scripts.translation: 弓箭手的技能

scripts.text: I want to become an Archer.
scripts.translation: 我想成为弓箭手

scripts.text: Nevermind
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Are you curious about the Archer's stats?
Do you know the most necessary stats for Archers?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
对弓箭手的属性感兴趣吗？
你知道弓箭手最需要哪项属性吗？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
That is ^0000cdDex^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
那就是^0000cd灵巧（DEX）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
To raise up the attacking power in other jobs, Str should be raised but Archers vary in accordance with their Dex figures.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
其他职业通常要提升力量（STR）来增加攻击力，弓箭手则主要靠灵巧（DEX）。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Here is a simple question! What is the name of the stat determining the Archer's attacking power?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
来个简单的问题！决定弓箭手攻击力的属性是什么？

scripts.text: Dex!
scripts.translation: 灵巧（DEX）！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You are correct~~
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
答对了～～

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you want to know more about the role of other stats, ^0000cdopen the status window by pressing ALT+Q.^000000
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
想了解其他属性的作用，就^0000cd按 Alt + Q 打开属性窗口。^000000

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you are curious about stats except Dex, you can check it out.
If you have a job later, you can reset the stats anyway.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
想了解灵巧以外的属性，可以自己看看。以后转职了，反正还能重置属性。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Hey, just click this and that!
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
喏，点这里，再点那里就行！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Hmm. You are interested in skills? Then, let's study ^0000cdskill^000000s.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
嗯，对技能感兴趣？那我们来看看^0000cd技能^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I thought you would better experience the skill than talking, so I prepared the experience of the archer's skill in a manual.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
光听我讲不如亲自试试，所以我把弓箭手技能的体验内容整理进了手册。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Archer have a lot of very useful skills.
But regretfully as most of them are skills useful only with arrows and bows, you can't experience them.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
弓箭手有很多实用技能。
可惜大多数技能都得配合弓箭使用，所以没法在这里体验。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
There is a useful skill without a bow... Called ^0000cdImprove Concentration^000000
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
有个实用技能不需要弓箭...叫作^0000cd心神凝聚^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
At the same time, it will reveal hidden enemies nearby.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
它还能同时显现附近隐匿的敌人。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
If you want to know more anout skill, then open the skill window by pressing the key  ^0000cdALT+S^000000
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
想了解更多技能，就按^0000cdAlt + S^000000打开技能窗口。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
When you scoll the mouse on the skill icon, there pops up the details about the skill. Please read it.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
把鼠标停在技能图标上，就会显示技能详情。记得看看。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
To use skills, click the skill icon on the skill window. Then drag and register it on the ^0000cdshortcut window^000000 to use conveniently.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
要使用技能，先点击技能窗口里的技能图标，再把它拖到^0000cd快捷栏^000000，使用起来更方便。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Will you go and find a hunting teacher on the 1st floor? if you do not want, then no need.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
要去一楼找狩猎教练吗？不想去也没关系。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
But he may train you with a lot of useful hunting skills for you.
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[Battle Trainer Subino]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>
You may visit him.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
不过，他能教你不少实用的狩猎技巧。
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[战斗训练师 苏比诺]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>
你可以去找他。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Do you want to become an^0000cd Archer^000000?
It hasn't been a long time since we met together. But I am sad about saying good bye to you.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
你想成为^0000cd弓箭手^000000吗？
我们才刚认识不久，一想到要和你道别，我还真有点舍不得。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Let me check a little while, before you change your job you have to be at job level 10.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
我先确认一下：转职前，你的职业等级必须达到10级。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Change conditions satisfied!!
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
转职条件已满足！！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Do you really want to become an Archer?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
你真的想成为弓箭手吗？

scripts.text: Yes, change me to an Archer.
scripts.translation: 是的，帮我转职为弓箭手

scripts.text: Let me think of it a little while.
scripts.translation: 让我再考虑一下

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
First, let me explain some things to you about the Job Change.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
转职前，我先跟你说明几件事。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
An Archer's hometown is ^0000cdPayon^000000; Which has a very long history.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
弓箭手的故乡是^0000cd斐扬^000000，一座历史悠久的城镇。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
When you are feeling fatigued, you can go there.
You will be given a warm hometown welcome.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
累了的话就回去看看吧。
那里的人会像家人一样热情地欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
The Archers Guild is located to the ^0000cdNorth of Payon Archer Village^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
弓箭手公会位于^0000cd斐扬弓箭手村北边^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
I will take you to the gates of Payon.
I would love to accompany you the rest of the way, but you must do this alone.
I'll give you the directions which you must remember.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
我会送你到斐扬城门口。
真想陪你走完剩下的路，不过那段路得由你独自走。
我告诉你路线，你可要记好了。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Here is where I will send you to.
Once you arrive, you will see the area marked by this ^0000cdRed Circle^000000. Go through there, then...
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
我会把你送到这里。
到了以后，先找到这个^0000cd红圈^000000标记的地方，从那里穿过去...

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You will reach the village of Payon.
Follow the direction of the ^0000cdRed Arrow^000000, you will enter ^0000cdArcher Village^000000.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
穿过去就能到斐扬村。
沿着^0000cd红色箭头^000000走，就能进入^0000cd弓箭手村^000000。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Once you get there, make your way to the ^0000cdCircled Area^000000. Here you will find the ^0000cdArcher Job Change Guild^000000.
Got it? Easy to find, right?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
到了之后，前往^0000cd圈出的区域^000000，那里就是^0000cd弓箭手转职公会^000000。
记住了吗？很好找吧？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Due to satellite navigation, you shouldn't worry about getting lost.
However, if you are still worried, you can ask the local ^0000cdGuide^000000 where to go.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
现在有卫星导航，不用担心迷路。
要是还是不放心，就问问当地的^0000cd向导^000000该怎么走。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You can find me after your visit to the guild.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
拜访完公会后再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Now then, I wish you success in becoming an Archer. Until next time!
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
祝你顺利成为弓箭手。回头见！

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Yes, come back and see me after reconsideration.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
好好考虑清楚，再回来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Hmmm. You are a little bit short of Job Level.
Are you coming back after more training?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
嗯，你的职业等级还差一点。
继续训练之后再回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Visit <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Battle Trainer Subino]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>
at Armory on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
去一楼军械库找<NAVI>^4D4DFF[战斗训练师 苏比诺]^000000<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83,</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Really? Then, don't be lazy but get some training.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
是吗？那就别偷懒，去好好训练吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Why are you still here? Are you not going to become an Archer?
Are you going to pursue a different job?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
你怎么还在这儿？不打算成为弓箭手了吗？
还是想选择别的职业？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Well? How is it being an Archer?
The student has surpassed the teacher, as the saying goes.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
怎么样，当弓箭手感觉如何？
俗话说，青出于蓝而胜于蓝嘛。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
You don't seem to be fully registered at the Academy yet.
Hurry and complete your registration.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
你好像还没完成学院的注册手续。
快去办好吧。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Did you directly come here without the entrance application for Critura Academy yet?
You are too in a hurry. Rush to go to the 1st floor for application, and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
你还没去克里图拉学院办入学申请，就直接跑来了吗？
也太心急了吧。快去一楼申请，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Why are you of a different job snooping around here?
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
你一个其他职业的人，在这里鬼鬼祟祟地做什么？

scripts.text:
[Marlbron]
Don't snoop around and get out of here!!
scripts.translation:
[马尔布朗]
别在这里东张西望，快出去！！

scripts.text: - Quest cannot be continued due to your overfilled inventory. -
scripts.translation: - 背包已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You want to learn about Swordsman?
If you want to take the class you must register.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
想了解剑士吗？
想参加课程的话，得先登记。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go and register at the counter on the 1st floor!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
去一楼柜台登记！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You want to become a swordsman?
Great decision.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
你想成为剑士？
眼光不错。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Fight on the frontline with large swords,
Bringing victory and with a high defense to protect your comrades.
Simply put, we're the best.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
手持大剑冲锋陷阵，为同伴抵挡攻击、守住防线，带领大家走向胜利。
简单说，我们就是最强的。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
What do you think?
You want to become a Swordsman here?
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
怎么样？
想在这里成为剑士吗？

scripts.text: No thanks
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢

scripts.text: I want to test Swordsman Skills!
scripts.translation: 我想体验剑士技能！

scripts.text: Change me right now!
scripts.translation: 现在就帮我转职！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Since you're not interested in this opportunity,
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
既然你对这个机会没兴趣，

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go hunt Porings and stay
as a novice forever!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
那就继续去打波利，永远当初心者吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Calm down, lets's start over.
First, I'll give you a ^FF0000Swordman Manual^000000
Read it carefuly before asking any questions.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
冷静点，我们重新来过。
先给你一本^FF0000剑士入门手册^000000。
有问题之前，先仔细读一读。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you want to become a Swordman,
You should reach over ^006400Base level 10^000000,
And become more than ^006400beginner's skill level 9^000000.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
想成为剑士，
^006400基础等级必须达到10级^000000，
而且^006400初心者基本技能等级必须达到9级以上^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Get taught here and follow the steps.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
先在这里接受指导，再按步骤来。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your change into a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
看来你已经学得差不多了。
去剑士公会继续办理转职吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
剑士公会就在依斯鲁得广场中央的西边，
很好找。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you are equipped with a ^FF0000Swordman Manual^000000
You'll be able to experience the basic skills of the swordsman.
Now let's study the basics of Swordsman skills.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
装备^FF0000剑士入门手册^000000后，
就能体验剑士的基础技能。
现在来学学这些技能吧。

scripts.text: Swordman key points
scripts.translation: 剑士要点

scripts.text: Heightened Attack and defense.
scripts.translation: 提高攻击力与防御力

scripts.text: Related stats
scripts.translation: 相关属性

scripts.text: Additional Swordman classes?
scripts.translation: 剑士的进阶职业？

scripts.text: I learned enough already.
scripts.translation: 我已经学得差不多了

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Swordsman uses strong constitution; shrugs off damage easily from foes and when in a party, is a leader and the protector of others.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
剑士体格强健，能轻松扛住敌人的攻击。在队伍中，他们既是领袖，也是同伴的守护者。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Swordsman prefer to use spears, two-handed swords or combination sword and shield.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
剑士常用长矛、双手剑，或一手持剑、一手持盾。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Also the swordsman's vitality is normally high making them able to carry massive amounts of weight.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
剑士的体质通常很高，因此负重能力也很强。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Desired stats are usually ^0000FFStr^000000, ^0000FFAgi^000000, ^0000FFVit^000000, ^0000FFDex^000000
Of course this is all up to you
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
常见的属性配点是^0000FF力量^000000、^0000FF敏捷^000000、^0000FF体质^000000和^0000FF灵巧^000000。
当然，怎么分配还是由你决定。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
^0000FFVit^000000 affects ^FF0000HP recovery rate^000000.
^0000FFStr^000000 affects ^FF0000strength and attacking power^000000.
^0000FFDex^000000 increases ^FF0000accuracy of your attack^000000,

[Trainer Adric]
^0000FFAgi^000000 increases ^FF0000attacking speed^000000 and ^FF0000evasion rate^000000,
^0000FFLuk^000000 affects ^FF0000probability of critical^000000.

[Trainer Adric]
After changing to a Swordsman you can change to a ^0000FFKnight^000000 or ^0000FFCrusader^000000.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
转职为剑士后，可以继续转职为^0000FF骑士^000000或^0000FF十字军^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go raise your strength while figuring out if you're offensive or defensive.
This is something you should do.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
努力提升力量，同时想清楚自己更偏向进攻还是防守。这些都得由你自己决定。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The study material can be retaught by Neals the assitant trainer.
Remember this.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
想复习课程内容，可以找助理训练师尼尔斯。记住了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Using the Swordman Manual I gave you train by hunting monsters.
Go to the Battle Instructor Subino on the first floor Armory room.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
拿着我给你的剑士入门手册去狩猎魔物，好好训练。
记得去一楼军械库找战斗训练师苏比诺。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Raise your level to ^006400job level 10^000000 and get to ^006400beginner's skill level 9^000000, come back here again.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
把职业等级升到^00640010级^000000，并将^006400初心者基本技能升到9级^000000，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Since you have enough job levels,
you don't need any more lecturing.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
你的职业等级已经够了，
不用再听我讲课了。

scripts.text: Then I will stop.
scripts.translation: 那我先走了。

scripts.text: But I want to listen more.
scripts.translation: 可我还想多听一些。

scripts.text: I want to be a Swordsman right away!
scripts.translation: 我想马上转职为剑士！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You surpassed the study material to raise your level.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
你的等级已经超过教材涵盖的进度了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Impressive.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
真不错。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
There's nothing else special to teach you.
Everything I taught you if you remember them well, that's all you need.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
没什么特别的内容可教你了。
只要把我教的东西都记牢，就足够了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you need additional training,
Go to the Battle Instructor Subino
on the first floor Armory room.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
还需要进一步训练的话，
就去一楼军械库找战斗训练师苏比诺。

scripts.text: This is very tedious.
scripts.translation: 这也太麻烦了。

scripts.text: I need more training.
scripts.translation: 我还需要更多训练。

scripts.text: I want to be a Swordsman right away!
scripts.translation: 我想马上转职为剑士！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
A simple No would've sufficed.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
直接说“不”就行了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go to the Battle Instructor Subino on the first floor Armory room.
If you think you're ready, come back here.
You need to change to a Swordsman job soon!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
去一楼军械库找战斗训练师苏比诺。
觉得准备好了就回来找我。
你得尽快转职为剑士！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your transfer to a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
看来你已经学得差不多了。
去剑士公会继续办理剑士转职吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
剑士公会就在依斯鲁得广场中央的西边，
很好找。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your change into a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
看来你已经学得差不多了。
去剑士公会继续办理转职吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
剑士公会就在依斯鲁得广场中央的西边，
很好找。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You still don't have enough to become a Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
你还没达到转职为剑士的条件。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
If you need some battle training find Subino on the first floor Armory of the Academy.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
需要战斗训练的话，就去学院一楼军械库找苏比诺。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
It seems you have learned enough.
Head over to the Swordsman Guild
to continue your change into a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
看来你已经学得差不多了。
去剑士公会继续办理转职吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
The Swordsman Guild is located
to the west of the Izlude Plaza Center.
It should be very easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
剑士公会就在依斯鲁得广场中央的西边，
很好找。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
During this period, you must train really hard.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
这段时间一定要刻苦训练。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Continue to improve your abilities to change to an amazing job!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
继续提升实力，转职成为更出色的职业吧！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
You're already a Swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
你已经是剑士了！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
There's nothing else special to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
没什么特别的内容可教你了。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Hey! You already have a job!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
喂！你已经有职业了！

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
Go away!
scripts.translation:
[训练师 阿德里克]
走开！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
You want to learn about Swordsman?
If you want to take the class you must register and come back here.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
想了解剑士吗？
想参加课程的话，先登记，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
As you are at the enough job level, you don't need any more lecturing.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
你的职业等级已经够了，不用再听课了。

scripts.text: Then I will stop.
scripts.translation: 那我先走了。

scripts.text: Become a swordsman right away!
scripts.translation: 现在就转职为剑士！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Before the training starts, you already raised your level.
Impressive.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
训练还没开始，你就已经升级了。
真厉害。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
It seems that you have fully grown.
Head to the Swordsman Guild to become a swordsman!
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
看来你已经训练有成。
去剑士公会正式转职为剑士吧！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
The Swordsman Guild is located in Izlude square
From the center, go west.
It should be easy to find.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
剑士公会在依斯鲁得广场中央往西的地方。
很好找。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
You are now a swordsman!
There's nothing else special to teach you.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
你现在已经是剑士了！
我没什么特别的内容可教你了。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
You already have another job!
Go away!
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
你已经转职成别的职业了！
快走开！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Let's repeat the prerequisite of Swordsmanhood, this is a review study!
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
我们来复习一下成为剑士的条件吧！

scripts.text: Swordman key points
scripts.translation: 剑士要点

scripts.text: Heightened Attack and defense.
scripts.translation: 提高攻击力与防御力

scripts.text: Related stats
scripts.translation: 相关属性

scripts.text: Additional Swordman classes?
scripts.translation: 剑士的进阶职业？

scripts.text: I learned enough already.
scripts.translation: 我已经学得差不多了

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Swordsman uses strong constitution; shrugs off damage easily from foes and when in a party, is a leader and the protector of others.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
剑士体格强健，能轻松抵挡敌人攻击。在队伍中，他们是领袖，也是同伴的守护者。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Swordsman prefer to use spears, two-handed swords or combination sword and shield.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
剑士常用长矛、双手剑，或一手持剑、一手持盾。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Also the swordsman's vitality is normally high making them able to carry massive amounts of weight.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
剑士的体质通常很高，所以负重能力也很强。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Desired stats are usually ^0000FFStr^000000, ^0000FFAgi^000000, ^0000FFVit^000000, ^0000FFDex^000000 Of course this is all up to you
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
常见的属性配点是^0000FF力量^000000、^0000FF敏捷^000000、^0000FF体质^000000和^0000FF灵巧^000000。当然，怎么分配还是由你决定。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
^0000FFVit^000000 affects^FF0000HP recovery rate^000000.
^0000FFStr^000000 affects ^FF0000strength and attacking power^000000.
^0000FFDex^00000 increases ^FF0000accuracy of your attack^000000.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
^0000FF体质^000000影响^FF0000生命值恢复速度^000000。
^0000FF力量^000000影响^FF0000力量和攻击力^000000。
^0000FF灵巧^00000可以提高^FF0000攻击命中率^000000。

scripts.text:
[Trainer Adric]
^0000FFAgi^000000 increases ^FF0000attacking speed^000000 and ^FF0000evasion rate^000000.
^0000FFLuk^000000 affects ^FF0000probability of critical ^000000.

[Assitant Trainer Neals]
After changing to a Swordsman you can change to a ^0000FFKnight ^000000or ^0000FFCrusader^000000.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
转职为剑士后，可以继续转职为^0000FF骑士^000000或^0000FF十字军^000000。

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Go raise your strength while figuring out if you're offensive or defensive.
This is something you should do.
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Let's repeat the prequisite of swordsmanhood,
this is a review study!
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
提升力量的同时，也想想自己更偏向进攻还是防守，这些都得由你自己决定。
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
我们再复习一下成为剑士的条件吧！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Ask again anytime.
I'll answer everything!
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
随时都可以再来问我。
我知无不言！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Let's repeat the prequisite of swordsmanhood,
this is a review study!
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
我们来复习一下成为剑士的条件吧！

scripts.text:
[Assitant Trainer Neals]
Feeble people like you can become a gallant Swordsman soon.
Yes, you can. Be ambitious.
scripts.translation:
[助理训练师 尼尔斯]
像你这样弱不禁风的人，也能很快成为英勇的剑士。
没错，你一定行！要有志气。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
I am the one in charge of magic studies in Criatura Academy
^0000FFA genius Mage^000000~!
^0000FFMage Chuck^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
我负责克里图拉学院的魔法教学，
是位^0000FF天才魔法师^000000～！
我就是^0000FF魔法师查克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Someone like you who has magic talent but doesn't know how to become a Mage.
For a ^FF0000Novice^000000 like you I'm offering my training.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
你这样有魔法天赋，却不知道怎么成为魔法师的人，
正是我^FF0000初心者^000000训练课程的对象。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
How about it?
Do you wanna try out my priceless lessons?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
怎么样？
想不想听听我这无价的课程？

scripts.text: I will learn.
scripts.translation: 我要学。

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you don't listen to me, you'll regret of it.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
不听我的话，你会后悔的。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
When you change your mind, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
改变主意了就再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Good! If that's your decision, I will do my best.
How much you learn depends on your own effort.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
很好！既然你决定了，我一定尽力教你。
能学到多少，就看你自己有多努力了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
To become a Mage, you need to be very studious.
Ask me what you want to learn!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
想成为魔法师，就得勤奋好学。
告诉我你想了解什么吧！

scripts.text: What is a Mage's primary role?
scripts.translation: 魔法师的主要职责是什么？

scripts.text: What ^8B4513stats^000000 are good for Mage?
scripts.translation: 哪些^8B4513属性^000000适合魔法师？

scripts.text: What are Mage's ^8B4513skill^000000s?
Can I try some skills?!
scripts.translation: 我可以试试技能吗？！

scripts.text: I want to ^8B451Cchange job^000000 to Mage!
scripts.translation: 我想^8B451C转职^000000为魔法师！

scripts.text: I'll get back to you later
scripts.translation: 我晚点再来。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
A Mage's primary role is to use magic to inflict powerful attacks.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
魔法师的主要职责，就是施展魔法发动强力攻击。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
We have low defense but have various attack ^006400skills^000000.
Be careful about the damage you take as a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
我们的防御力比较低，但拥有各种攻击^006400技能^000000。
当魔法师可得小心别受伤。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you remember these little things you can become a great Mage.
Walk with pride as you grow in magic power~
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
记住这些小要点，你也能成为出色的魔法师。
随着魔力增长，昂首挺胸地前进吧～

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
还想了解魔法师的其他事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Doesn't a Mage remind you something solid?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
说到魔法师，你会不会想到某种坚实的东西？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Sheer physical force is for brutes who increase their ^006400STR^000000.
For a ^0000FFgenius Mage^000000 like myself that's a waste.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
只会提升^006400力量^000000、靠蛮力战斗的人才需要体格。
对我这样的^0000FF天才魔法师^000000来说，那简直是浪费。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Become wise and clever with your^006400 mind power^000000.
This is Mage's primary attribute- ^006400INT^000000, it's what's most important!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
提升^006400智力^000000，让自己变得睿智又机敏。
这是魔法师最重要的属性——^006400智力^000000！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you remember these little things you can become a great Mage.
Walk with pride as you grow in magic power~
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
记住这些小要点，你也能成为出色的魔法师。
随着魔力增长，昂首挺胸地前进吧～

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
还想了解魔法师的其他事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Mages have powerful magical skills.
The basis of these skills are the attributes ^006400<Water, Wind, Earth, Fire>^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
魔法师能施展强力的魔法技能。
这些技能以^006400<水、风、土、火>^000000四种属性为基础。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
As each element has its own^006400 range attack magic^000000, these are useful when dealing with many enemies~!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
每种属性都有自己的^006400范围攻击魔法^000000，对付一群敌人时特别好用～！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ok enough talk.
I will show you my power by offering a demonstration.
You should be honored to be witnessing this!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
好了，不说了。
我来给你展示一下真正的实力。
能亲眼见证可要好好珍惜！

scripts.text: [Mage Chuck]
scripts.translation: [魔法师 查克]

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Detecting hidden enemies
^006400Sight^000000 !!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
探测附近隐匿的敌人
^006400火狩^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Deflect all physical attacks
^006400Safety Wall^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
抵挡所有物理攻击
^006400暗之障壁^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Fire damage premier ~!!!
^006400Fire Ball^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
感受火系伤害的巅峰～！！！
^006400火球术^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Wall of Fire~!!
^006400Fire Wall^000000!!!!

[Mage Chuck]
Want a taste of thunder?
^006400Lightening Bolt^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
想尝尝雷电的滋味吗？
^006400雷击术^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Get lost in the storm!
^006400Thunder Storm^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
在风暴中迷失吧！
^006400雷暴术^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
What killed the dinosaurs?
The Ice Age!
^006400Frost Diver^000000!!!!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
恐龙是怎么灭绝的？
冰河时代！
^006400冰冻术^000000！！！！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Doesn't it shake your heart to see my skills?
You won't get hurt so don't worry~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
看到我的技能，难道不觉得热血沸腾吗？
别担心，你不会受伤的～！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
还想了解魔法师的其他事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
I think you already received a ^FF0000Mage Manual^000000~!
I can't offer you two of them.
One is good enough~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
我想你已经拿到^FF0000魔法师入门手册^000000了～！
一本就够了，我可不能再给你一本。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Try out the skills after equipping the^006400 Mage Manual^000000.
Then hunt with the skills given to you in your skill window.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
装备^006400魔法师入门手册^000000后，就能试用这些技能。
再用技能窗口里学到的技能去狩猎吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
还想了解魔法师的其他事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Right, you must be set with your heart firm on becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
很好～看来你已经下定决心要成为魔法师了。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
OK! Then I'll give you a chance to taste what it is to become a Mage.
Take this ^006400Mage Manual^000000.
I'll let you borrow it!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
好！我就让你体验一下成为魔法师的感觉。
拿着这本^006400魔法师入门手册^000000，我借给你用！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Try out the skills after equipping the^006400 Mage Manual^000000.
Then hunt with the skills given to you in your skill window.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
装备^006400魔法师入门手册^000000后，就能试用这些技能。
再用技能窗口里学到的技能去狩猎吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
It's a valuable item so don't lose it.
If you want to become a genius ^0000FFMage^000000 like me, follow in my path.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
这是贵重物品，别弄丢了。
想成为像我一样的^0000FF天才魔法师^000000，就跟着我的脚步走吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you want to become a Mage lighten up your inventory load.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
想转职为魔法师，就先把背包清空一些。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Anything else you want to know about Mages?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
还想了解魔法师的其他事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ah~ you want to change to a magician?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
啊～你想转职为魔法师吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
I seem to have used a great deal of magic sending you before...
Because of too many students like you, I cannot send you again!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
刚才为了把你送过去，我好像耗费了不少魔力...
像你这样的学生实在太多了，我没法再送你一次！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
If you really want to go, then please go speak to the Kafra Staff and use their Teleport Service.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
真想过去的话，就去找卡普拉职员使用传送服务吧。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ah~ you want to change to a magician?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
啊～你想转职为魔法师吗？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
To change your job to a magician, you must visit the Magician's Guild.
I can send you close to there, but...
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
要转职为魔法师，得去魔法师公会。
我可以把你送到附近，不过...

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You must first reach ^006400Job level 10^000000 and ^006400Basic Skill level 9^000000.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
你得先达到^006400职业等级10级^000000，并将^006400基本技能升到9级^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You don't seem ready!
If you want to change your job, you must first be ^006400Job level 10^000000 and ^006400Basic Skill level 9^000000.
Then come back and see me!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
你看起来还没准备好！
想要转职，必须先达到^006400职业等级10级^000000，并将^006400基本技能升到9级^000000。
达到条件后再回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
What else do you want to know about magicians?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
关于魔法师，你还想了解什么？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Ah, it seems that you already have those requirements!
Do you want to change your job immediately?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
啊，看来你已经满足转职条件了！
现在就要转职吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Okay, when you have decided please come back!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
好，决定好了就回来找我！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
What else do you want to know about magicians?
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
关于魔法师，你还想了解什么？

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
In that case, I'll use magic to send you near ^8B4513Geffen^000000, where the Magician's Guild is.
It is there that you will be able to become a magician.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
那我用魔法把你送到^8B4513吉芬^000000附近，魔法师公会就在那儿。
你可以在那里转职为魔法师。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Once I send you, you will speak to the ^0000FFMage's Guild Guide^000000.
They will be able to assist you further.
Let's go! I'm ready to send you there!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
我送你过去后，记得找^0000FF魔法师公会向导^000000。
他会继续帮你办理转职。
走吧！我准备好送你过去了！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Whoosh Whoosh
Ooo... Ooo... Hum... Hmm!
Teleport!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
呼——呼——
哦...哦...嗯...嗯！
传送！

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
Yes~ Go meet other teachers then come back.
Of course, Mages are most alluring of them all.~
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
好～先去见见其他老师，再回来找我。
当然，魔法师才是最迷人的职业～

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You'll choose Mage again I have no doubt about it~~!!
Haha see you later~
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
我敢肯定，你最后还是会选魔法师~~！！
哈哈，回头见～

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
First you'll have to complete your ^8B4513registration^000000 at the Academy front desk.
If you go to the 1st floor of the academy someone will help you register.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
首先，得去学院前台完成^8B4513注册^000000。
到学院一楼就有人能帮你办理。

scripts.text:
[Mage Chuck]
You're no longer the innocent ^8b4513Novice^000000 who doesn't know anything~?
I don't have anything to teach you~!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师 查克]
你已经不是那个什么都不懂的^8b4513初心者^000000了吧～？
我没什么可教你的了～！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
It seems that you've come from Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
看来你是从克里图拉学院来的。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
You look a little exhausted...
Though.. to become a magician is exhausting in a way...
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
你看起来有点累...
不过，成为魔法师确实也挺耗神的...

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
First off, my task is to guide you to the Mage's guild!
Go straight to the right!
After ^8B4513crossing the bridge^000000, you will see the entrance to ^FF0000Geffen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
我的工作就是带你去魔法师公会！
一直往右走！
^8B4513过了桥^000000之后，就能看到^FF0000吉芬^000000的入口！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Once there,
You should find our <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Magician's Guild Guide]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>.
Speak to him, he will continue to guide you to the Magician's Guild!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
到了那里，
你会看到我们的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法师公会向导]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>。
和他谈谈，他会继续带你去魔法师公会！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
First off, my task is to guide you to the Mage's guild!
Go straight to the right!
After ^8B4513crossing the bridge^000000, you will see the entrance to ^FF0000Geffen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
我的工作就是带你去魔法师公会！
一直往右走！
^8B4513过了桥^000000之后，就能看到^FF0000吉芬^000000的入口！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Once there,
You should find our <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Magician's Guild Guide]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>.
Speak to him, he will continue to guide you to the Magician's Guild!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
到了那里，
你会看到我们的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法师公会向导]^000000<INFO>geffen,43,123,</INFO></NAVI>。
和他谈谈，他会继续带你去魔法师公会！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
I am in charge of bringing ^8B4513Criatura Academy^000000 students to the Mage's guild.
These days the academy has a lot of new students so I'm happy to be working.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
我负责带^8B4513克里图拉学院^000000的学生去魔法师公会。
最近学院来了很多新生，我也忙得很开心。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Ah, you made it all the way here. Very good for an academy student!
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
你居然一路走到了这里，真不愧是学院的学生！

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Before this step-by-step guide, they would get lost and frustrated.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
以前没有这样一步步的指引，学生们总会迷路，急得团团转。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Anyways, let's keep this short.
I will now tell you the route to the Mage's Guild!
The way to go is quite simple...
From here, go toward 11 o'clock, you will see the Mage's Guild.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
总之，长话短说。
我这就告诉你去魔法师公会的路线！
路很简单...
从这里朝11点钟方向走，就能看到公会。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Just go inside, and upstairs a little to find the
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[Mage Guildsman]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>
From there, he will assist you in becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
直接进去，再往楼上走一小段，就能找到
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法师公会成员]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>。
他会帮你转职为魔法师。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
The way to go is quite simple...
From here, go toward 11 o'clock, you will see the Mage's Guild.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
路很简单...
从这里朝11点钟方向走，就能看到魔法师公会。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
Just go inside, and upstairs a little to find the
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[Mage Guildsman]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>
From there, he will assist you in becoming a Mage.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
直接进去，再往楼上走一小段，就能找到
<NAVI>^4D4DFF[魔法师公会成员]^000000<INFO>geffen_in,164,124,</INFO></NAVI>。
他会帮你转职为魔法师。

scripts.text:
[Magician's Guild Guide]
I am in charge of bringing ^8B4513Criatura Academy^000000 students to the Mage's guild.
These days the academy has a lot of new students so I'm happy to be working.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会向导]
我负责带^8B4513克里图拉学院^000000的学生去魔法师公会。
最近学院来了很多新生，我也忙得很开心。

scripts.text: - As you are overloaded with so many items, quest can't be proceeded. -
scripts.translation: - 背包超重，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Ehm?
This class only for Novices just starting their adventure.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
嗯？
这门课程只面向刚开始冒险的初心者。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Looking at you, you seem like you need some help. How about going to another place?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
看起来你需要帮忙。要不要我带你去别处？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~
At a glance, hey, you like the lost baby sheep.. Here the non registered passengers are prohibited.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哦～
一看你就像只迷路的小羊羔...这里不允许未登记的乘客进入。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
If you want to look around this area without physical prohibiton, you would better register first at the info desk at the Academy entrance.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
想在这片区域自由活动的话，最好先去学院入口的信息台登记。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Ho Oh~
You look like you're ready to change to a first job.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哦～
看起来你已经准备好转职为一转职业了。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
How about it? Are you interested in the way of the Merchant? If so, I may be helpful for you.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
怎么样？你对商人这条路感兴趣吗？如果有兴趣，我可以帮你。

scripts.text: Not interest.
scripts.translation: 没兴趣

scripts.text: Interested.
scripts.translation: 感兴趣

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh.. No...
Well, there is no way. Our Criatura Academy put the priority to the adventurer's choice.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哦...这样啊...
好吧，没办法。克里图拉学院会优先尊重冒险者自己的选择。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Good~ Then, I will send you to the town of Alberta. There you can become a merchant.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
很好～那我就送你去艾尔贝塔。在那里你可以转职为商人。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Do not go elsewhere, immediately enter the town.
Find the <NAVI>[Forge]<INFO>alberta_in,75 48</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
别到处乱跑，直接进城。
找到<NAVI>[锻造屋]<INFO>alberta_in,75 48</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Not yet ready.
scripts.translation: 我还没准备好

scripts.text: I'm Ready!
scripts.translation: 我准备好了！

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, I understand. When you are ready, let me see you again.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
嗯，我明白了。准备好后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Good~ Please go to the Forge and find me.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
很好～去锻造屋找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~
Hey, you like a lost sheep. Do you know why you've come here?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哦～
嘿，你看起来像只迷路的小羊。知道自己为什么来这里吗？

scripts.text: Don't Know
scripts.translation: 不知道

scripts.text: Know.
scripts.translation: 知道

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh... you don't?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哦...你不知道啊？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~ you seem like a quick learner.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哦～你学得挺快嘛。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Well, I should at least give a briefing.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好吧，至少先给你简单介绍一下。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
I am ^0000ffSalim Hamid^000000 in charge with training the merchant course here at the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
我是^0000ff萨利姆·哈米德^000000，负责克里图拉学院的商人课程。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
This classroom is for Merchant applicants. In fact, this room is mainly for doing the finacial management of the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
这间教室是给商人课程学员用的。实际上，这里主要负责学院的财务管理。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Next time, if you want to observe the merchant course, you can visit me, Salim Hamid and register.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
下次想旁听商人课程的话，来找我萨利姆·哈米德登记就行。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~ You came back. Do you want to experience the Merchant training course? It is a little bit difficult to the average beginner.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哦～你回来啦。想体验商人培训课程吗？对一般的新手来说，这课稍微有点难。

scripts.text: No thanks!
scripts.translation: 不了，谢谢！

scripts.text: Sign me up!.
scripts.translation: 帮我报名！

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh~ though it is a bit hard, it is worth learning. Sadly, there's no other way.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哦～虽然有点难，但很值得学。可惜没有别的办法。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Oh, yes... Then, first will you register your name in this student list?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哦，对了...先在这份学员名单上写下你的名字吧？

scripts.text: Refuse.
scripts.translation: 不了

scripts.text: Put your name on the list.
scripts.translation: 把名字写在名单上

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Resistance from the beginning? This isn't the way to start training.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
一开始就打退堂鼓？这样可没法开始训练。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Ummm~ Your name is...
^0000ff{0}^000000...... right?

[Salim Hamid]
First to observe the Merchant course, you need to have the Merchant mindset. A trader with less than 100 zeny could not be called a Merchant.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
想旁听商人课程，首先要有商人的头脑。身上连100 Zeny都不到，可算不上商人。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
{0}^000000 come back to me with 100 Zeny in hand before the next class.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
{0}^000000，下次上课前记得带着100 Zeny来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Of course, that money won't be taken. It is only A test to see your basic mindset to being a Merchant. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
当然，我不会收走这笔钱。这只是测试你有没有成为商人的基本意识。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Wow, you really came back with 100 zeny in hand. I feel your desire to learn clearly.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哇，你真的带着100 Zeny回来了。我能感受到你求知的热情。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now. I will give you a Merchant's manual. Equipped with it. Press Alt + S key and look at the skill window.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好，我给你一本商人入门手册。装备上它，再按 Alt + S 打开技能窗口。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Clicking the [MISC] tab on the skill window, you can see the Merchant manual skills.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
点击技能窗口里的[杂项]标签，就能看到商人手册中的技能。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now~ as we should go to the next course, equip the guide and see the skill, then speak to me again.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
接下来要上下一堂课了。先装备手册，看看里面的技能，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Hohohong.. Test is not easy? Will you give it up now?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
呵呵呵...测试很难吗？现在要放弃了？

scripts.text: Can't do it.
scripts.translation: 我做不到

scripts.text: Give it up.
scripts.translation: 我放弃

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Will you? 100 zeny isn't hard to get pal.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
真要放弃吗？朋友，100 Zeny可不难赚。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, come back to me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好吧，改变主意后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now, how about attending the class concerning various basic skills which merchants should have for making money.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
接下来上一堂课，学学商人赚钱所需的各种基础技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
This might be better for you to learn from the steward working on the field next door. Go to him for the Merchant theory course, then return to me.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
隔壁田地里有位管家，或许他更适合教你。先去上商人理论课，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Haven't you gone to him for the class? Go to the steward next to me and return after completing the Merchant skill theory.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
你还没去上课吗？去我旁边找那位管家，学完商人技能理论后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Have you come after a good lesson from the steward concerning what a Merchant can do?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
你听完那位管家讲商人能做什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
By any chance, {0} do you have mind to learn more about Merchants here?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
对了，{0}，你还想在这里多了解一些商人的知识吗？

scripts.text: I will look around at more jobs.
scripts.translation: 我想再看看其他职业

scripts.text: Let me do it a little more.
scripts.translation: 我想再学一会儿

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, your open mind is good for you. As this academy has many other lecturers besides Merchants.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
很好～愿意多方了解对你有好处。学院里除了商人课程，还有很多其他讲师。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Whenever you feel like learning again, come back to me {0}.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
{0}，什么时候想继续学习，都可以回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Is that so? OK, now how about learning the major effects of Merchant's stats? If you are ready, speak to me.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
是吗？好，那我们来讲讲商人各项属性的主要作用。准备好了就跟我说。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Trader's stats are classified as two major series. One is for manufacturing, the other is for battle.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
商人的属性配点大致分为两类：一类用于制造，另一类用于战斗。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Of course, these are for farther down in the future. At this moment, you are even short of stats to invest DEX enabling you to hunt a monster.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
这些都是以后的事了。眼下你连打怪所需的灵巧（DEX）都还不够呢。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
But, there is a big difference between your knowledge of the basic rules and being ignorant of it.
Let's learn about it one by one.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
不过，懂得基本原则和一无所知可大不一样。
我们一项一项来学吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now, what series do we start with?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
那我们先从哪一类讲起？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now, what series do we start with?
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
那我们先从哪一类讲起？
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好，这堂课就到这里。
还想了解商人的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text: Already know it.
scripts.translation: 我已经知道了

scripts.text: Battle Stats.
scripts.translation: 战斗属性

scripts.text: Crafting Stats.
scripts.translation: 制造属性

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
It will be OK as it is, won't it?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
保持这样也没问题，对吧？

scripts.text: I already know all of them.
scripts.translation: 这些我都知道

scripts.text: Please make another explanation.
scripts.translation: 请再讲一遍

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes, you are {0} I am pleased to meet a quick-to-learn student like you. It also saves my time.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
没错，你就是{0}。能遇到像你这样一点就通的学生真好，也省了我的时间。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Aha~ I think I got you wrong. Let's start the lecture again.
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
啊～看来我误会你了。那我们重新开始讲吧。
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好，这堂课就到这里。
还想了解商人的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Being in a trader role, the stats affecting the figure of battle power are two ^4d4fffSTR & DEX^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
商人的战斗能力主要受两项属性影响：^4d4fff力量（STR）和灵巧（DEX）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
STR is related to the basic attacking power, DEX is to hit ratio and recovery from damage.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
力量（STR）影响基础攻击力，灵巧（DEX）则影响命中率和受伤后的恢复速度。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
In you future, according to the 2nd and 3rd jobs you choose, you can learn additional attacking stats such ^4d4fffINT or AGI^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
以后选择二转或三转职业后，还可以根据职业需求提升^4d4fff智力（INT）或敏捷（AGI）^000000等属性。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
To back up your shortage, you can increase LUK a little.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
也可以稍微提高一点幸运（LUK），弥补其他方面的不足。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Rather than worry yourself, it may be a good idea to learn from other Merchants. You know ask others for advice.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
别一个人闷头苦想，多向其他商人请教就好。遇到问题可以找人商量嘛。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Any other questions?
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
还有其他问题吗？
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好，这堂课就到这里。
还想了解商人的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
The stats concerning crafting is simpler than that concerning battle. Only difficulty is how to cultivate it.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
制造型商人的属性配点比战斗型简单，难点只在于怎么培养。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
It is common that you increase ^4d4fffDEX & LUK^000000 as the base and, if you have surplus, you invest the rest in ^4d4fffINT^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
通常以^4d4fff灵巧（DEX）和幸运（LUK）^000000为主，有剩余点数的话，再投到^4d4fff智力（INT）^000000上。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Of course, the allocation of the portion should be properly adjusted in accordance with your equipments and the status you are in.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
当然，具体怎么分配，还得看你的装备和当前状况。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
One thing you should keep in mind is it may be a very boring and ascetic way to grow alone as Merchant specializing in crafting.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
有一点要记住：专精制造的商人若是单打独斗，成长过程可能会很枯燥，也很艰苦。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
If possible, make use of your friends and their items if you can.
This is my personal opinion only.
It is absolutely not the official standpoint of the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
有需要的话，不妨请朋友帮忙，也借用一下他们的物品。
这只是我的个人意见，
绝不代表克里图拉学院的官方立场。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Any other questions?
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
还有其他问题吗？
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好，这堂课就到这里。
还想了解商人的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Then, it is the end of this class.
If you have more questions about Merchants, please make other visits.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好，这堂课就到这里。
还想了解商人的话，欢迎再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
You came back again. {0} this time, shall we have a practical training by doing a simple errand?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
你又回来啦。{0}，这次要不要做个简单的跑腿任务，来练习实战？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Can you see the noisy vending machine at the corner of this classroom? It was originally a soft drink vending machine but swallows coin very much...
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
看到教室角落那台吵闹的自动贩卖机了吗？它原本卖饮料，不过特别会吞硬币...

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Anyway, due to this reason, it is now being used for the trainees' practice of skills. Please check the prices for Garlet and Zargon.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
总之，现在学员会用它来练习技能。去查查加勒结晶和刹勒空结晶的价格吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
But! You should come back wit the information about ^4d4fffthe discounted prices equipped with the merchant's manual and applied with the discount rate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
不过！记得装备商人手册、使用折扣技能后，再把^4d4ffft折扣后的价格^000000带回来。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Don't buy them. Just come back with the checked prices only. Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
别买，只要查好价格回来告诉我就行。办得到吗？

scripts.text: I will do it next time.
scripts.translation: 我下次再做

scripts.text: I will do it.
scripts.translation: 我这就去

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
OK. Then you challenge it next time.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好，那下次再来挑战吧。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Good~ I will see you later.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好～回头见。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Yes. Let's see the prices you checked.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好，给我看看你查到的价格。

scripts.text: I will come back after rechecking them.
scripts.translation: 我再核对一遍就回来

scripts.text: Garlet 39z Zargon 450z
scripts.translation: 加勒结晶 39z／刹勒空结晶 450z

scripts.text: Garlet 37z Zargon 448z
scripts.translation: 加勒结晶 37z／刹勒空结晶 448z

scripts.text: Garlet 37z Zargon 446z
scripts.translation: 加勒结晶 37z／刹勒空结晶 446z

scripts.text: Garlet 37z Zargon 444z
scripts.translation: 加勒结晶 37z／刹勒空结晶 444z

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
OK. You come back after rechecking them in detail.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
好，仔细核对完再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
OK~ You correctly checked the prices equipped with Merchant's Manual.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
不错～你查到的是装备商人手册后的正确价格。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Perhaps, if you become a Merchant and use the high level of discount skill, you can buy what you want at much cheaper prices.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
等你成为商人后，把低价买进技能练高些，就能用更便宜的价格买到想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
The practice of overcharge will be the same.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
高价卖出也是同样的道理。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
You don't need to practice the overcharge as well. You experience it while selling items earned during the other courses.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
高价卖出不用特意练习。上其他课程时，把获得的物品卖掉就能体验了。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Now the Merchant training at the Academy is finished.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
学院的商人训练到此结束。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Did you correctly check them?
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
价格都查对了吗？

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
Hahaha. {0} you have completed the Merchant theory course at the Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
哈哈。{0}，你已经完成克里图拉学院的商人理论课程了。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
When you want to test the other battle skills in the Merchant's Manual,
visit <NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI> on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
想体验商人手册里的其他战斗技能，就去一楼找<NAVI>[战斗训练师 苏比诺]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
You can fully experience the battle related practice through him.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
你可以跟他充分练习战斗相关的内容。

scripts.text:
[Salim Hamid]
The guide for the next course {0} will be serviced when you reach job level 10. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[萨利姆·哈米德]
达到职业等级10后，就能参加下一门课程了，{0}。祝你好运。

scripts.text: - As you are overloaded with so many items, quest can't be proceeded.
scripts.translation: - 背包超重，无法继续任务。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Mr. Hamid sent you here. Nice to meet you. Being busy in organizing the account book, I will make time for you.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
哈米德先生让你来找我吧？幸会。我正忙着整理账簿，不过还是能抽空接待你。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
There are many ways to make margin on trading.. A threat, a concillation, black-market dealings, etc.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
做生意赚钱的手段可多了...威胁、和解、黑市交易，等等。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
If necessary, even various violent and bloody shortcuts (wow this guy is serious!)
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
必要时，还能走各种暴力血腥的捷径。（哇，这家伙还真敢说！）

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
OH wait, what did I tell you?
These are legally prohibited behaviors. So, Merchants will be given two skills. Those are ^4d4fffOvercharge and Discount^000000..
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
啊，等等，我刚才说了什么？
这些手段都违法。所以商人有两项技能：^4d4fff高价卖出和低价买进^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Besides, there are some other helpful skills such as ^4d4fffPush Cart Vending, Item Appraisal^000000 etc.. Which are not related directly to them though.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
此外还有一些实用技能，比如^4d4fff手推车、露天商店和物品鉴定^000000，不过它们和这两项技能没有直接关系。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Any questions among them?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
这些技能有什么想问的吗？

scripts.text: I already know all of them.
scripts.translation: 这些我都知道

scripts.text: Overcharge & Discount
scripts.translation: 高价卖出和低价买进

scripts.text: Other skills
scripts.translation: 其他技能

scripts.text: Item Appraisal
scripts.translation: 物品鉴定

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Really are you OK with it?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
你真的都清楚了吗？

scripts.text: Wait I know it all.
scripts.translation: 等等，我全都知道

scripts.text: No, please explain them again.
scripts.translation: 不，请再解释一遍

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Ho O~ You don't have any questions?
OK. You are a person of practice rather than of theory.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
哦～你没有问题吗？
好吧，看来你是重实践、轻理论的人。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
The additional lecture will be provided by Mr. Salim Hamid. Ah. I have something to give you.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
接下来的课程由萨利姆·哈米德先生负责。对了，我有样东西要给你。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
This is a box containing the defective equipments leaving from the inventory organization here.
Please practice the Item Appraisal skill in the Merchant Manual with it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
这是整理库存时清出来的一箱瑕疵装备。
用它来练习商人入门手册里的物品鉴定技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
I anticipate to see you next time in a good shape.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
希望下次见面时，你已经练得身手矫健。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Ho O~ Sorry but I got you wrong.
Let's start the class.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
哦～抱歉，是我误会你了。
那我们开始上课吧。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
It is simple to use Overcharge and Discount.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
高价卖出和低价买进都很容易使用。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
These two skills are passive skills. If you become familiar with these, {0} these will automatically perform in trading with merchant NPC without your operation.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
这两项都是被动技能。熟悉之后，{0}，和商人 NPC 交易时它们会自动生效，无需手动操作。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Once you've learned Overcharge, when selling commodities to a merchant NPC, you can gain the sales money composed of the regular sales price plus additional money as per the Overcharge skill level.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
学会高价卖出后，把商品卖给商人 NPC 时，除了正常售价，还能根据技能等级获得额外收入。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Oppositely, Discount is the skill, on your buying commodities from a merchant NPC, you can purchase it at the price discounted on the regular selling price as per the skill level.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
低价买进则相反：从商人 NPC 购买商品时，可以根据技能等级享受折扣。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Be carefult that these two skills are to be used only in trading with usual merchant's NPC, not with other manufacturing NPC or among adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
要注意，这两项技能只对普通商人 NPC 的交易有效，不能用于其他制造类 NPC，也不能用于冒险者之间的交易。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Do you have more questions?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Enlarge Weight Limit, Push Cart, Vending. These three skills have close relationships.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
负重量上升、手推车和露天商店这三项技能彼此密切相关。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
First talking about ^4d4fffEnlarge Weight Limit^000000 skill, is the skill to increase th character's basic earned points. It is an automatic operational passive skill when you learn it.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
先说说^4d4fff负重量上升^000000。这个技能可以提高角色的负重上限，学会后会自动生效。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
This earned point skill reaching a certain level, you can use the skill called ^4d4fffPush Cart^000000
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
负重量上升达到一定等级后，就能使用^4d4fff手推车^000000技能。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
But this Push Cart skill has the disadvantage of the slowdown of moving speed, though the advantage of high loading capacity.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
手推车技能的缺点是会降低移动速度，不过好处是负重能力大幅提升。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
When this Push Cart skill reaches at a certain level, you can use the skill called ^4d4fffVending^000000. This is used to sell your own items to other players.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
手推车达到一定等级后，就能使用^4d4fff露天商店^000000技能，把自己的物品卖给其他玩家。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Besides these, is there any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
除此之外，还有什么想问的吗？

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Item Appraisal skill is a supplementary skill rather than the essential one.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
物品鉴定属于辅助技能，并非必学技能。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
If you learn this skill you can identify items without having to use a Magnifying Glass Item.
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
学会这项技能后，不用放大镜也能鉴定物品。

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
Besides these, is there any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
除此之外，还有什么想问的吗？

scripts.text:
[Steward Aydin]
I am very busy clearing an account book, so how about talking next time?
scripts.translation:
[管家 艾丁]
我正忙着整理账簿，下次再聊吧？

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包已满，无法继续任务。
整理好物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.......... Then

[Mayssel]
I see, Lu make it as you want.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我知道了，卢，随你的意思吧。

scripts.text: Uh, hi...
scripts.translation: 呃，你好...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I am sorry...
Are you a student of Criatura Academy?
I didn't intend to ignore you.
He is also one of the students in this class.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
抱歉...
你是克里图拉学院的学生吧？
我不是故意不理你的。
他也是这堂课的学生。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Hello {0}
I am Mayssel  the section chief of the Veins section of the Assassin Guild.
I came here to give you some information about the Thief class.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你好，{0}。
我是梅塞尔，刺客公会伯仁斯分部的主管。
我来向你介绍盗贼职业。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Do you want to know about the Thief class?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
想了解盗贼这个职业吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好啊，麻烦你了。

scripts.text: No, I won't be a Thief.
scripts.translation: 不用了，我不打算当盗贼。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want it....
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你要是愿意的话...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Well a thief is commonly thought of as a criminal.
But our guild is not about taking from those that are in need of it.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
人们通常觉得盗贼就是罪犯。
不过，我们公会不会去偷生活困难之人的东西。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
First, we should make it clear.
We don't steal other's belongings.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
首先得说清楚：
我们不偷别人的财物。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
How about monsters?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
那魔物呢？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Now monsters...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
至于魔物嘛...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Hey, take it easy.
You said it was a mission for something important. But only a place like this...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
嘿，别激动。
你说是为了重要的任务才来的，可这里却只有这种地方...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I was upset...
Let me continue.
A Thief uses techniques that common thieves use to be fast and nimble.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我刚才有点激动...
让我接着说。
盗贼擅长运用各种技巧，行动迅速又灵活。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
We use stealth to blend into our surroundings and strike our foes.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我们会隐匿身形、融入周围环境，再伺机袭击敌人。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Our primary weapon is a dagger and we compensate their attack strength by adding poison property to our attacks.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我们的主要武器是短剑，并会给攻击附加毒属性，以弥补攻击力的不足。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
The higher class jobs in Thief class are Assassin and Rogue.
Verkhasel is a Guillotine Cross which is the third class of the Assassin Job.
and......
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
盗贼系的高阶职业有刺客和流氓。
维尔卡塞尔是十字斩首者，也就是刺客系的三转职业。
还有...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Mr. Vicente... I called Dumk..
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
维森特先生...我刚才叫的是邓克...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah, that is... Mayssel..
As you know well about Master.
I can explain about Rogues to you.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
啊，这个嘛...梅塞尔...
你也知道师父的情况。
我来给你介绍一下流氓职业吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see...
{0} Sorry but you can learn about the Shadow Chaser class from them.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我明白了...
{0}，抱歉，关于逐影猎人这个职业，你可以向他们请教。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Anyway, these two gentlemen will help you.
^4d4dffCome back to me after speaking to Verkhasel and Vicente.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
总之，这两位先生会帮你。
^4d4dff和维尔卡塞尔、维森特谈过之后，再回来找我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Have you learned something about Thief, Assassin and Rogue?
You don't need to understand everything right now.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
盗贼、刺客和流氓这几种职业，你都了解了吗？
现在不用什么都弄明白。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...
The next course is how to use the experience guide... Let's skim it over.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我只是负责让你知道还有这些职业...
下一堂课会教你怎么使用技能体验手册，我们先大致看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
The guide for skill experience provided by the academy can be used up to level 12.
Regretfully, only the explanation is available for you.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
学院提供的技能体验指南可以使用到12级。
遗憾的是，眼下只能给你讲解。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want to be a Thief, you just come back here.
I can help you with the 1st step of the job change.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
想成为盗贼的话，就回来找我。
我可以帮你办理转职的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
辛苦了，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I only play the role to inform you of there is this one that one...
Then, let's talk about the Thief's skills.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我只是负责让你知道还有这些职业...
接下来，我们来聊聊盗贼的技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will give you the guide to borrow the thief's skill temporarily.
Organize the guide items, you can see the useful skills on the 'ETC' skill window.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我借你一本手册，让你暂时体验盗贼技能。
装备手册后，就能在技能窗口的“杂项”标签页里看到实用技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
By making use of the guide, you may take the missions being asked by Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
使用这本手册，就能接取维尔卡塞尔和维森特委托的任务。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Verkhasel and Vicente will give you various information related to the higher class jobs.
So, come back to me after listening to them.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
维尔卡塞尔和维森特会告诉你各种高阶职业的相关知识。
听完他们的介绍后，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Preparation for real battle is next.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
接下来要准备实战了。

scripts.text: I see...
scripts.translation: 我明白了...

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不参加。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will compensate for you when your mission is completed.
Come back to me after speaking to Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
完成任务后，我会给你奖励。
和维尔卡塞尔、维森特谈过之后，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see..
This course is now cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我明白了...
那这门课就取消了。

You don't need to understand everything right now.

scripts.translation:

利用这本指南，就能接取维尔卡塞尔和维森特委托的任务。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Have you got a sense what it is to be a Thief?
If you want to use the skill like double attack, visit ^4d4dffMr. Subino on the 1st floor^000000.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你有没有体会到当盗贼是什么感觉？
想体验二刀连击等技能的话，就去^4d4dff一楼找苏比诺先生^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
<NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI> will give you several battle missions.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
<NAVI>[战斗训练师 苏比诺]<INFO>iz_ac01,59,83</INFO></NAVI>会给你安排几项战斗任务。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I hope you experience other skills with battle Quests.
Double attack is somewhat an exciting skill.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
希望你通过战斗任务体验其他技能。
二刀连击可是个很刺激的技能。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Make a decision after you've at least experienced it.
You still have a long way and enough time before you make a decision... Think of it deeply.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
至少亲自体验之后再做决定吧。
离你做决定还早着呢，时间也充裕...好好想清楚。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you want to be a Thief, you just come back here.
I can help you with the 1st step of the job change.
scripts.translation:

我可以帮你办理转职的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Thank you for you hard work.
scripts.translation:
