辛苦了，谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
In the battle training, the actual fighting is more important than theory.
To use the skill once is better than all this talking.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
战斗训练重在实战，理论没那么重要。
亲自用一次技能，胜过听我说半天。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you carry out the mission asked by Verkhasel and Vicente, I will go to the next class.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
完成维尔卡塞尔和维森特委托的任务后，我就带你上下一堂课。

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不参加。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I will compensate for you when your mission is complete.
Come back to me after listening to Verkhasel and Vicente.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
任务完成后，我会给你奖励。
听完维尔卡塞尔和维森特的介绍后，再回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I see.
This course is now cancelled.
The ongoing lower courses are cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
我明白了。
这门课现在取消。
目前正在进行的初级课程也会一并取消。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes, cancel the course.
scripts.translation: 是，取消课程

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Fortunately...
Good to see you have patience.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
幸好...
很高兴你愿意耐心听下去。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
All the ongoing courses are cancelled.
These are not your aptitude.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
所有正在进行的课程都已取消。
看来这些课程不适合你。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
What are you curious about?
If you want to know about battle, visit <NAVI>[Battle Trainer Subino]<INFO>iz_ac01_c,59,83</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你想了解什么？
想了解战斗的话，就去找<NAVI>[战斗训练师 苏比诺]<INFO>iz_ac01_c,59,83</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text: Change job to Thief.
scripts.translation: 转职为盗贼

scripts.text: Thief Stat Explanation
scripts.translation: 盗贼属性介绍

scripts.text: Thief Skill Explanation
scripts.translation: 盗贼技能介绍

scripts.text: Not curious about it.
scripts.translation: 没兴趣

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You made up your mind.
Welcome to the world of shadows.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你已经决定了。
欢迎来到暗影世界。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If you are ready, I will send you to the deserts of Morocc to embrace the shadows.
The journey will be both strange and challenging.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
准备好后，我就送你去梦罗克沙漠，投入暗影的怀抱。
这段旅程既陌生又充满挑战。

scripts.text: At once please.
scripts.translation: 现在就出发

scripts.text: I need more time.
scripts.translation: 我还需要些时间

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Yes, after a sufficient survey of other jobs, you may make a decision.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
没错，多了解其他职业之后，再做决定也不迟。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffFind the Pyramid^000000 in the ^4d4dffNorthwest^000000 of Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
前往摩洛克的^4d4dff西北方^000000寻找^4d4dff金字塔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
I'm sorry but you are short of job levels to change your job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
很抱歉，你的职业等级还不够，暂时无法转职。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Level composes of Base level and Job level.
Job level is what determines your current job.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
等级分为基础等级和职业等级。
职业等级决定你当前的职业。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffThe 1st job condition condition is job level 10.^000000
You need more experience so fight more and level up first.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff一转的条件是职业等级达到10级。^000000
你还需要积累经验，先多打些魔物、提升等级吧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You want to know more about stats?
As Vicente already told you, stats don't have a fixed answer.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
想多了解一些属性吗？
正如维森特说的，属性配点没有固定答案。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If I choose one among them,
^4d4dffAGI is related to flee ability^000000,
^4d4dffDex is related with hit ratio
STR raises physical attacking power^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
如果要挑一项的话，
^4d4dff敏捷（AGI）影响闪避能力^000000，
^4d4dff灵巧（DEX）影响命中率，
力量（STR）提高物理攻击力^000000。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Vit, Luk, Int are valued according your target chosen.
For your reference, Verkhasel has high level of Luk.
A weapon called Katar is good for Critical.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
体质、幸运和智力的作用，得看你选择的发展方向。
比如，维尔卡塞尔的幸运就很高。
拳刃很适合打出暴击。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
But thief's primary weapon is a dagger.
In the end, you have only to supplement your weak point, after evaluating you and your enemy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
不过，盗贼主要使用短剑。
评估自己和敌人的情况后，想办法弥补自己的弱点就行。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
If your attack doesn't hit the enemy, you come to think of the hit ratio.
Hope you find the right stats that are suitable to your fighting style.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
攻击打不中敌人时，就该考虑提高命中率了。
希望你能找到适合自己战斗风格的属性配点。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Which skill are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你想了解哪个技能？

scripts.text: Improve Dodge
scripts.translation: 残影

scripts.text: Double attack
scripts.translation: 二刀连击

scripts.text: Hiding and Steal
scripts.translation: 隐匿和偷窃

scripts.text: Envenom and Detoxify
scripts.translation: 施毒和解毒

scripts.text: Not curious about it.
scripts.translation: 没兴趣

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
As the name implies, ^4d4dffthis skill increases a certain amount of evasion ratio^000000
You want to avoid taking damage from enemy attack, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
顾名思义，^4d4dff这个技能可以提高一定的闪避率^000000。
你也想避开敌人的攻击吧？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffThis skill allows you to deal two damages with only one attack.^000000
Even though this dagger looks poor, it can damage your enemy severely by the fast two attacks.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff这个技能能让你一次攻击造成两次伤害。^000000
这把短剑虽然不起眼，但迅速的连击能让敌人伤得不轻。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffHiding means exactly that... to hide.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff隐匿，顾名思义，就是把自己藏起来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffSteal is the skill of stealing enemy's items^000000.
You can steal one item from one enemy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff偷窃就是从敌人身上窃取物品的技能^000000。
每个敌人身上只能偷到一件物品。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
^4d4dffEnvenom is used to poison your enemy.^000000
If poisoned, it can make a physical attacks slowly eat away at your foe.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
^4d4dff施毒可以让敌人中毒。^000000
敌人中毒后，生命值会逐渐减少。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Oppositely, the name implies, Detoxify removes poison status.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
反过来说，解毒顾名思义就是解除中毒状态。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is good you have enough knowledge.
Supplementary the field experiences will make you perfect.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你已经掌握了不少理论知识。
再加上实战经验，就能熟能生巧。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Is that so?
Like other job guilds, there is a limit learned through theory.
I would like to recommend you to experience battle first-hand.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
是吗？
和其他职业公会一样，光靠理论能学到的东西有限。
我建议你先亲自体验战斗。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
You are a stranger.
Excuse me but I was invited to explain about the jobs for the students,
I have no words to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
你是位陌生人。
抱歉，我受邀来为学员介绍职业，
没什么能告诉你的。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
It is almost miracle to meet you and me living far away from the light of ground.
We should abide by the regulations.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
能在远离地面的地下世界相遇，简直是奇迹。
我们还是得遵守规定。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Attending the class, first you may be a student of Criatura Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
想参加课程，首先得是克里图拉学院的学生。

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
However, if you want the information about the thief job itself, I will let you know.
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
不过，如果你想了解盗贼职业本身，我可以给你介绍。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, excellent!
Keep the stone as a souvenir.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哦，太好了！
这块石头就留作纪念吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Anyway, it is good enough for your skill experience purpose, let's finish the class here.
If you haven't finished Mr. Verkhasel's assignment, keep going with it.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
总之，已经足够让你体验这项技能了，这堂课就到这里。
还没完成维尔卡塞尔委托的话，就继续去完成吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Steal one Stone from a Poring.
Wasn't it fun?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
从波利身上偷一块石头。
挺有意思吧？

scripts.text: It didn't give me a stone.
scripts.translation: 没偷到石头

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不参加

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm? All porings were stolen of their stones?
I will summon Porings again, and you, try it once again.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
嗯？波利身上的石头都被偷光了吗？
我再召唤几只波利，你再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Hmmm. Is that so?
This is not your aptitude.
I see. This mission is now cancelled.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
嗯，是吗？
看来这项任务不适合你。
好吧，那就取消吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ahhh. Boring, Boring...
Now I can understand why Master ran away.
I want to go home.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
啊...无聊死了...
现在我总算明白师父为什么逃跑了。
我想回家。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
So do I.
Mayssel... what did she think of...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我也是。
梅塞尔...她到底在想什么...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Hmmm. Did she go AWOL?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
嗯...她擅离职守了吗？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Are you kidding me?!
Would you rather be carrying out a fatal mission!?!
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你在开玩笑吗？！
难道你宁愿去执行送命的任务吗？！

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah... I don't like it.
I would rather evaluate jewelry sitting at the workshop as usual...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
啊...我不太喜欢这样。
我还是更愿意像平时那样，坐在工作室里鉴定珠宝...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
.... .. ..
I will accept Verkhassel's wish.
Don't worry hohoho...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
...
我会答应维尔卡塞尔的请求。
别担心，呵呵呵...

scripts.text:
The mood is becoming gloomy.
Should I get out of here?
scripts.translation:
气氛越来越阴沉了。
我该离开这里吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are doing well.
I hope to see you again someday.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你做得不错。
希望以后还能再见到你。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Ah, for your reference, I am operating a small workshop in Lighthalzen.
Visit me there someday.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
对了，我在里希塔乐镇经营着一家小工作室。
有空来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Perhaps, I won't forget you...
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
也许我不会忘记你...
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
You are not a student of Criatura Academy.
If you want more explanation about this job, you better register as a student of the Academy.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
你还不是克里图拉学院的学员。
想进一步了解这个职业的话，最好先去学院登记。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Though only novices can register...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
不过，只有初心者才能登记...

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh, you became a good thief.
Don't you want to be a shadow chaser in your future?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哦，你已经是个出色的盗贼了。
以后想不想成为逐影猎人？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
This is the higher class applied by the elite Rogues of good artistry.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
这是只有技艺高超的精英流氓才能转职的高阶职业。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Above job level 40, any Thief can be transferred to a Rogue anytime.
Fortunately, the sailing service from Izlude wharf to Pharos lighthouse is available!!
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
职业等级达到40级后，盗贼随时都能转职为流氓。
而且，从依斯鲁得岛码头前往发乐斯灯塔岛的航线也开通了！！

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
First, is it courteous to ask whether you can be a Rogue or not?
If it is an application for an Assassin, what happens to you?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你先问问自己能不能当流氓，这样才算有礼貌吧？
那你要是申请成为刺客呢？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha. You like a bloody job?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哈哈，你喜欢血腥的职业吗？

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Haha... Calm down...
Don't respond to every tiny matter..
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哈哈...冷静点...
别为一点小事就反应过度...

scripts.text: The atmosphere became very tense.
scripts.translation: 气氛顿时变得紧张起来。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Welcome to the Criatura Academy.
Here, I am teaching the basics to the people wishing to be a Thief.
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
欢迎来到克里图拉学院。
我在这里教想成为盗贼的学员基础知识。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
So, in other words, I am handling the Novices wanting to be thieves.
Haha...
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
也就是说，我负责指导想成为盗贼的初心者。
哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
What? It interrupts me.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
什么？你打断我说话？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Eheee, Eheee, It can't be a joke.
Mayssel's class...
Did you call upon me for this kind of nasty thing?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
呃...这可不是开玩笑。
梅塞尔的课...
你叫我来处理这种麻烦事？

scripts.text: ...Let's keep working?
scripts.translation: ...我们继续？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
It's a pity. That man is scary.
But as long as I am with you, don't be afraid of him.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
真可惜，那个男人看起来好可怕。
不过有我陪着你，别怕。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
What are you talking about this time?
In the beginning, Lue.. You should not be here...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你这次又在说什么？
首先，卢敏...你本来就不该在这里...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.........Who am I?
Assistant.... Trainer?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...我是谁？
助理...训练师？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Zt...
Well, which one are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
啧...
好吧，你想了解什么？

scripts.text: Double Attack
scripts.translation: 二刀连击

scripts.text: Envenom
scripts.translation: 施毒

scripts.text: Improve Dodge and Hide
scripts.translation: 残影和躲藏

scripts.text: About you
scripts.translation: 关于你

scripts.text: That's enough.
scripts.translation: 够了

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You  may already know the primary weapon of a Thief is a dagger.
A Thief's specialty is the ^4d4dffDouble Attack^000000 by a dagger.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你应该知道，盗贼的主要武器是短剑。
盗贼擅长用短剑施展^4d4dff二刀连击^000000。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you are short of attacking power, it can be covered at a certain degree.
Any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
攻击力不足时，可以靠这招在一定程度上弥补。
还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
There is a skill called ^4d4dffEnvenom^000000 to intoxicate your enemy with poison and
the other skill called ^4d4dffDetoxify^000000 to remove the poisoned status.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
^4d4dff施毒^000000可以让敌人中毒，
而^4d4dff解毒^000000可以解除中毒状态。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can tell the poisoned status by its very pretty purple color.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
中毒时，身上会呈现很显眼的紫色。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
In case, you are poisoned, venom will decrease your vitality rapidly,
you either detoxify right away or take the antidote potion.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
中毒后，毒素会迅速削弱你的体力。
记得立刻解毒，或者服用解毒剂。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you have more interest in poison, you may be an assassin.
They officially use poison.
Then next!
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
如果你对毒很感兴趣，也许适合成为刺客。
刺客会正式使用毒药。
接下来！

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Thiefs train the skill called ^4d4dffImprove Dodge^000000.
This makes the enemy powerless by evading its attack.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
盗贼会学习^4d4dff残影^000000，
靠闪避敌人的攻击让对方无计可施。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Rather than being patient after being hit, it is more suitable for a less defensive thief to avoid from it fast.
Being this reason, agility [AGI] can't be neglected.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
防御较弱的盗贼，与其挨打硬撑，不如迅速躲开攻击。
因此，敏捷（AGI）不容忽视。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
^4d4dffHiding^000000 is the skill for refuge.
If successful, others can't see you.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
^4d4dff隐匿^000000是藏身的技能。
成功发动后，别人就看不到你。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Ah, as it is said you can't cheat a ghost.... You would be found by evil.
Also sensitive insects recognize it...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
俗话说，幽灵可骗不了...邪恶的魔物仍会发现你。
有些感知敏锐的昆虫也能看穿隐匿...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Other than these, it will be useful for avoiding emergency situations.
When you become higher jobs like Rogue or Assassin, you can learn more useful skills like Refuge.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
除此之外，隐匿也能帮你躲过紧急状况。
转职为流氓或刺客后，还能学到更多实用技能，例如藏身术。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Me? I am a chief of the Guillotine Cross.
......
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我？我是十字斩首者的首领。
...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
As one of the assassins, I am in charge of punishing the law violators, as the member of the execution group.
For your reference, the primary weapon of Verkhasel is Katar.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
作为刺客，我是行刑小组的一员，负责惩治违法者。
顺便告诉你，维尔卡塞尔主要使用拳刃。

scripts.text: How do you know that?
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道的？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
That's my hope.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我也是这么希望的。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Oh.. Smart funk~~
That's enough, Lu.
Any more questions?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
哦...挺机灵嘛～～
好了，卢。
还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can steal one item from one enemy.
I feel mortified at stopping here, but it's worse to be neglected...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你可以从每个敌人身上偷一件物品。
我也不想就这么停下来，但被你晾在一边更难受...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
OK.
Considering your favor not to ignore me, let's finish it now.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
好吧。
看在你没有无视我的份上，我们现在就结束这堂课。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Honestly, I don't think you need to know the details about the thief's skills.
Then, just be aware there is something like that..
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
老实说，盗贼技能没必要了解得那么详细。
知道有这些技能就够了...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I mean it is good enough now.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我的意思是，现在这样就够了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Anything else you're curious about?
I will give you an answer after you finish Mayssel's class.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
还有什么想问的吗？
等你上完梅塞尔的课，我再回答你。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I mean that she knows it.
Mayssel will do it for you.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我的意思是，她知道该怎么做。
梅塞尔会帮你的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Lazy boy.
Tell me the truth... You are annoying..
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
懒鬼。
说实话...你真烦人...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
.......You........
Zt.. I don't know the enemy..
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
...你...
啧...我也不知道敌人在哪儿...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Actual experience assignments about the skill?
To do it, your level is too high.
I can't use the guide.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
想做技能实战任务吗？
不过你的等级太高了，我没法使用手册安排任务。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Originally, I will let you hunt porings with envenom.
No way, if I can't use the skill....
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
本来想让你用施毒来猎杀波利。
可我没法使用技能，就没办法了...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Envenom is the skill to poison.
If not poison him, you can damage to him due to the characteristic of venom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
施毒可以让敌人中毒。
即使没能让敌人中毒，毒性本身也会造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Keep in mind of these. That might be good enough for you.
As it is the class to let you know what you can do.
Let's finish the skill experience.
Check with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
记住这些就够了。这堂课只是让你了解自己能做什么。
技能体验就到这里吧，去找梅塞尔确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are doing well.
Envenom has the poison effect and can damage from venom itself.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
做得不错。
施毒能让敌人中毒，毒性本身也会造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
The skill experience is now enough.
Check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
技能体验到这里就够了。
去找梅塞尔确认一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You can't equip the Thief Manual?
Your level is too high.
There is no other way.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
盗贼入门手册也装备不了吗？
你的等级太高了。
没别的办法了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Envenom is the skill to poison.
If not poison him, you can damage to him due to the characteristic of venom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
施毒可以让敌人中毒。
即使没能让敌人中毒，毒性本身也会造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Keep in mind of these. That might be good enough for you.
As it is the class to let you know what you can do.
Let's finish the skill experience.
Check with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
记住这些就够了。这堂课只是让你了解自己能做什么。
技能体验就到这里吧，去找梅塞尔确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
This is about the use of skill.
Now if you were an assassin, shall I let you test the skills related to venom which you may continue to use?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
这是在介绍技能的用法。
如果你是刺客，我倒可以让你体验还能继续使用的毒系技能。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Load the thief guide receved by Mayssel and open the skill window by pressing Alt+S key,
Register Envenom regisstered on the ETC compartment,  by pressing shortcut key^000000
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
装备梅塞尔给你的盗贼手册，按 Alt + S 打开技能窗口。
在“杂项”栏找到施毒，将它设到快捷栏上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Then, approach the Poring's cage in the center of this room and
Aim at Poring, and ^4d4dff' hunt one poring by using
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
然后走到房间中央的波利笼子旁，
瞄准波利，^4d4dff用施毒猎杀一只波利

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
That's my assignment to you.
You definitely use envenom to Poring in this room.
don't go out faraway to find Porings.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
这就是交给你的任务。
必须在这个房间里对波利使用施毒。
别跑到外面找波利。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Eummm.
It's sad..
Please accept my condolence in advance, as you can't experience envenom... hehehe...
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
嗯...
真可惜...
你没法体验施毒，我先提前向你表示哀悼...呵呵呵...

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
From now, I am going to hunt Poring..
...Don't misunderstand me for challenging you, as such I  want to make a bet with you.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
从现在起，我要去猎杀波利...
别误会，我不是要挑战你，只是想和你打个赌。

scripts.text: Lumin is betting win or loose.
scripts.translation: 卢敏正在下注，赌输赢。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are doing well.
Envenom has the poison effect and can damage from venom itself.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
做得不错。
施毒能让敌人中毒，毒性本身也会造成伤害。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
The skill experience is now enough.
Check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
技能体验到这里就够了。
去找梅塞尔确认一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Come close to a poring cage and use envenom to poring.
You must do it only to porings in this room.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
走到波利笼子旁，对波利使用施毒。
只能对这个房间里的波利使用。

scripts.text: I see..
scripts.translation: 我明白了...

scripts.text: I won't do it.
scripts.translation: 我不做了。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
OK. Until you kill all the porings in the cage, attack them with venom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
用施毒攻击波利，直到笼子里的波利全被消灭为止。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
These are not your aptitude.
I will cancel my assignment, and the other assignments from Mayssel to be cancelled by her.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
看来这项任务不适合你。
我会取消自己的任务，梅塞尔也会取消她安排的其他任务。

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: I will continue..
scripts.translation: 我会继续...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Cancel the mission to hunt poring with envenom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
取消用施毒猎杀波利的任务。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Have you changed your mind?
Then, until you kill all the poring in the cage, keep attacking them with envenom.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
改变主意了？
那就继续用施毒攻击笼子里的波利，直到它们全被消灭为止。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Now you fully understand what skill venom is..
As you completed my assignment, go and check it with Mayssel.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
现在你应该完全明白施毒这个技能了...
既然完成了我的任务，就去找梅塞尔确认一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are the bung finished Mayssel's class complete.
Any more questions, ask Mayssel.
It is the end of my class.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你总算上完梅塞尔的课了。
还有问题就去问她。
我的课也到此结束。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
If you become a thief, we may meet together in far future..
If you become an assassin.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
如果你成为盗贼，也许很久以后我们还会再见...
如果你成为刺客，那就...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
There is no words to tell you guy not belonging to our academy.
In fact, I pulled out here unwillingly, I don't have mind to be kind of you...
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
不属于本学院的人，我没什么好说的。
说实话，我是不情愿被叫来的，没心情对你们客气...

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
Wait, Verkhasel.....
Don't get even with other innocent....
How about helping my class for me?
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
等等，维尔卡塞尔...
别拿无辜的人出气...
不如帮我代一下课？

scripts.text: ... everyone seems tense..
scripts.translation: ...大家好像都很紧张...

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Yo~ You...
What do you want to be?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
喂～你...
想当什么？

scripts.text: An Assassin!
scripts.translation: 刺客！

scripts.text: A Rogue!
scripts.translation: 流氓！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Welcome to your joining in the way of bloody darness.
My comrad.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
欢迎你加入这条血腥的黑暗之路。
我的同伴。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
..............
(Verkhasel glancing at sky)
...
... Ha...!
The mood is becoming strange.
scripts.translation: 气氛变得有些诡异。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
Go over there.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
过去吧。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh... Mr. Verkhasel...
Don't play like this among a family.
Why are you dividing us into teams?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哦...维尔卡塞尔先生...
我们同属一个公会，别这样嘛。
为什么还要把我们分成两队？

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
I've never been in your family.
Originally, you are not a Rogue.
You were only a merchant.
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
我可从来没加入过你们那一伙。
再说，你本来就不是流氓，
你以前只是个商人。

scripts.text:
[Vicente]
Oh.. No.. What a dirty word.
Have I asked you for buying something from me?
scripts.translation:
[维森特]
哦...别说得那么难听。
我有求你买过我什么东西吗？

scripts.text:
[Mayssel]
..........You look friendly.. Two of you...
scripts.translation:
[梅塞尔]
...你们两个看起来关系真好...

scripts.text: The mood has become tense.
scripts.translation: 气氛变得紧张起来。

scripts.text:
[Verkhasel]
You are the guy knows everything you need.
Are you coming to watch only? Emmm?
Why don't you help the juniors without watch only?
scripts.translation:
[维尔卡塞尔]
你不是自称什么都懂吗？
你打算只在旁边看着？嗯？
何不帮帮后辈，别光看热闹？

scripts.text:
Quest cannot be continued due to the overfilled inventory.
Please try it again after organizing the items.
scripts.translation:
背包已满，无法继续任务。
整理好物品后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Your eagerness and efforst to complete mission moved me to offer something.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
你完成任务时的热情和努力打动了我，我想给你点东西。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
^4d4dff It is to hunt all 4 Porings here within 30 seconds^000000.
If you do, I will yield to you all the earned item in my hand.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
^4d4dff在30秒内猎杀这里的4只波利^000000。
做到了的话，我就把手里的战利品全给你。

scripts.text: If I fail?
scripts.translation: 如果我失败了呢？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
It is our bet. You have to give up yours as you lost.
Emmm. As I am generous, I will receive ^4d4dff10 beginner's red potions^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
这是我们打的赌。你输了，就得交出赌注。
嗯，我很大方，就收你^4d4dff10瓶初心者红色药水^000000吧。

scripts.text: Give Up.
scripts.translation: 我认输

scripts.text: I Accept.
scripts.translation: 我接受

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.... Eh...
Coward!
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...呃...
胆小鬼！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.... Good!
Now, ^4d4dffspeak to me once you finish hunting 4 porings in 30 seconds.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...很好！
现在，^4d4dff在30秒内猎杀4只波利，完成后再来找我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
The intoxicated enemies won't die only from poisoning.
They only come close to death.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
中毒不会直接杀死敌人，
只会让它们濒临死亡。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
.. Why do Porings turn their back?
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...波利为什么都背对着我？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
... 30 seconds have passed and you have not yet hunted 4 porings.
Then, it is not interesting.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...30秒过去了，你还没猎杀完4只波利。
这样就没意思了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
If you don't like do it... no way.
As I am generous, I disregard the bet this time.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
不想做就算了...没办法。
我大方一点，这次就不计较赌注了。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You may be too busy in^4d4dff hunting 4 porings in 30 seconds.^000000
Hey, time passes now...
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
你可能正忙着^4d4dff在30秒内猎杀4只波利。^000000
喂，时间可在流逝呢...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Oh... You are very powerful!
Now then, as agreed I will give you everything I have.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
哇...你真厉害！
那么，按照约定，我把刚才得到的战利品都给你。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I've had a lot of fun because of you!
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
和你一起玩得真开心！

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
Regretfully, 30 seconds has passed.
.....
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
真可惜，30秒已经过去了。
...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I will give them to you anyways.
Come on, take it.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
不管怎样，我还是把东西给你。
来，拿着吧。

scripts.text: Why are you treating me like this?
scripts.translation: 你为什么要这样对我？

scripts.text: Didn't I loose?
scripts.translation: 我不是输了吗？

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
You spent time with me.
Get it free. I stole them from Porings.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
你陪我一起度过了这段时光。
这个送给你，不收钱，是我从波利身上偷来的。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
We may meet again.
Becoming familiar with others is pleasrue and sad.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我们以后或许还会再见。
和别人熟悉起来，既令人开心，也难免伤感。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
... It may be in trouble if it dies upfront...
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
...要是它先死了，事情可能会变麻烦...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
At last, the day comes.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
终于等到这一天了。

scripts.text: Lumin changing clothes piece by piece.
scripts.translation: 卢敏开始一件件脱下衣服。

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
I was carrying out my mission.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
我刚才是在执行任务。

scripts.text: No need to make an excuse....
scripts.translation: 不用找借口了...

scripts.text:
[Lumin]
At least to you, I don't want to be a stranger.
Forget what you saw today, as I have to introduce to the way of Thief Guild as many people as possible.
scripts.translation:
[卢敏]
至少，我不想和你变成陌生人。
忘了今天看到的事吧。我还得尽可能多地向大家介绍盗贼公会的规矩。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Did you ^ff0000register with the Criatura Academy^000000?
You can register at ^ff0000information center of Criatura Academy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
你在^ff0000克里图拉学院登记^000000了吗？
可以去^ff0000克里图拉学院的信息中心^000000办理登记。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is annoying... but you need to register so you can receive ^ff0000lots of education and service of Criatura Academy^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
虽然手续有点麻烦...但登记后才能享受^ff0000克里图拉学院提供的各项教育和服务^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
oh Odin!
Nice to meet you.
I am Alice Yisha ^ff0000in charge of Acolytes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
哦，奥丁！
很高兴见到你。
我是爱丽丝·伊莎，^ff0000负责服事课程^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Welcome~
Glad to meet you again.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
欢迎～
很高兴再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
If you did not select Acolyte as a job, why don't you study more about it?
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
如果你还没选服事，何不多了解一下这个职业？

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
I guess you do not need my help any more.
Do you have any questions about Acolytes?
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
看来你已经不需要我的帮助了。
关于服事还有什么想问的吗？

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte serves ^ff0000Odin^000000 so it can use ^ff0000Holy skills^000000 according to the will of Odin.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
服事侍奉^ff0000奥丁^000000，能遵循奥丁的旨意施展^ff0000神圣系技能^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Most skills are based on ^ff0000the purpose of treatment or aid^000000 so it is a very important job for ^ff0000party hunting^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
大多数技能都用于^ff0000治疗或辅助^000000，因此服事在^ff0000组队狩猎^000000中非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is a ^ff0000hybrid job^000000 which can change ^ff0000attack type^000000 depends on increased status, but the range of weapon is narrow because they don't use fatal killing weapons for religious reason.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
服事是^ff0000混合型职业^000000，所加属性不同，^ff0000攻击方式^000000也会改变。
但受宗教戒律影响，他们不使用致命武器，可选武器种类较少。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte is categorized as ^ff0000support type^000000 and ^ff0000physical attack type^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
服事分为^ff0000辅助型^000000和^ff0000物理攻击型^000000。

scripts.text: Support type
scripts.translation: 辅助型

scripts.text: Attack type
scripts.translation: 攻击型

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000INT^000000 is important status for ^ff0000support type Acolytes^000000.
^ff0000INT^000000 enhances ^ff0000treatment function^000000 and increases ^ff0000SP^000000 which is necessary for using skills.
It also helps ^ff0000SP recovery^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000智力（INT）^000000是^ff0000辅助型服事^000000的重要属性。
^ff0000智力（INT）^000000能增强^ff0000治疗效果^000000、提高使用技能所需的^ff0000SP^000000，
也有助于^ff0000恢复SP^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
But  aid type acolyte has a weakness point such as ^ff0000It is difficult to hunt alone^000000.
So it goes huning with ^ff0000party^000000 or use ^ff0000heal^000000 skill to monsters with ^ff0000fire-attribute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
不过，辅助型服事不擅长^ff0000独自狩猎^000000。
通常会加入^ff0000队伍^000000，或用^ff0000治愈术^000000攻击^ff0000火属性魔物^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
It is like ^ff0000heal skill with holly power is fatal to undead with fire-attribute^000000.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
例如，带有神圣力量的^ff0000治愈术对火属性不死系魔物有致命效果^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
The important status FOR ^ff0000physical attack type^000000 acolyte is ^ff0000STR, VIT, AGI, DEX^000000.
The status seem to be complicated compare to support type but it is simple indeed.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000物理攻击型^000000服事的重要属性是^ff0000力量（STR）、体质（VIT）、敏捷（AGI）和灵巧（DEX）^000000。
这些属性看起来比辅助型复杂，其实很简单。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000STR is the power, increases attack power, VIT is physical power, AGI is attack , speed and dodge, DEX increases hitting rate and skill casting speed.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000力量（STR）能提高攻击力；体质（VIT）增强体格；敏捷（AGI）提高攻击速度和闪避率；灵巧（DEX）提高命中率和技能咏唱速度。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
For the character of ^ff0000Attack type^000000, ^ff0000DEX^000000 will be most important status...no?
If the attack does not hit the enemy, the attack is meaningless.
You may increase STR, VIT, AGI according to your style.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
对^ff0000攻击型^000000服事来说，^ff0000灵巧（DEX）^000000最重要...对吧？
攻击打不中敌人，就毫无意义。
力量、体质和敏捷则可按个人风格分配。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
You might think an Acolyte is not strong enough because it has no attack type skill, it enables use of sub essential skills which enhance the powers as much as you want. It helps your stable hunting.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
你可能觉得服事没有攻击技能，所以不够强。其实服事可以用辅助技能强化自身能力，帮助你更稳定地狩猎。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
还有问题的话，尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
An acolyte has lots of skills.
All those skills are useful.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
服事有很多技能，
而且每一项都很实用。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000Heal^000000 is for the wounds, It is also used to attack undead with opposite attribute.
Increase the power related to ^ff0000speed^000000 and ^ff0000[Increase Agi]^000000 to increase  ^ff0000movement speed^000000
^ff0000[Blessing]^000000 can ^ff0000enhance^000000 ^ff0000STR, INT, DEX^000000 at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000治愈术^000000可以治疗伤口，也能用来攻击相克属性的不死系魔物。
提高^ff0000敏捷^000000并学习^ff0000[加速术]^000000，可以提升^ff0000移动速度^000000。
^ff0000[天使之赐福]^000000可以同时^ff0000提高^000000^ff0000力量（STR）、智力（INT）和灵巧（DEX）^000000。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
^ff0000[Teleport]^000000 is to ^ff0000move^000000 to other places.
^ff0000[Warp Portal]^000000 can open a gate to the ^ff0000Places saved in memory^000000.
There are still more skills as well.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000[瞬间移动]^000000可以^ff0000前往^000000其他地点。
^ff0000[传送之阵]^000000则能开启通往^ff0000记忆中保存地点^000000的传送门。
服事还有很多其他技能。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask ^ff0000if you want to experience skills of an Acolyte, ask the sister next to you^000000.
Now I am reading an introductory skill.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
^ff0000想体验服事技能的话，可以问问你旁边的修女。^000000
我现在在看技能入门指南。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
oh my!
So.. you decided to be an Acolyte?
Odin welcomes you.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
哎呀！
这么说...你决定成为服事了？
奥丁会欢迎你的。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Do you truly wish to become a servant of God?
Let's see whether you are ready for it or not... Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
你真的愿意成为神的侍从吗？
让我看看你准备好了没有...嗯...

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Please visit ^ff0000Father Mareusis^000000 at the church in the ^ff0000northeast corner^000000 of ^ff0000Prontera.^000000
At ^ff0000Job Level 10^000000 you can join the ministry.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
去^ff0000马鲁西斯神父^000000在^ff0000东北角^000000的^ff0000普隆德拉^000000教堂拜访他。
达到^ff0000职业等级10级^000000后，就能加入教会。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Oh my?! You haven't accomplished the basic practice yet?! You have long way to go! Come again after increasing your job level!
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
哎呀！基础训练还没完成吗？！你还有很长的路要走呢！提升职业等级后再来吧！

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Wonderful! I'll transfer you to the local ministry at Prontera.
^ff0000Please visit Father Mareusis at the church in the northeast corner of Prontera.^000000
At ^ff0000Job Level 10^000000 you can join the ministry.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
太好了！我会把你转介给普隆德拉当地的教会。
^ff0000请前往普隆德拉东北角的教堂拜访马鲁西斯神父。^000000
达到^ff0000职业等级10级^000000后，就能加入教会。

scripts.text: Go to the field south of Prontera
scripts.translation: 前往普隆德拉南边的野外

scripts.text: End Conversation
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
还有问题的话，尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Good, I wish you luck~
Let's go~
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
很好，祝你好运～
我们出发吧～

scripts.text:
[Alice Yisha]
Ask me anything if you have more questions.
scripts.translation:
[爱丽丝·伊莎]
还有问题的话，尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Wow... this academy is amazing?
It was not like this when I used to train in the past.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
哇...学院真了不起！
我以前受训时，可没有这么好的条件。

scripts.text: - You have too many items. Clear inventory and try again. -
scripts.translation: - 背包里的物品太多了，请先整理后再试。 -

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Wow... this academy is amazing?
It was not like this when I used to train in the past.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
哇...学院真了不起！
我以前受训时，可没有这么好的条件。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
You can ^ff0000register^000000 at the ^ff0000information center of the Criatura Academy^000000, it will be a great help.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
您可以先^ff0000登记^000000，再前往^ff0000克里图拉学院的信息中心^000000办理，会方便很多。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Ahem..~
Who are you?
Are you interested in this ^ff0000introductory course^000000?
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
咳咳...～
你是谁？
对这门^ff0000入门课程^000000感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[A nun]
This introductory manual is mysterious! It enables the ^ff0000use a couple of an Acolyte's skill^000000.
Will you borrow it?
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
这本入门手册很特别！可以让你^ff0000体验几项服事技能^000000。
要借来看看吗？

scripts.text: Take the Acolyte Course.
scripts.translation: 参加服事课程

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Well.. if you are not interested.. fine.
murmuring
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
嗯...既然你没兴趣...那就算了。
（低声嘟囔）

scripts.text:
[A nun]
You already have one.
We do not give two.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
你已经有一本了。
我们不能再发给你第二本。

scripts.text:
[A nun]
Then, use it for good.
^ff0000Equip (double click or drag to equipment window)^000000 and open the ^ff0000skill window(Alt+S)^000000 to see the skills in manual.
scripts.translation:
[一位修女]
那就好好利用吧。
^ff0000装备手册（双击或拖到装备窗口）^000000，再打开^ff0000技能窗口（Alt + S）^000000查看里面的技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I do not wish to speak to you. Leave now...
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我不想和你说话。现在离开...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you want to be trained as a Ninja, just visit Hono O, who is at the room next to where you upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
想接受忍者训练的话，就去找霍诺·欧。他在你转职的房间隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Ko Ori]
If you want to be trained as a Ninja, just visit Hono O, who is at the room next to where you upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[小织]
想接受忍者训练的话，就去找霍诺·欧。他在你转职的房间隔壁。

scripts.text:
[Ko Ori]
How was it?
Although he is very blunt, he does care very deeply about newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[小织]
感觉怎么样？
他虽然说话很直，其实很关心新人。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I am the guide to the way of the Ninja for newcomers.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我是为新人指引忍者之道的向导。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I am not interested in the people who are already on their path.
Take your leave now...
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我不想和已经踏上忍者之路的人打交道。
请离开...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
A child cannot accept the life of the Ninja.
It is not easy to qualify for such a life, so do not feel sorry...
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
小孩子还无法承担忍者的生活。
要达到这种资格并不容易，不必觉得遗憾...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
First of all, you must enroll in the Academy and visit me again.
Everything has to follow the correct procedures and being clumsy is no excuse.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
首先要先在学院登记，然后再来找我。
办事必须遵守规矩，笨手笨脚可不是借口。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Hmmm. So a new beginner has come eh?
Why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
嗯...来了个刚入门的新人啊？
你来这里做什么？

scripts.text: Explanation about the Ninja.
scripts.translation: 忍者职业介绍

scripts.text: I decided to be a Ninja.
scripts.translation: 我决定成为忍者

scripts.text: I don't have any business here.
scripts.translation: 我只是路过

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
A beginner wishing to be a Ninja....
Ask me what you are curious about.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
想成为忍者的新人...
有什么好奇的就问我吧。

scripts.text: What can I do if I become a Ninja?
scripts.translation: 成为忍者后能做什么？

scripts.text: What is required to become a Ninja?
scripts.translation: 成为忍者需要什么条件？

scripts.text: I want to experience Ninja skills.
scripts.translation: 我想体验忍者技能

scripts.text: I don't have any worries about Ninjas.
scripts.translation: 关于忍者，我没什么想问的

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Ninja is a profession that allows you to attack while sneaking for maximum damage.
As Ninja has various kinds of deception skills, which is good for soloing.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
忍者擅长潜行后发动攻击，造成最大伤害。
忍者还有各种诡术技能，很适合单独行动。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Not only can you learn Ninja technique similarly as magic, you can also make direct attacks, deal critical damage or throw knives at enemies.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
你不但能学习类似魔法的忍术，还可以直接攻击、打出暴击，或向敌人投掷飞刀。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
But you can't do all of these things perfectly without sufficient equipment.
You will take more damage than others if you are hit.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
不过，没有合适的装备，就无法充分发挥这些能力。
而且一旦被击中，你会比其他职业承受更多伤害。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Therefore, if the person who is not completely weary of this world chooses this job, with no discretion, they will not fail.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
忍者有多种修行路线，每一种都有优缺点。
务必深思熟虑，再做决定。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Ninja can be trained in a variety of courses.
Everything has both one merit and one demerit.
You would better make your own decision after profound consideration.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
忍者有多种修行路线。
每种都有优点和缺点，最好仔细考虑后再决定。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
There are two major status which affect the degree of damages.
One is ^ff0000Power^000000, the other is ^ff0000Intelligence^000000,
Power affects the damages by^8E2323 physical attacks^000000 and^8E2323 throwing attacks^000000.
Intelligence affects the damage by ^8E2323Ninja's skill ^000000
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
有两项主要属性会影响伤害。
一项是^ff0000力量^000000，另一项是^ff0000智力^000000。
力量会影响^8E2323物理攻击^000000和^8E2323投掷攻击^000000的伤害。
智力则影响^8E2323忍者技能^000000的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
In addition to these, you can learn
other statuses not from the professional trainers like us
but from the trainers teaching the basic skills for battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
除此之外，你还可以学习其他属性相关的知识。
这部分要向教授战斗基础的训练师请教，而不是找我们这些职业训练师。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
For example, to raise up the hit rate,
What should you do?
To raise the defense, what do you wear? Etc...
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
比如，想提高命中率该怎么做？
想提高防御力又该穿什么？诸如此类...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
You can equip this manual to experience some skills.
Open up your skill window by pressing <Alt+S> and find the skills in the Misc TAB.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
装备这本手册就能体验一些技能。
按<Alt+S>打开技能窗口，再到“杂项”标签页查看。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
The Academy has a trainer downstairs who will give you battle field training. Meet him and train your skills.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
学院楼下有位训练师，可以带你进行战斗训练。去找他练练技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
He will give you some quests to complete. Use the Manual to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
他会安排一些任务给你。战斗时可以使用手册中的技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Make every useful moment count.
You can equip this manual to experience some skills.
Open up your skill window by pressing <Alt+S> and find the skills in the Misc TAB.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
把每一刻都用在有意义的事情上。
装备这本手册就能体验一些技能。
按<Alt+S>打开技能窗口，再到“杂项”标签页查看。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
The Academy has a trainer downstairs who will give you battle field training. Meet him and train your skills.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
学院楼下有位训练师，可以带你进行战斗训练。去找他练练技能吧。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
He will give you some quests to complete. Use the Manual to help you in battle.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
他会安排一些任务给你。战斗时可以使用手册中的技能。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Do you understand everything I told you?
That's all... You don't have any questions?
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我说的这些你都明白了吗？
就这些...没有其他问题了吗？

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I appreciate your braveness but, first of all, you have to be familiar with the current profession.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我欣赏你的勇气，不过首先得熟悉自己现在的职业。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Before you decide to become a Ninja,
you need to come back after reaching the novice's job level 9. Then, I will accept you.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
想成为忍者，先把初心者职业等级升到9级，再回来找我。到时候我会接纳你。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
This may be your last warning.
Becoming a Ninja means leading a difficult life.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
这也许是我最后一次提醒你。
忍者的生活可不好过。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
As Ninja don't belong to a guild, it is easily obtainable to Novices.
Make sure your decision is final!
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
忍者不隶属于任何公会，初心者也能直接转职。
一定要慎重考虑，确定自己想清楚了！

scripts.text: I will reconsider.
scripts.translation: 我再考虑一下。

scripts.text: I already made up my mind.
scripts.translation: 我已经决定了。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
Well thought actions can often bring good results.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
三思而后行，往往会有好结果。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you're so assertive, I have no choice but to guide you there.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
既然你这么坚决，我也只好带你过去了。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I will send you close to where you can change your job.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
我会把你送到转职地点附近。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I will give you a special hint.
Amatsu town is where you are going to arrive. Find the hidden tunnel in a vacant house.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
给你个特别提示：你会抵达樱花城。去一栋空屋里找隐藏的隧道。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
There you will meet a person who will guide you to becoming a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
在那里，你会遇到一位能指引你成为忍者的人。

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
If you get lost in the town, well there is no way... Being ninja requires a level of observation power.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
要是在城里迷路了，我也帮不了你...成为忍者需要敏锐的观察力。

scripts.text: -Select ^ff0000Confirm^000000 to go to Amatsu.
scripts.translation: -选择^ff0000确认^000000前往樱花城。

scripts.text: Confirm
scripts.translation: 确认

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
............

[Ninja Guide]
......
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
...

scripts.text:
[Ninja Guide]
I have no words to say, if you don't have any business with me.
scripts.translation:
[忍者向导]
没事的话，我没什么可跟你说的。

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 背包太满，无法继续对话。 -

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hello? My name is Han to lead the next generation of refining culture in Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
你好！我叫韩，致力于引领卢恩-米德加兹的精炼文化迈向新一代。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Entering this market lately, if I don't have old customers, it is not easy to operate. So, I do the advertising by myself.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
刚入行时没有老顾客，生意可不好做。所以我只好亲自宣传。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Are you interested in ^3E86C3refining^000000 to make your items strong?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
想用^3E86C3精炼^000000强化装备吗？

scripts.text: I have no interest.
scripts.translation: 没兴趣

scripts.text: refining? Is it edible?
scripts.translation: 精炼？能吃吗？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ah, I am sorry. I caught a busy man.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
啊，抱歉，打扰你了。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Refining means to strenghthen your equipments with  ^3E86C3rare metal^000000 obtainable from monsters and so on.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
精炼就是用从魔物身上等途径获得的^3E86C3稀有金属^000000来强化装备。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
If weapons are refined, their attacking power increases. If shields are refined, their defensive power increasesand helps to reduce pain against monster's hits on you.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
精炼武器能提高攻击力，精炼盾牌能提高防御力，减轻受到魔物攻击时的伤害。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
So you kind of get the jist of it right?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
大概明白精炼是怎么回事了吧？

scripts.text: Oh... refining...
scripts.translation: 哦...精炼啊...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Yes, that's it. Refining is good but it can get addicting.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
没错，就是这样。精炼是好东西，不过也容易让人上瘾。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I don't usually do it, but will give you a special chance to experience refining.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我平时不这么做，不过这次破例让你体验一次精炼。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Whatever 1st level weapon level can be used it doesn't matter! If you use the ^3E86C3refining machine Wagjak^000000 over there!!
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
不管你拿的是哪种武器，都能拿来精炼！用那边的^3E86C3精炼机瓦格杰克^000000就行！！

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
^I will give you ^FD4F02just! one refining service free of charge.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
^我可以给你^FD4F02一次免费的精炼服务^000000。

scripts.text: Only once?
scripts.translation: 只有一次？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hey I need to make a living you know! Don't go telling everyone I'm doing this for free ok?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
喂，我也得养家糊口啊！别到处跟人说我免费帮你精炼，行吗？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
You haven't used the refining machine Wagjak.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
你还没用过“瓦格杰克”精炼机呢。

scripts.text: Refining Machine Wagjak
scripts.translation: 瓦格杰克精炼机

scripts.text: Why is it called Wagjak?
scripts.translation: 为什么叫瓦格杰克？

scripts.text: Anything else I should know?
scripts.translation: 还有什么要注意的吗？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
The refining machine Wagjak is a machine I made after 8 years of research.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
这台瓦格杰克精炼机是我花了八年研究制造出来的。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I made it for more precious refining. It is my personal refining machine. Well, thanks to it, I have made several contracts.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我造它是为了进行更高级的精炼。这是我的私人精炼机，多亏了它，我还谈成了好几笔生意。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
The name doesn't mean anything it's just a name. Wagjak! What a weird name right?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
这个名字没什么特别意思，就是随便取的。瓦格杰克！是不是很奇怪？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Absolutely!
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
当然！

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
But I subscribe to the idea that seeing is believing... You know what I mean? Try it out yourself instead of asking questions.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我一直相信眼见为实...你懂我的意思吧？别光问，自己试试看。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ohoh... as you don't have a service coupon.. You may have already used Wagjak...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
哦哦...你没有服务券啊...看来你可能已经用过瓦格杰克了...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I hope you have a brief understanding of refining.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
希望你已经对精炼有了初步了解。

scripts.text: Anything else I should know?
scripts.translation: 还有什么要注意的吗？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Yes, yes, we have... Safety refining indications and refining price... such small things...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
对了，还有安全精炼规则和精炼价格之类的小事...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
For an explanation ^3E86C3weapon levels^000000 & ^3E86C3safety refining^000000...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
关于^3E86C3武器等级^000000和^3E86C3安全精炼^000000的说明...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
You can learn from ^3E86C3Mr. Taddae^000000 selling Phracon and Emveteracon
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
可以向^3E86C3塔达埃先生^000000了解强化武器金属-级数一和强化武器金属-级数二，他负责出售这两种材料。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I recommend you visit and listen to Mr. Tadde about weapon levels and safe refining.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
建议你去找塔德先生，听听他讲解武器等级和安全精炼。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Did you get a good lesson? Did he explain it well enough?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
课听得怎么样？他讲清楚了吗？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Just between us, there is a rumor that lots of employees complain about me.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
悄悄告诉你，听说不少员工都在抱怨我。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I sent you there to monitor the situation.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我让你过去，就是想让你打探一下情况。

scripts.text: So?
scripts.translation: 然后呢？

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I will adopt it in the performance rating. By the way, how was Mr. Tadde's lesson?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我会把这件事纳入他的绩效评估。对了，塔德先生讲得怎么样？

scripts.text: It was excellent.
scripts.translation: 讲得非常好

scripts.text: It was just OK.
scripts.translation: 还不错

scripts.text: It was so-so.
scripts.translation: 一般般

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
He did a good job...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
他做得不错...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hmm. Is that so? I see... I'll have to jot this down...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
嗯，是吗？我知道了...得把这件事记下来...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Hmm.. It was like that... I see.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
嗯...原来是这样...我知道了。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Now! I'm done organizing..
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
好了！整理完了...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Next is the explanation about ^3E86C3refining effect^000000 and ^3E86C3refining price^000000.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
接下来要介绍^3E86C3精炼效果^000000和^3E86C3精炼价格^000000。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
^3E86C3Mr. Locas^000000 is in charge with refinement with Oridecon gemstones.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
^3E86C3洛卡斯先生^000000负责用神之金属原石进行精炼。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Go speak with Mr. Locas's about the refining effect and refining price.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
去找洛卡斯先生，问问精炼效果和价格吧。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Ah!! I ask for your favor this time, either.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
啊！！这次又得麻烦你了。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Go and see ^3E86C3Mr. Locas^000000 in charge with refining Oridecon stone for the refining effect and refining price.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
去问负责精炼神之金属原石的^3E86C3洛卡斯先生^000000，了解精炼效果和价格。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Did you get a good lesson? Did he explain it well enough?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
课听得怎么样？他讲清楚了吗？

scripts.text: He was good great.
scripts.translation: 讲得特别好

scripts.text: It was just OK.
scripts.translation: 还不错

scripts.text: So-so..
scripts.translation: 一般般

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Mr. Locas explained it to you well.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
洛卡斯先生讲得很清楚。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Just OK? Hmmm.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
只是还不错？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
Oh no.. You were not satisfied with his explanations...
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
糟了...看来他讲得不够好，让你不满意...

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
I see. I will jot that down.
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
我知道了，会记下来的。

scripts.text:
[Refinery Owner Han]
By the way, I have finished all the explanations about refining. Any further questions?
scripts.translation:
[精炼厂主 韩]
关于精炼的说明就到这里。还有其他问题吗？

scripts.text: No questions at all.
scripts.translation: 没问题了

scripts.text: I have some questions...
scripts.translation: 我还有些问题...

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Welcome. The owner told me to explain to you about ^3E86C3the weapon levels^000000 and ^3E86C3safety refining.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
欢迎。店主让我向你说明^3E86C3武器等级^000000和^3E86C3安全精炼^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
In fact, it is better to get to know while questing yourself. But anyway if you have any questions, please ask to me.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
其实，自己做任务时慢慢了解会更好。不过有问题的话，尽管问我。

scripts.text: Weapon level
scripts.translation: 武器等级

scripts.text: Safety refining.
scripts.translation: 安全精炼

scripts.text: Finish the question.
scripts.translation: 结束提问

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Weapons have level, whereas Armors don't. The more ^3E86C3upscaled a weapon^000000 is, the higher the weapon level is.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
武器有等级，防具则没有。武器^3E86C3精炼等级^000000越高，武器等级也越高。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
That means ^A20B09the upscaled weapons are more difficult to obtain.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
这也意味着，^A20B09高等级武器更难获得^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Considering the customers coming to refine, the ones for refining level 1,2 weapons are more than those for level 3,4 weapons.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
来精炼的顾客中，拿1级、2级武器来的比拿3级、4级武器的多。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Safety refining differs from the levels of Armor or weapon, so basically each level has a ^3E86C3different safe upgrade level.^000000
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
安全精炼上限会因武器或防具的等级而异，每个等级都有^3E86C3不同的安全精炼上限^000000。

scripts.translation: 1级武器

scripts.text: Level 2 Weapon
scripts.translation: 2级武器

scripts.text: Level 3 Weapon
scripts.translation: 3级武器

[Tadde]
Level 1 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+7^000000. The lower the level of weapon is, the higher the figure of the refining is possible.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
1级武器精炼到^A20B09+7^000000都在安全范围内。武器等级越低，安全精炼上限越高。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Of course, it has stronger effect than level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
当然，等级更高的武器，性能也更强。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 2 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+6^000000, even though refining figure is lower than level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Of course, it has stronger effect than level 1 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
当然，等级更高的武器，性能也更强。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 3 weapons are safe when refined up to ^A20B09+5^000000. Simply speaking, it looks like the safety refining goes down by 1 according to each weapon level.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
3级武器精炼到^A20B09+5^000000都在安全范围内。简单来说，武器等级每提高一级，安全上限就降低1。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
The higher the weapon is, the increasing effect of +1 becomes higher as well.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
武器等级越高，每提升精炼等级+1，带来的效果也越明显。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Level 4 weapons are safe up to ^A20B09+4^000000. Numbers of level 4 weapons are so rare that not so many customers bring them here.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
4级武器精炼到^A20B09+4^000000都在安全范围内。4级武器很稀有，拿来精炼的顾客不多。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
As it is one of the most luxurious weapons, the effect of refining is the strongest.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
这类武器十分珍贵，精炼带来的效果也最强。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
Armors are safe when refined up to^A20B09+4^000000, just like a level 4 weapon.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
防具和4级武器一样，精炼到^A20B09+4^000000都在安全范围内。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]
As most refiners are used to making weapons it's hard for them to safely upgrade armors.
scripts.translation:
[塔德]
大多数精炼师平时更常精炼武器，因此不太擅长安全地精炼防具。

scripts.text:
[Tadde]

scripts.translation:

看来您已经了解了安全精炼的相关知识。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

您的问题问完了。以后还有疑问的话，随时可以来找我。
